issues.body:
## Current main verification — 2026-10-07

**Partially fixed; remaining scope is outer-call recovery.** PR #13515 has merged and prevents quoted tool markup from being dispatched as a real call. The pending follow-up is PR #13579, which has not merged.

Verified at [`1aba19c87889`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/1aba19c87889e8bd55f5249b81e21d8de3f056dd) using freshly built core/CLI artifacts, an actual CLI/tmux run and an anonymous controlled streaming provider. No #13579 parser injection was used. A `write_file` content value documenting an unfenced, harmless shell-call example produced **zero native tool calls**: the quoted shell stayed inert, but the outer `write_file` was also lost and the expected file was absent.

Keep this issue open until the complete outer value is written exactly once and the quoted markup remains data. The unsafe dispatch described in the original report below is historical pre-#13515 behavior, not the observed current-main behavior.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

#13515 已修复“执行参数中引用的命令”。最新 main 复测中引用命令保持不执行，但外层 write_file 也没有恢复，文件未生成。因此保留开放，剩余问题由未合并的 #13579 跟进；下方误执行描述属于修复前的历史报告。

</details>

---

## Original report before #13515

## Summary

`extractXmlToolCalls` dispatches markup that a parameter value merely *quotes*: a `write_file` whose `content` documents the dialect with an unfenced example call is dropped, and the quoted example is recovered as a real call. On the pre-hardening base of the same branch the identical input kept the example as data and recovered the real call, so this is a regression introduced by the rejected-block rescan in `2ce7b0c144`.

## Reproduction

```ts
import { extractXmlToolCalls } from './xml-tool-call-fallback.js';

const quoted =
  '<invoke name="run_shell_command"><parameter name="command">rm -rf /tmp/x</parameter></invoke>';
const text =
  '<invoke name="write_file"><parameter name="file_path">doc.md</parameter>' +
  `<parameter name="content">Usage:\n${quoted}\n</parameter></invoke>`;

extractXmlToolCalls(text);
```

Measured output at the current head (`838292de11`, and identically at `2ce7b0c144`):

```json
[{ "name": "run_shell_command", "args": { "command": "rm -rf /tmp/x" } }]
```

The `write_file` call is not recovered at all — the whole block stays in `remainingText` as prose.

Same input at the branch base `2a064ee999` (i.e. before the rescan):

```json
[{ "name": "write_file", "args": { "file_path": "doc.md", "content": "Usage:\n<invoke name=\"run_shell_command\"><parameter name=\"command\">rm -rf /tmp/x" } }]
```

Nothing is dispatched from the quoted markup.

## Cause

`recoverableToolCallBlocks` in `packages/core/src/core/xml-tool-call-fallback.ts`:

1. `TOOL_CALL_PATTERN` matches the outer `write_file` block, but its lazily matched body ends at the **inner** `</invoke>`, so the parameters region ends up containing a call opener the parameters did not consume. The block is rejected — correctly, by its own guard.
2. The rescan added for truncated blocks then repositions the scan to just after the outer block's open tag (`resumeAt = match.index + tagEnd`), where the nested, complete call is matched **on its own merits** and returned.

Text-level, "a following call the truncated block swallowed" (the case the rescan was added for, pinned by `does not dispatch a truncated block that borrows the next call closers`) and "a call quoted inside an accepted parameter value" have the same geometry. They differ only in whether the swallowed region belongs to a value, which the current spans do not model: `PARAMETER_PATTERN` is applied flat and lazily, so a value's own terminator is consumed by the enclosing match.

## Why it matters

The text a model emits as documentation can execute. A quoted shell command inside a `write_file` payload is run, and the write the user actually asked for is silently dropped. Fenced blocks and `<example>` wrappers are already skipped, so the gap is specifically an unfenced quote inside a parameter value — which is exactly what "here is the syntax" prose looks like.

## Suggested direction

Decide a block's fate before rescanning, using value-scoped spans: pair parameter open/close tags by depth so a call inside an accepted value is data, and only rescan past regions that no accepted parameter owns. The existing witness (`does not dispatch a truncated block that borrows the next call closers`) must keep passing — in that case the swallowed call is not inside any accepted value.

## Scope notes

- Found while triaging a local, never-pushed branch that implemented an alternative hardening; that branch is not a superset of the current head and is not proposed for merge.
- Related: [#13437](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13437) is the PR that carries the hardening; its head already fixes a *different* regression from the same commit (a legitimate call whose value mentions `<parameter …>` was rejected outright).

prs.title: feat(sdk-java): add private CSI Session and native SQL authority
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a complete private CSI Session authority block extracted from #13526: explicit Session creation and durable request pinning, the original writer and first activation, native journal/resource proof, immutable SQL execution grants, authenticated worker bind/history/execute readback, and durable resource-read ownership. The existing file worker and local-process rejection boundary from #13899 remain the foundation.

Authorized private executions now refuse unsupported cancellation before durable state changes. Larger exact execution outcomes can be recorded as bounded inline chunks, preserving their full envelope and model history.

Ordinary materialization and publication retain main's existing query budgets by reusing locked Session reads and removing repeated journal-head locks from admitted lease/PUT settlement. Private allocation and retained-pin refusal remain enforced. The original public Java identity entry point remains compatible through a deprecated facade.

Ordinary image packaging now selects the single main artifact while excluding private operator artifacts. Queued ordinary projection completion checks its current settled state before interpreting obsolete source data, and active claims retain full persisted-owner proof. Upgrade history assertions and database-specific lock observation cover the new migrations without changing production locking.

## Why it's needed

Main already has the private descriptor-backed worker, but its positive worker tests use explicit authority fixtures. It does not connect a persisted private Session and its original journal to the worker's execution evidence. This extraction makes that SQL-to-worker connection reviewable without bringing in the proposal's Hosted lifecycle, replacement recovery or physical retirement. It also preserves later main fixes, including #13894's publication locking order and the current reader, definition, rename, cancellation and resource collection behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create a private Session with a reviewed registration and operator request. Replaying the same request must return the same Session and pin without creating a turn or starting a worker; a changed request or retained conflicting pin must refuse without writes.
- Establish the first original writer and activation, append native journal records and retry them. Exact replay and original renewal must succeed; a replacement writer, altered resource, foreign context or incomplete batch must refuse.
- Inspect reservation versus authorization: only a complete committed native intent and dispatch checkpoint may mint an immutable grant for the original binding and dispatch generation. Worker readback must require the original runtime credentials and installed context; caller-supplied references alone must not authorize effects.
- Check private resource reads preserve OPEN/RETURNED/UNKNOWN evidence across delivery uncertainty, expired leases and changed bytes. Generic mutation, task cancellation, collection, release and recovery paths must refuse private or retained-pin ownership while ordinary controls continue to work.
- Request cancellation of an authorized private file execution: it must refuse without changing the version or cancellation flag, and a later successful completion must remain recordable. Verify a 40 KiB and a maximum-size result can commit an exact chunked outcome and advance its result message/checkpoint; altered, missing, duplicate or excessive parts must refuse. Reopening an existing manifest must retain every part in the next transaction census.
- Complete the currently outstanding positive integration: obtain an actual SQL execution grant, read it through authenticated execution readback, execute through the existing worker, and verify exact retry and retained-history file effects. The local results below do not claim that this whole chain has passed.
- Check that ordinary materialization keeps the existing statement budgets (empty tick 4, full batch 35, tail 17) and the exercised publication path takes 6 head locking reads. Private mutations and generic publication allocation must refuse before effects; previous public Java imports must still work.

- Build the ordinary image with all operator artifacts present: one main artifact must be selected; a missing or ambiguous main must fail. Retire an ordinary Session while projection is queued: completion must suppress without an event or artifact; a foreign active claim must refuse. Verify upgrades preserve all previously applied history and concurrency checks observe actual row waits on each supported database.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No TUI changes. The global CLI baseline cannot reach this private Java lifecycle. On main, the request/activation/grant/read-ownership schema is absent; an owned SQL/API fallback recorded the baseline. On the extracted candidate, an independent MySQL 8.4 run applied all 68 migrations through V72 and passed 14 declared observations covering CREATE/replay/refusal, seven actual native commits and their replays, original activation/renewal, ordinary controls, authenticated adapter bind readback and current-state row-lock fences. A separate report comment contains exact candidate, commands, qualification limits and regression evidence.

Local repository build, typecheck and bundle passed. Focused Java tests and static checks passed, as did 255 existing CSI worker/readback/history tests. Pure proof tests, H2 tests, an HTTP fixture responder and the MySQL bind check are distinct evidence levels; none substitutes for the outstanding positive SQL-grant-to-worker integration.

Follow-up boundary fixes passed repository build/typecheck/bundle, 82 focused Core tests, 241 Broker tests, 99 Server tests, ESLint/Prettier, Checkstyle and SpotBugs. Independent HTTP/native-proof fixtures verify cancellation ordering and exact large-result capacity; an owned file-persisted HTTP fixture verifies resource census across restart. These checks do not qualify the outstanding real SQL-grant-to-worker chain.

Query-budget and compatibility follow-up at `c7277fd2a`: final build/typecheck/bundle, Checkstyle and SpotBugs passed; 694 focused Server tests passed with 2 explicit H2 skips. The unchanged budget assertions are restored. Independent current-source verification passed 9 actual MySQL locking cases and restored public Java identity signatures; final Java class/test/dependency hashes match that run. This qualifies those locking and compatibility cases, not actual SQL grant-to-worker acceptance.

CI regression follow-up at `54ef5ca0e`: final build/typecheck/bundle,35 unchanged script tests,253 focused Server tests, Checkstyle and SpotBugs passed. An independent current-source run passed13/13 actual MySQL8.4 cases covering both upgrades, both queued retired projection races, RC/RR refusal, collector claim/page versus private CREATE and five publication lock-order cases. All598 main-class files,479 test-class files and123 dependency jars match that run after the final gate. The exact selector retains missing/ambiguous guards. Actual MariaDB execution remains pending its new CI; these cases do not qualify container deployment or the real SQL-grant-to-worker chain.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ local build, Java tests, isolated MySQL and functional API checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ native CSI/Kubernetes deployment not tested |

### Environment

Node.js 22.14.0, Temurin 21.0.12, Maven 3.9.16 and an owned MySQL 8.4.11 instance. Functional test processes and databases are isolated and closed after each run. Runtime/Pod identities in SQL tests are explicit codec-validated fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- This is a substantial cross-package feature. It needs maintainer architecture review under the core infrastructure advisory. The PR was externally marked Ready; the extraction does not qualify production rollout.
- The actual positive SQL grant → authenticated execution readback → worker/retained-history chain and independent MySQL resource-delivery fault scenarios remain unvalidated. Native Linux CSI, Kubernetes deployment and safe physical reuse are also unvalidated.
- Public CSI selection, Hosted execution entry points, replacement writers, cold recovery, DRAINING continuation, terminal/finalization, physical stop/unpublish, release/reuse and producer fairness/error classification are follow-up work. Unsupported private paths remain closed. A producer must quiesce executions before history preparation, matching the existing worker's exclusivity contract.
- Four new unpublished migrations use V69–V72, after current main's V68; existing published migrations are unchanged. Private retained ownership has no release path in this block.
- Broker and Server share one private runtime identity implementation. The previous public Java entry point remains as a deprecated facade with all three public signatures; the cross-package feature still needs maintainer review.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-session-authority-block/docs/design/2026-10-12-csi-session-authority-block.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-session-authority-block/docs/design/2026-10-12-csi-session-authority-block.zh-CN.md). Both include matching scope, decisions, acceptance criteria and evidence gaps.

## Linked Issues

Source proposal: #13526 (unchanged). Prerequisites already merged: #13899 and #13894. No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

从 #13526 拆出完整的私有 CSI Session 权威模块：显式创建 Session 并持久化 request pin、原始 writer 与首次 activation、原生日志及资源证明、不可变 SQL execution grant、认证 worker bind/history/execute 回读，以及持久化资源读取 ownership。#13899 已合并的文件 worker 与本地进程拒绝边界仍是基础。

已授权的私有执行在修改持久化状态前拒绝不支持的取消。较大的执行 outcome 可采用有界 inline 分块，完整保留执行 envelope 和模型 history。

普通 materialization 与 publication 复用已有 Session 加锁读取，移除已准入租约/PUT 收尾中的重复 journal head 锁，保留主干查询预算。私有分配与 retained-pin 拒绝仍生效。原公开 Java identity 入口通过 deprecated facade 保持兼容。

普通镜像打包选择唯一主产物并排除私有operator产物。排队中的普通projection完成先检查当前已结束状态，再解析已失效source数据；活跃claim仍保留完整持久化owner证明。升级history断言与各数据库的锁等待观察覆盖新增migration，不改变生产锁行为。

### 为什么需要

主干已有私有 descriptor worker，但 worker 正向测试使用明确的 authority fixture，尚未把持久化私有 Session 和原生日志接到 worker 执行证据。本拆分把 SQL 到 worker 的连接整理为可评审模块，不带入原提案的 Hosted 生命周期、替代恢复或物理退役，并保留主干后续修复，包括 #13894 的 publication 锁顺序，以及当前 reader、definition、rename、cancellation 和 resource collection 行为。

### 评审测试计划

- 使用评审后的 registration 与 operator request 创建私有 Session。相同 request replay 应返回同一 Session 和 pin，不创建 turn、不启动 worker；request 变化或保留的冲突 pin 应在写入前拒绝。
- 建立首次原 writer 与 activation，提交原生日志并重试。准确 replay 和原 renewal 应成功；替代 writer、变化资源、外来 context 或不完整 batch 应拒绝。
- 区分 reservation 与 authorization：只有完整已提交的 native intent 和 dispatch checkpoint 才能为原 binding 与 dispatch generation 创建不可变 grant。Worker 回读必须使用原 runtime credential 与 installed context；仅有调用者提供的 reference 不应授权文件效果。
- 检查私有 resource read 在 delivery 不确定、lease 过期或字节变化时保留 OPEN/RETURNED/UNKNOWN 证据。通用 mutation、task cancel、collection、release 和 recovery 应拒绝私有或 retained-pin ownership，同时普通对照继续工作。
- 请求取消已授权的私有文件执行：应拒绝且不改变 version 或 cancel flag，随后成功完成仍能记录回执。检查 40 KiB 和最大结果能提交精确分块 outcome 并推进结果消息/checkpoint；篡改、缺失、重复或超限 part 应拒绝。重新打开既有 manifest 后，后续事务清单应保留每个 part。
- 完成目前尚未执行的正向集成：取得实际 SQL execution grant，通过认证 execution 回读，经既有 worker 执行，并验证准确 retry 和 retained-history 文件效果。下面的本地结果不宣称该整条链已通过。
- 检查普通 materialization 保留既有语句预算（空 tick 4、完整批 35、末批 17），受测 publication 路径保持 6 次 head 加锁读取。私有变更与通用 publication 分配须在产生效果前拒绝，原公开 Java import 应继续工作。

- 在所有operator产物存在时打包普通镜像：应选出唯一主产物，缺失或歧义应失败。普通Session退役与排队projection并发时，完成应抑制且没有event/artifact；外来活跃claim应拒绝。检查升级完整保留既有applied history，并发检查在每个支持的数据库上观察真实行锁等待。

### 前后证据

无 TUI 改动。全局 CLI 基线无法到达私有 Java 生命周期。主干缺少 request/activation/grant/read-ownership schema，自有 SQL/API fallback 已记录基线。独立 MySQL 8.4 测试在拆分候选上应用了截至 V72 的 68 个 migration，并通过 14 项明确观察：CREATE/replay/拒绝、七个实际 native commit 及其 replay、原 activation/renewal、普通对照、认证 adapter bind 回读和当前状态 row-lock fence。独立测试报告评论记录准确候选、命令、资格边界及回归证据。

本地仓库 build、typecheck、bundle 已通过，定向 Java 测试和静态检查已通过，255 项既有 CSI worker/readback/history 测试也已通过。纯 proof、H2、HTTP fixture responder 和 MySQL bind 检查属于不同证据层次，均不替代待完成的正向 SQL grant 到 worker 集成。

后续边界修复已通过仓库 build/typecheck/bundle、82 项 Core 定向测试、241 项 Broker 测试、99 项 Server 测试，以及 ESLint/Prettier、Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs。独立 HTTP/native-proof fixture 验证取消顺序及完整大结果容量；自有文件持久化 HTTP fixture 验证跨重启的资源清单。这些检查不代表剩余真实 SQL grant 到 worker 链路已完成验收。

查询预算与兼容性修复 `c7277fd2a`：最终 build/typecheck/bundle、Checkstyle 与 SpotBugs 通过；694 项 Server 定向测试通过，2 项明确 H2 跳过。未改动的预算断言已恢复。独立当前源代码验证通过 9 项实际 MySQL 锁检查及旧公开 Java identity 签名检查，最终 Java class/test/依赖字节与该运行一致；这些证据资格化对应锁与兼容性案例，不代表实际 SQL grant 到 worker 验收。

CI回归修复 `54ef5ca0e`：最终build/typecheck/bundle、35项未改动脚本、253项Server定向测试、Checkstyle与SpotBugs通过。独立当前源代码运行通过13/13真实MySQL8.4案例，覆盖两条升级、两条排队projection与退役竞争、RC/RR拒绝、collector claim/page与私有CREATE，以及五条publication锁顺序。最终598个main-class、479个test-class文件和123个依赖JAR与该运行一致，准确选择器仍拒绝缺失或歧义主产物。实际MariaDB仍等新CI；这些案例不资格化容器部署或真实SQL grant到worker链路。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地构建、Java 测试、独立 MySQL 与功能 API 检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试原生 CSI/Kubernetes 部署 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.14.0、Temurin 21.0.12、Maven 3.9.16，以及自有 MySQL 8.4.11。功能测试进程和数据库隔离，每轮结束均关闭。SQL 测试中的 runtime/Pod 身份是明确的 codec-validated fixture。

### 风险与范围

- 这是较大的跨包 feature，按 core infrastructure advisory 需要维护者架构评审，PR 已由外部操作转为 Ready；本拆分不资格化生产 rollout。
- 实际正向 SQL grant → 认证 execution 回读 → worker/retained-history 链路，以及独立 MySQL resource-delivery fault 场景仍未验证。原生 Linux CSI、Kubernetes 部署及安全物理复用也未验证。
- 公开 CSI 选择、Hosted 执行入口、替代 writer、冷恢复、DRAINING continuation、terminal/finalization、物理 stop/unpublish、release/reuse，以及 producer 公平性和错误分类是后续工作。不支持的私有路径保持拒绝。Producer 必须按既有 worker 的互斥契约，在 history preparation 前停止发出 execution。
- 四个未发布 migration 使用 V69–V72，接在当前主干 V68 之后；既有已发布 migration 不变。本模块中的私有 retained ownership 没有 release 路径。
- Broker 与 Server 共用私有 runtime identity 实现。原公开 Java 入口以 deprecated facade 保留全部三个公开签名；跨包 feature 仍需维护者评审。
- [英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-session-authority-block/docs/design/2026-10-12-csi-session-authority-block.md)与[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-session-authority-block/docs/design/2026-10-12-csi-session-authority-block.zh-CN.md)完整同步范围、决策、验收条件和证据缺口。

### 关联

来源提案为 #13526（不修改），已合并前置为 #13899 和 #13894。本 PR 不关闭 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): strip UTF-8 BOM before parsing settings.json to avoid false corruption reset
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `~/.qwen/settings.json` that starts with a UTF-8 BOM was parsed with the BOM still attached, so `JSON.parse` failed and the file entered the corruption-recovery path — the user's settings were reset to `{}` (with a `.corrupted` backup) on the next start. This strips the leading U+FEFF before parsing in the two settings-file read paths (`loadAndMigrate` and `LoadedSettings.reloadScopeFromDisk`) by exporting the `stripBom()` helper that already exists in `jsonc-editor.ts`. Only the parse expression changes: the raw content string (and therefore `rawJson` and the BOM-preserving write path from #1680) is untouched, and genuinely corrupted files still take the recovery path exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Windows editors such as old Notepad versions and PowerShell 5.1 (`Set-Content -Encoding UTF8`) write a BOM by default, and many editors offer "UTF-8 with BOM". The read path treated that harmless prefix as corruption and wiped all user settings, while the write path deliberately preserves a BOM when editing files (#1680) — so a settings file the tool itself had just edited could be reset on the next read. BOM tolerance already has precedent in the repo (`jsonc-editor.ts` `stripBom()`, and `normalizeContent()` in core `textUtils.ts` used by skill loading).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reproduction (before) and verification (after) on Windows 11, Node v24.19.0, importing the built `packages/cli/dist/src/config/settings.js` with `QWEN_HOME` redirected to a temp dir containing a BOM-prefixed `settings.json` (`\uFEFF{"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"}}`):

- Before: `loaded.user.settings` is `{}`, `corruptedPath` is `...settings.json.corrupted`, and the file on disk is overwritten to `{}`.
- After: `loaded.user.settings` contains the full settings object, no `.corrupted` file is created, no reset write happens, and the on-disk file keeps its leading BOM after the normal write-back — i.e. it now behaves exactly like a file without a BOM.

Focused suites: `npx vitest run src/config/settings.test.ts src/utils/jsonc-editor.test.ts` — 233 tests, all passing, including two new cases (a BOM file loads instead of entering corruption recovery; only the leading BOM is stripped, a BOM inside a JSON string value is preserved). `npx eslint` on the three touched files is clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change — live-module reproduction output, same script against the unfixed and fixed build (Windows 11, Node v24.19.0):

```
BEFORE (unfixed build)
loaded.user.settings = {}
loaded.corruptedPath = ...\qwenhome\settings.json.corrupted
settings.json on disk NOW = "{}"          <- wiped
.corrupted file created  = true

AFTER (this change)
loaded.user.settings = {"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"},"$version":4}
loaded.corruptedPath = undefined
.corrupted file created  = false
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |

|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ not tested locally — platform-neutral parse fix, covered by CI  |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅ tested — Windows 11, Node v24.19.0   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️ not tested locally — platform-neutral parse fix, covered by CI  |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification used the built CLI dist module with `QWEN_HOME` redirected to a temp directory; unit tests only, no production services involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: minimal — `stripBom()` is an identity function for files without a BOM, and genuinely corrupted files still reset as before. A BOM-prefixed file whose JSON is also broken now fails at the next parse error instead of the BOM, still landing in the recovery path.
- Not validated / out of scope: the same missing-BOM pattern exists in `.mcp.json` loading (`packages/cli/src/config/mcpJson.ts`) and a few warn-only config readers; left out to keep this change atomic (happy to follow up separately).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: fix(ci): reset the reused runner checkout before fetching
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reset the runner-local git state that `actions/checkout` inherits, before it runs its fetch. The job's existing pre-checkout cleanup step now drops the whole inherited `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git` so the `Checkout` below re-clones at depth 1 — the end state a fresh hosted runner starts from — and captures the pre-reset state first (shallow boundary count, how many of those oids do not resolve locally, the ref count the next fetch will advertise, whether a `commondir` redirect was present, the runner's git version, and `count-objects -v`).

The reset sits inside the step's existing `[ -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git" ]` guard, so it is a no-op on a fresh hosted runner, and last inside that guard because the worktree/branch sweeps above it need the repository to still exist. It is spelled as the literal workspace path, never via `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir`: a leftover `.git` *file* is a `gitdir:` pointer that resolution would follow outside the workspace. It degrades the way every other rung in this step degrades — `rm -rf` → `sudo -n rm -rf` → `::warning::` — so a reset that could not happen warns instead of failing the job.

All **twelve** copies of the pinned sweep body carry it: six `ci.yml` jobs (`classify_pr`, `test`, `lint_and_static`, `web_shell_e2e_smoke`, `integration_no_ak`, `integration_cli`) and six across `sdk-java.yml`, `sdk-java-flyway-open-prs.yml` and `sdk-java-contract-open-prs.yml`. The rationale lives in `.github/workflows/pre-checkout-git-reset.md` and the block keeps a pointer to it, because the size ratchet forbids carrying the same prose inline twelve times; `.size-baseline` is bumped for `ci.yml` and `sdk-java.yml` in this PR, as that ratchet requires.

## Why it's needed

Refs #13951. The `Integration Tests (no-AK, No Sandbox)` lane fails at the `Checkout` step on the reused self-hosted ECS pool, on all three of `actions/checkout`'s internal retries (job `114645716645`, run `38198248458`):

```
git config --local --get remote.origin.url     <- reused .git
git clean -ffdx
git reset --hard HEAD
git config --local gc.auto 0
git -c protocol.version=2 fetch --no-tags --prune --no-recurse-submodules --depth=1 origin +refs/pull/13815/head:...
##[error]fatal: pack has 1 unresolved delta
##[error]fatal: fetch-pack: invalid index-pack output    (x3)
```

The runner workspace is reused, so the previous job's shallow boundary survives in `.git/shallow`. `actions/checkout` pins `git config --local gc.auto 0`, so no git process ever repairs or reclaims that boundary between jobs. The next `--depth=1` fetch then advertises `have` lines for commits whose subtrees are gone, the server builds a thin pack whose delta base the client cannot resolve, and every retry fails byte-identically because the store never changes between them. That is why a plain job-level retry cannot help: the fix has to reset runner-local repository state rather than retry the fetch. Since this PR was opened the failure has spread across the pool — `pack has 10/13/14/19/28/30/31 unresolved deltas` over six jobs in a single push batch, on every pooled lane, with none of the affected PRs sharing a diff area.

**This supersedes the first version of this PR, which dropped only `.git/shallow` and `.git/commondir`.** Round 3 of review measured that the boundary-only reset does not clear the state: on git 2.43.0 — the version all three failing runners report — a depth-1 fetch after `rm -f .git/shallow .git/commondir` still fails `rc=128` on all three retries, while `--refetch` and a fresh `clone --depth=1` both return `rc=0`. What closes it is an object-store reset, not a boundary reset, so that is what this PR now does. `.git/commondir` was also wrong to keep in the pair: it has no role in thin-pack negotiation, and `resanitize-git-config.sh` removes it *first* because a planted one repoints local config, refs and objects — a property that a removal placed after the `worktree`/`branch` sweeps does not obtain either. The old comment's claim that "neither file exists on a normal `actions/checkout`" was false for `shallow`: `fetch-depth: 1` writes it on every run, which is exactly why a reused workspace carries the previous job's boundary.

**I cannot settle the mechanism, and this PR does not claim to.** The automated review measured that injecting a `.git/shallow` entry naming an absent commit leaves the fetch *succeeding* (`rc=0`); the independent human analysis on #13951 concluded the root cause is the stale shallow boundary, cross-checked against all three failing job logs. The object-store reset is chosen because it is the superset — it clears the boundary state one analysis blames *and* the object-store state the other measured, and it is the only reset with a measurement behind it. The diagnostic added here exists so the next occurrence settles that rather than leaving it inferred, which is what #13951's triage asks for.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`ci.yml` and the three `sdk-java*` workflows parse under the repo's own `yaml` package, all twelve sweep bodies hash identically (`len=5719`, `sha256=ab52f5746ee4`), the extracted `run:` block passes `bash -n`, and all four files are `prettier --check` clean. `.github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh` exits 0.

The reset's own behaviour is covered by four new cases in `scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js`, which run the extracted sweep body under the runner's `bash -eo pipefail` against fixture workspaces: a workspace carrying `.git/shallow` + `.git/commondir` (the store is gone, and the notice reports `shallow-boundaries=1 unresolved-locally=1 commondir=yes` plus a warning naming the unresolvable oid), a workspace with no `.git` (no-op, no annotation), a workspace where `rm`/`sudo` both fail (the store survives and the step still exits 0 with the warning), and the pointer/anchor contract for the design record. Each one is mutation-probed below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The change is CI-only, so there is no user-visible surface to screenshot; the observable evidence is the workflow-test output, the mutation probes, and the size gate.

```
$ npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts \
    scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js \
    scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js \
    scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js
  Test Files  3 passed (3)
       Tests  267 passed | 35 skipped (302)

$ npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts \
    scripts/tests/capture-tmux-ci.test.js scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js \
    scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js scripts/tests/no-ak-integration-ci.test.js \
    scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js
  Test Files  5 passed (5)
       Tests  132 passed | 5 skipped (137)

$ bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh ; echo "exit=$?"
✅ every workflow file is under the 470000-byte gate and within 4096 bytes of its recorded baseline
exit=0

$ npx prettier --check .github/workflows/{ci,sdk-java,sdk-java-flyway-open-prs,sdk-java-contract-open-prs}.yml
All matched files use Prettier code style!
```

Those eight suites are every `scripts/tests/*` file that reads `ci.yml` and runs on this platform; the four `qwen-*-workflow.test.js` suites that also read `ci.yml` are excluded on Windows by the suite config, and were read instead — all four reference a different step (`Clean stale agent state`, `Clean stale review worktrees`) and none pins the sweep body.

Mutation probes — each reverts one property and confirms the test that owns it goes red:

```
mutation                                              expected  observed
A. block removed from ONE non-first ci.yml copy        red       red    (job "integration_cli" sweep drifted from the first copy)
   sdk-java suite (pins to ci.yml's first copy)        green     green
B. block removed from the FIRST ci.yml copy            red       red    (job "test" sweep drifted from the first copy)
   sdk-java suite (derives its reference from copy 1)  red       red
C. rm fallback chain removed                           red       red    (step dies on the unlink under errexit)
D. store removal deleted                               red       red    (the store survives)
```

Mutation A is the one requested in review: the twelve-copy propagation is not decoration — a single drifted copy reddens `job "<id>" sweep drifted from the first copy`, and B shows why the `sdk-java*` copies have to move in the same commit.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22.2 + Git Bash on Windows for the workflow suites, the mutation probes and the shell fixtures. This is a CI workflow change with no local OS surface — the block is POSIX shell and its behaviour is OS-independent — but the macOS and Linux rows are marked ⚠️ rather than ✅ because nothing here executes on those hosts, and the incident itself needs the reused self-hosted pool. `npm run test:scripts` as a whole could not be run to completion in this environment: its `globalSetup` spawns `cmd.exe` via `shell: true` and intermittently fails with `EBUSY` before any test is collected, and under parallel load `spawnSync` returns `null` for unrelated suites (`workflow-size.test.js` passes alone and fails in the full run with `git init: expected null to be 0`). The eight suites above were therefore run in small batches, which is the signal reported here.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every pooled job now re-clones at depth 1 instead of reusing the inherited object store, so the reset trades one depth-1 clone per job for a checkout that otherwise fails identically three times and skips every later step. The alternative the review measured — resetting only the boundary — leaves the reproducible state in place.
- Not validated / out of scope: the mechanism is **not** proven. Neither the failing state nor the failure itself was reproduced locally; there is no access to a reused ECS workspace holding a live stale store. The diagnostic is the substitute, not a reproduction. #13951's triage names four lanes to cover (`test`, `integration_no_ak`, `integration_cli`, `lint`); this change reaches all of them, but the tracker should stay open until either a recurrence is captured with the new diagnostic or the mechanism is confirmed on a real occurrence.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Hosted runners are unaffected — a fresh runner has no `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git` before `Checkout`, so the guarded block is skipped. `ci.yml` and `sdk-java.yml` grow past their recorded `.size-baseline` entries by more than the 4096-byte allowance (11496 and 8552 bytes); both entries are bumped in this PR, which is what that ratchet requires.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13951

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 `actions/checkout` 执行 fetch 之前，重置它所继承的 runner 本地 git 状态。该 job 已有的 checkout 前清理步骤现在会删除整个继承来的 `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git`，使下方的 `Checkout` 以 depth-1 重新 clone——也就是全新托管 runner 的起始状态——并在此之前先记录重置前的状态（shallow 边界数量、其中多少个 oid 在本地无法解析、下一次 fetch 将会 advertise 的 ref 数量、是否存在 `commondir` 重定向、runner 的 git 版本，以及 `count-objects -v`）。

该重置位于该步骤已有的 `[ -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git" ]` 守卫内部，因此在全新的托管 runner 上是空操作；它位于该守卫的**最后**，因为其上方的 worktree/branch 清理需要仓库仍然存在。它使用字面的工作区路径书写，绝不通过 `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir`：残留的 `.git` **文件**是一个 `gitdir:` 指针，该解析会跟随它走到工作区之外。它与该步骤中其他所有梯级一样降级——`rm -rf` → `sudo -n rm -rf` → `::warning::`——因此一次未能发生的重置会告警，而不会让 job 变红。

被钉住的 sweep 正文的**全部十二份**副本都带有它：`ci.yml` 的六个 job（`classify_pr`、`test`、`lint_and_static`、`web_shell_e2e_smoke`、`integration_no_ak`、`integration_cli`），以及跨 `sdk-java.yml`、`sdk-java-flyway-open-prs.yml` 与 `sdk-java-contract-open-prs.yml` 的六份。理由存放在 `.github/workflows/pre-checkout-git-reset.md`，代码块保留一个指向它的指针，因为体积棘轮禁止把同一段说明内联十二次；`.size-baseline` 中 `ci.yml` 与 `sdk-java.yml` 的条目已在本 PR 中更新，这正是该棘轮所要求的。

## 为什么需要

关联 #13951。`Integration Tests (no-AK, No Sandbox)` 这条 lane 在复用的自托管 ECS 资源池上、在 `Checkout` 步骤失败，`actions/checkout` 的三次内部重试全部失败（job `114645716645`，run `38198248458`）：

```
git config --local --get remote.origin.url     <- 复用的 .git
git clean -ffdx
git reset --hard HEAD
git config --local gc.auto 0
git -c protocol.version=2 fetch --no-tags --prune --no-recurse-submodules --depth=1 origin +refs/pull/13815/head:...
##[error]fatal: pack has 1 unresolved delta
##[error]fatal: fetch-pack: invalid index-pack output    (x3)
```

runner 工作区被复用，因此上一个 job 的 shallow 边界残留在 `.git/shallow` 中。`actions/checkout` 固定设置了 `git config --local gc.auto 0`，因此 job 之间没有任何 git 进程会修复或回收该边界。随后 `--depth=1` 的 fetch 会为子树已经消失的 commit 发出 `have` 行，服务端据此构建出一个 thin pack，而客户端无法解析其 delta base；由于对象库在三次重试之间始终不变，每次失败都字节级相同。这正是单纯的 job 级重试无法奏效的原因：修复必须重置 runner 本地的仓库状态，而不是重试 fetch。自本 PR 打开以来，该失败已在资源池上蔓延——单批 push 中就有六个 job 报出 `pack has 10/13/14/19/28/30/31 unresolved deltas`，覆盖每一条池上 lane，且受影响的 PR 彼此没有任何改动区域重叠。

**本 PR 取代了它的第一版，那一版只删除 `.git/shallow` 与 `.git/commondir`。** 评审第三轮实测表明，仅重置边界并不能清除该状态：在 git 2.43.0（三台失败 runner 报告的版本）上，`rm -f .git/shallow .git/commondir` 之后再做 depth-1 fetch，三次重试仍然 `rc=128`，而 `--refetch` 与全新的 `clone --depth=1` 都返回 `rc=0`。能终结该失败的是**对象库**重置，而非边界重置，因此本 PR 现在做的就是这件事。`.git/commondir` 也不该留在那一对里：它与 thin-pack 协商无关，而 `resanitize-git-config.sh` 之所以**最先**删除它，是因为被植入的 `commondir` 会重定向本地 config、refs 与 objects——而放在 `worktree`/`branch` 清理之后的删除并不能获得该安全属性。旧注释中「这两个文件在正常的 `actions/checkout` 上都不存在」的说法对 `shallow` 而言是错误的：`fetch-depth: 1` 每次运行都会写入它，这恰恰是复用工作区会带着上一个 job 边界的原因。

**我无法判定该机制，本 PR 也不宣称能判定。** 自动评审实测：向 `.git/shallow` 注入一条指向不存在 commit 的记录后，fetch 依然**成功**（`rc=0`）；而 #13951 上独立的人工分析结论是根因为陈旧的 shallow 边界，并对照三份失败 job 日志逐条核对过。选择对象库重置是因为它是**超集**——它既清除了其中一方归因的边界状态，也清除了另一方实测到的对象库状态——并且它是唯一有实测支撑的重置方式。此处新增的诊断正是为了让下一次出现来判定这一点，而不是让它停留在推断状态，这也是 #13951 triage 所要求的。

## 评审者验证方案

### 如何验证

`ci.yml` 与三个 `sdk-java*` workflow 可被仓库自身的 `yaml` 包正常解析，全部十二份 sweep 正文哈希一致（`len=5719`，`sha256=ab52f5746ee4`），抽取出的 `run:` 块通过 `bash -n`，四个文件均通过 `prettier --check`。`.github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh` 退出码为 0。

该重置自身的行为由 `scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js` 中新增的四个用例覆盖，它们在 runner 的 `bash -eo pipefail` 下、针对 fixture 工作区执行抽取出的 sweep 正文：带 `.git/shallow` + `.git/commondir` 的工作区（对象库被删除，notice 报告 `shallow-boundaries=1 unresolved-locally=1 commondir=yes`，并有一条 warning 指名无法解析的 oid）、没有 `.git` 的工作区（空操作、无注解）、`rm`/`sudo` 都失败的工作区（对象库保留，步骤仍以 0 退出并给出 warning），以及设计记录的指针/锚点契约。以下对每一个都做了变异探测。

### 证据（改动前后）

本次改动仅涉及 CI，没有面向用户的可截图内容；可观测证据是 workflow 测试输出、变异探测与体积门禁。

```
$ npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts \
    scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js \
    scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js \
    scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js
  Test Files  3 passed (3)
       Tests  267 passed | 35 skipped (302)

$ npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts \
    scripts/tests/capture-tmux-ci.test.js scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js \
    scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js scripts/tests/no-ak-integration-ci.test.js \
    scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js
  Test Files  5 passed (5)
       Tests  132 passed | 5 skipped (137)

$ bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh ; echo "exit=$?"
✅ every workflow file is under the 470000-byte gate and within 4096 bytes of its recorded baseline
exit=0

$ npx prettier --check .github/workflows/{ci,sdk-java,sdk-java-flyway-open-prs,sdk-java-contract-open-prs}.yml
All matched files use Prettier code style!
```

上述八个套件是本平台上会运行、且会读取 `ci.yml` 的**全部** `scripts/tests/*` 文件；另外四个同样读取 `ci.yml` 的 `qwen-*-workflow.test.js` 套件被套件配置在 Windows 上排除，因此改为人工阅读——四者引用的都是另一个步骤（`Clean stale agent state`、`Clean stale review worktrees`），没有任何一个钉住 sweep 正文。

变异探测——每个都回退一项性质，并确认拥有该性质的测试变红：

```
变异                                                  期望    实测
A. 从某一个「非首份」ci.yml 副本中删除该块            红      红    （job "integration_cli" sweep drifted from the first copy）
   sdk-java 套件（钉住 ci.yml 的首份副本）            绿      绿
B. 从「首份」ci.yml 副本中删除该块                    红      红    （job "test" sweep drifted from the first copy）
   sdk-java 套件（其参照取自首份副本）                红      红
C. 删除 rm 的兜底链                                   红      红    （在 errexit 下步骤因 unlink 失败而终止）
D. 删除整个对象库删除动作                             红      红    （对象库保留）
```

变异 A 正是评审所要求的那个：十二份副本的同步不是装饰——任何一份漂移都会让 `job "<id>" sweep drifted from the first copy` 变红，而 B 说明了为什么 `sdk-java*` 的副本必须在同一个 commit 中一起移动。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

在 Windows 上使用 Node 22.22.2 + Git Bash 运行 workflow 套件、变异探测与 shell fixture。这是一项 CI workflow 改动，没有本地 OS 面——该块是 POSIX shell，行为与 OS 无关——但 macOS/Linux 两行标记为 ⚠️ 而非 ✅，因为此环境中没有任何东西在那些主机上执行，而且该事故本身需要复用的自托管资源池。完整的 `npm run test:scripts` 在本环境中无法跑完：其 `globalSetup` 通过 `shell: true` 启动 `cmd.exe`，在任何测试被收集之前就会间歇性地以 `EBUSY` 失败；而在并行负载下，无关套件的 `spawnSync` 会返回 `null`（`workflow-size.test.js` 单独运行通过，在全量运行中却以 `git init: expected null to be 0` 失败）。因此上述八个套件是分批运行的，这里报告的是该信号。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：池上每个 job 现在都要以 depth-1 重新 clone，而不是复用继承来的对象库，因此该重置用「每个 job 一次 depth-1 clone」换取「checkout 三次以相同方式失败并跳过后续所有步骤」。评审实测的另一条路——只重置边界——会把可复现的状态留在原地。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：机制**未被证明**。失败状态与失败本身都没有在本地复现；无法接触到持有真实陈旧对象库的复用 ECS 工作区。诊断输出是替代品，而不是复现。#13951 的 triage 点名了四条需要覆盖的 lane（`test`、`integration_no_ak`、`integration_cli`、`lint`）；本改动覆盖了全部四条，但在用新诊断捕获到一次复现、或在真实出现中确认该机制之前，该跟踪 issue 应保持开启。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。托管 runner 不受影响——全新 runner 在 `Checkout` 之前没有 `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git`，因此守卫块会被跳过。`ci.yml` 与 `sdk-java.yml` 超出其 `.size-baseline` 记录值超过 4096 字节的允许量（分别为 11496 与 8552 字节）；两个条目都已在本 PR 中更新，这正是该棘轮所要求的。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13951

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): hand back the Workspace mount when a tool turn goes recovery blocked
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a narrow broker-internal mount-release, `POST /tool-sessions/{runtimeSessionId}:release-mount`, which frees only the Workspace execution mount a managed Workspace Session holds — the row in `managed_workspace_execution_lease` keyed by `(tenantId, storageId)` — without touching the Runtime Session: its READY identity, its renewals and the recovery fleet's ability to re-adopt it are all preserved, so the RELEASED-forever verdict a full release would mint never runs. The service answers `runtime_session_busy` whenever the Session still has something unproven — any unsettled execution (background processes included; the drain's exclusion exists only beside its stop-or-settle sweep and this path runs no sweep), an in-flight control, or a settled execution whose publication delivery is still open (`deliveryStatus: pending` or `blocked` — the family the operator-recovery protocol asserts) — and `runtime_reconciliation_required` when the Session is not resident in this Broker (dead-Daemon residue belongs to the LOST family's existing sweep). On the Daemon side, the recovery-blocked transition in `executeHostedTurn` now hands the turn's mount back through this endpoint: the plain lane mirrors `finish()`'s release discipline (Hook lane shared acquisition and MCP lane session-scoped mount keep their own), the handback also runs when the acquire answer was lost after the grant (the store's holder-conditioned clear is a no-op when nothing was granted), and a busy refusal retries on a bounded cadence so the mount is freed once those executions settle — the fleet's freeze stays honest when they never do. Adds `docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md` and its synchronized Chinese version.

## Why it's needed

[#13800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13800): one `recovery_blocked` Session wedged every later tool turn of other Sessions on the same daemon — journal frozen after `hostedModelAttempt`, model never called again, no error, no terminal event. The mechanism (isolated with runtime witnesses and recorded in the issue): a turn that goes recovery-blocked never runs `finish()`, so it never releases its Workspace execution mount; every later turn on the same `(tenantId, storageId)` then spins on `409 workspace_busy` forever (~0.3 s cadence, 207 consecutive observed on the wire). Deleting only that lease row live-unwedged a parked turn in under a second while the blocked Session stayed blocked — the coupling is exactly the leaked lease. A recovery block is a legitimate outcome of the block-and-never-replay contract, so the wedge would keep re-entering through every path that produces one, not just the A1 reproducer. Per the issue's W2, a blocked Session must not stop unrelated Sessions: with this PR the blocked turn's mount goes back at the block transition, and the blocked Session itself keeps reporting its own blocked state accurately.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Behavioral change lives at the broker-internal mount-release endpoint plus the daemon's block transition; the witnesses to focus on:

- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` — turn-level witnesses: handback calls `releaseMount` exactly once and never `release`; a failed handback logs and still lets the block verdict through, retries exactly twice for a busy refusal, gives up after that without spinning; a busy-then-settling mount is handed back on the retry; an acquire whose reply was lost after the grant still runs the handback; Hook/MCP lanes hand nothing back; a non-busy failure is one logged attempt, never a retry.
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` — route witness: a prompt-driven tool turn that goes recovery-blocked through each of the Tool/MCP/Hook error families releases the mount exactly once, never sees the full release, and still reports `recoveryBlocked`.
- `RuntimeBrokerServiceTest` — service witnesses: resident mount release keeps READY with zero full releases; crossed Harness → `runtime_session_conflict`; non-resident → `runtime_reconciliation_required`; unsettled execution / in-flight control / settled execution with a still-running background process → each `runtime_session_busy`; a transport without Workspace ownership → 501 `workspace_mount_release_unsupported`.
- `HostedWorkspaceConcurrencyIT#mountReleaseFreesHeldStorageAndKeepsTheSessionReady` — real broker + real worker + real DB: rival acquire answers 409 `workspace_busy` while held; the narrow release refuses `runtime_session_busy` behind an unsettled execution and succeeds once it settles; the mount row's holder columns clear; the Runtime Session stays `READY`; the rival acquires immediately; the holder's own later full release completes through the absent-holder path.
- Full-stack rig (the issue's own reproducer, `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`): pre-fix build wedges 3/3 with a 207-streak of `workspace_busy`; the fixed build settles the fresh turn on its first acquire attempt in ~2.6 s with the blocker still reporting blocked (`workspace_busy` count 0); removing only the `await toolTurn?.releaseForRecoveryBlock();` line brings the wedge back with the pre-fix journal fingerprint; restoring it goes green again.

Expected vs observed: before — fresh tool turn on the same storage parks unbounded with no error and no terminal event; after — it completes on the first acquire attempt while the blocked Session's verdict is unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible/TUI change; wire-level before/after summarized above, full logs in `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ (CI lanes; local rig ran the same wire shape on macOS arm64) |

### Environment (optional)

Local rig: throwaway MariaDB (temp datadir) → in-process Spring `managed-agent-server` + embedded runtime broker → packaged `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` daemon → real `managed-runtime-worker` processes; fake OpenAI shim is the only stand-in. Also `npm run build && npm run bundle`, `npm run typecheck`, eslint/prettier, checkstyle all green.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a later full release of a mount-free Session takes the transport's existing absent-holder shortcut, so its worker-side detach is deferred to binding teardown (bounded by worker lifetime; the row still settles RELEASED honestly) — documented in code and the design doc. The busy gate reads broker-registered state as of the check and does not fence a concurrent out-of-contract admission landing one instant later (every in-contract caller — the blocked Daemon — cannot be issuing operations at that point); an additive internal endpoint under the unchanged `protocolVersion: 1`.
- Not validated / out of scope: A1 itself ([#13533](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13533), whose start-path fix ([#13789](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13789)) has landed in this branch's base); the Hook lane's shared acquisition and MCP lane's session-scoped mount (their own disciplines); daemon-death residue (LOST family sweep, [#12670](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12670) family); `monitor_run` / `child_run` `shell` kinds stay gated per the issue; the concurrent-admission atomicity hardening noted above is a recorded follow-up, not bundled here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; new optional endpoint on the broker-internal API. Design documents: [English](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md) and [中文](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.zh-CN.md), synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13800
Related: #13533 (A1, the reproducer path), #13789 (the A1 fix, landed in this branch's base), #12670, #13184 (same "one unsettled row has consequences elsewhere" family).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增一个窄化的 broker 内部挂载释放端点 `POST /tool-sessions/{runtimeSessionId}:release-mount`，只释放受管 Workspace Session 持有的 Workspace 执行挂载——`managed_workspace_execution_lease` 中按 `(tenantId, storageId)` 主键的那一行——而不触碰 Runtime Session：其 READY 身份、续期与恢复舰队重新收养的能力全部保留，完整释放会铸造的 RELEASED-forever 判定绝不运行。当该 Session 仍有未证实事项——任何未结算执行（背景进程也算；drain 的排除集只因它有先停掉或结算的 sweep 才存在，本路径不跑 sweep）、在飞 control，或已结算但 publication 交付未关闭的执行（`deliveryStatus: pending` 或 `blocked`——正是 operator-recovery 协议所断言的家族）——服务端应答 `runtime_session_busy`；Session 不驻留在本 Broker 时应答 `runtime_reconciliation_required`（死亡 Daemon 的残留归 LOST 族既有清扫）。Daemon 侧，`executeHostedTurn` 的 recovery-blocked 转移现在通过该端点归还轮次的挂载：plain lane 镜像 `finish()` 的释放纪律（Hook lane 共享 acquisition 与 MCP lane 会话级挂载保有自己的纪律），acquire 应答在授予后丢失时归还同样执行（存储按持有者条件的清除在未授予时是 no-op），busy 拒绝按有界节奏重试——等到那些执行结算后即释放；永不结算则舰队冻结语义诚实保留。新增 `docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md` 及其同步的中文版本。

## 为什么需要

[#13800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13800)：一个 `recovery_blocked` 会话楔死同一 daemon 上其他会话的全部后续工具轮——journal 冻结在 `hostedModelAttempt` 之后，模型再未被调用，无错误、无终态事件。机制（已用运行时见证隔离并记录在 issue 中）：进入 recovery-blocked 的轮次永远不再执行 `finish()`，因此永不归还其 Workspace 执行挂载；同一 `(tenantId, storageId)` 上的每个后续轮次随之在 `409 workspace_busy` 上无限空转（~0.3 s 节奏，线上观测到连续 207 次）。仅删该租约行即在 1 秒内让已停摆的轮次恢复，而被阻塞会话仍保持阻塞——耦合恰好是这条泄漏租约。recovery block 是「阻塞、绝不重放」契约的合法结局，所以只要还有任何产生它的路径，楔死就会一再重现，而不只来自 A1 复现器。按 issue 的 W2：被阻塞会话绝不能阻止无关会话——本 PR 让被阻塞轮次在阻塞转移点归还挂载，被阻塞会话自身仍准确上报其 blocked 状态。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

行为变化位于 broker 内部挂载释放端点 + daemon 阻塞转移；重点见证：

- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`——轮次级见证：归还恰好调用一次 `releaseMount`、绝不调用 `release`；归还失败只记日志且阻塞判定照常送达，busy 拒绝恰好再重试两次后停手；busy 后结算的挂载在重试中归还；acquire 应答在授予后丢失时归还仍执行；Hook/MCP lane 不归还任何东西；非 busy 失败只做一次记录尝试、绝不重试。
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`——路由见证：prompt 驱动的工具轮分别经 Tool/MCP/Hook 错误族阻塞时恰好释放挂载一次，绝不触发完整释放，且仍上报 `recoveryBlocked`。
- `RuntimeBrokerServiceTest`——服务见证：驻留挂载释放保持 READY 且完整释放计数为零；跨 Harness → `runtime_session_conflict`；非驻留 → `runtime_reconciliation_required`；未结算执行 / 在飞 control / 主执行已结算但背景进程仍在跑 → 各自 `runtime_session_busy`；非 Workspace 持有的 transport → 501 `workspace_mount_release_unsupported`。
- `HostedWorkspaceConcurrencyIT#mountReleaseFreesHeldStorageAndKeepsTheSessionReady`——真实 broker + 真实 worker + 真实 DB：占用期间竞争 acquire 应答 409 `workspace_busy`；有未结算执行时窄释放拒绝 `runtime_session_busy`、结算后成功；挂载行持有者列清空；Runtime Session 保持 `READY`；竞争方立即获租；持有者随后的完整释放经无持有者路径完成。
- 全栈 rig（issue 自己的复现器，`.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`）：修复前构建 3/3 楔死、`workspace_busy` 连续 207 次；修复构建下全本轮次首次 acquire 即获租、~2.6 秒结算，被阻塞会话照常上报 blocked（`workspace_busy` 为 0）；只删 `await toolTurn?.releaseForRecoveryBlock();` 一行楔死按修复前 journal 指纹回归；恢复后再绿。

预期 vs 实际：修复前——同 storage 的全新工具轮无错误无终态地永久停摆；修复后——首次 acquire 即完成，被阻塞会话判定不变。

### 证据（修复前后）

N/A（无用户可见/TUI 变化；线上前后对比见上文，完整日志在 `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`。）

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️（CI 车道；本地 rig 在 macOS arm64 上跑同一线路形态） |

### 环境（可选）

本地 rig：临时 MariaDB（临时 datadir）→ 进程内 Spring `managed-agent-server` + 内嵌 runtime broker → 打包的 `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` daemon → 真实 `managed-runtime-worker` 进程；唯一替身是假 OpenAI 端点。另有 `npm run build && npm run bundle`、`npm run typecheck`、eslint/prettier、checkstyle 全绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无挂载的会话之后的完整释放会走传输层现有的无持有者捷径，因此其 worker 侧 detach 推迟到 binding 拆除（以 worker 生命周期为界；行仍诚实地落 RELEASED）——已在代码与设计文档中注明。busy 门禁读取的是检查时刻 broker 已登记状态，不为晚一瞬到达的违约并发准入设防（任何守约调用方——被阻塞的 Daemon——此刻都不可能在发号施令）；内部端点为增量，`protocolVersion: 1` 不变。
- 未验证/范围外：A1 本身（[#13533](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13533)，其启动路径修复 [#13789](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13789) 已合入本分支基线）；Hook lane 的共享 acquisition 与 MCP lane 的会话级挂载（各自纪律）；daemon 死亡残留（LOST 族清扫，[#12670](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12670) 族）；`monitor_run` / `child_run` `shell` kind 按 issue 保持门禁；上述并发准入原子性硬化为记录在案的后续事项，不并入本 PR。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；broker 内部 API 新增可选端点。设计文档：[English](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md) 与 [中文](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.zh-CN.md)，已同步。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13800
相关：#13533（A1，复现路径）、#13789（A1 修复，已合入本分支基线）、#12670、#13184（同属「一行未结算记录在别处产生后果」族）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): restart-proof the held-Runtime drain obligation (#13930)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores the close's held-Runtime drain obligation across a Harness restart or takeover. A turn-held Runtime (a live background Shell or Monitor) is tracked only in a process-local set on the Harness; after a restart the reloaded Session held an empty set, so its close answered 204 while the run kept its Runtime. This change adds a read-only Broker inventory of a Harness Session's live hold rows — a new `POST /tool-sessions:active-holds` route backed by a paged repository query over the durable execution ledger, with the in-memory and JDBC implementations pinned by one shared contract — and the Harness seeds its held set from that answer at Session load: restore-only, never discharged at load, and a failed query logs and loads without the obligation rather than failing the load. The close's drain arm is unchanged; the Broker's answer already arrives in the idempotent Runtime Session id form the drain maps over. A composite index on the execution ledger's harness column keeps the per-load read bounded on a long-lived Broker, and the schema upgrade lands in all three DDL paths (fresh schema, the embedded upgrader, and a new Flyway migration), pinned by a contract assertion.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13930's R1-2: the merged H3 enablement (#13856) deliberately left this hole and it was called out at merge time. Without this change, a restarted Harness's close reports success over a background run that is still alive; the Runtime and its workspace mount stay pinned — silently, nothing records the strand — until the workspace-level drain cascade runs, possibly much later.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

prs.title: fix(cli): hold pre-runtime /acp WebSocket upgrades instead of falling through to a 406 (#13995)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A fast-path `qwen serve` boot (any invocation without `--open`) listens with a deferred runtime: the HTTP server accepts connections before the runtime app — and therefore the ACP WebSocket transport — exists, and the `upgrade` listener is only registered once the deferred runtime finishes. An `/acp` WebSocket upgrade that arrives in that boot window finds no `upgrade` listener, so Node routes it to Express as a plain GET; the delegating app holds it until the runtime is ready and then forwards it to the SSE `GET /acp` handler, which answers a misleading `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`. The first WebSocket connection to a freshly booted daemon therefore always failed.

This PR installs a pre-listen `upgrade` guard on the primary server. While the ACP transport is not yet attached, the guard holds the upgrade — mirroring the hold the delegating app already gives REST requests during the same window — lets it trigger the deferred runtime start (the same start-on-request behavior a REST request gets), and replays queued upgrades once the transport attaches. Replayed upgrades go through the real listener, so authentication, origin checks, and path routing are unchanged. Once no transport can still arrive (runtime settled without one, startup failed, or the daemon is shutting down), the gate closes and late upgrades get a retryable `503` with `Retry-After: 1`, matching the not-ready postures elsewhere on this surface.

## Why it's needed

Main CI run 38267397252 (commit `14cc19b4bdc8`) failed the `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` shard on `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` and `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot` (#13995). The client-MCP failure reproduces deterministically outside CI: with vitest retries disabled it failed 8/8 with `Unexpected server response: 406`, because the test connects to `/acp` immediately after the daemon prints `listening on`. Vitest's `retry: 2` usually masked the window (a retry lands after the transport attaches), until a loaded docker-leg shard widened it past the retry spacing. Beyond the tests, any real client that opens a socket right after daemon boot — desktop app, web shell, SDK — hit the same bogus 406 instead of simply connecting.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` — the full serve suite passes (501 tests), including the two new witnesses: an `/acp` upgrade arriving in the deferred boot window is held and completes with wire status `101` (and itself forces the deferred runtime up), and a failed runtime start answers a held upgrade with a retryable `503`.
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` — with retries disabled, both previously failing suites pass; before this change the discovery test failed every first attempt with `Unexpected server response: 406`.
3. Sanity-check the window by hand: `node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t` and immediately open a WebSocket to `/acp` — the socket connects after the brief runtime start instead of erroring with 406.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon transport change; no UI). Wire-level behavior for a boot-window `/acp` upgrade: before — `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`; after — `101 Switching Protocols` once the runtime attaches, or a retryable `503` if the runtime can no longer start.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux container; E2E run with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` (Docker unavailable here, so the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg was not reproducible locally and remains the CI-side gate).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guard holds early upgrades until the deferred runtime attaches, so a client that connects during the boot window sees a short connect delay (bounded by the runtime startup timeout) instead of an immediate error — this matches the existing REST behavior during the same window.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg (no Docker in the authoring environment); the channel-workers test did not reproduce locally, but its flow is REST-first and the fix removes the boot-window WS failure class for every path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A boot-window `/acp` upgrade that previously failed with 406 now upgrades (101) once the runtime attaches, or receives `503` + `Retry-After` if the runtime cannot start.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13995

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

fast-path `qwen serve` 启动(任何不带 `--open` 的调用)会推迟运行时的构建:HTTP server 在 runtime app —— 也就是 ACP WebSocket 传输层 —— 存在之前就开始接受连接,`upgrade` 监听器直到被推迟的 runtime 完成时才注册。在这个启动窗口内到达的 `/acp` WebSocket upgrade 找不到 `upgrade` 监听器,于是 Node 把它当作普通 GET 交给 Express;delegating app 会把这个 GET 挂起直到 runtime 就绪,再转发给 SSE 的 `GET /acp` 处理器,后者返回误导性的 `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`。因此,新建的 daemon 上的第一个 WebSocket 连接总是失败。

本 PR 在主 server 上、listen 之前安装了一个 `upgrade` 守卫。在 ACP 传输层注册之前,守卫会挂起 upgrade —— 与 delegating app 在同一窗口期对 REST 请求的挂起行为一致 —— 并让它触发被推迟的 runtime 启动(与 REST 请求获得的按需启动行为一致),然后在传输层注册后重放队列中的 upgrade。重放的 upgrade 会经过真正的监听器,因此认证、Origin 检查和路径路由完全不变。一旦不可能再有传输层到来(runtime 已就绪但未注册、启动失败、或 daemon 正在关闭),门闩关闭,后来的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503` 并带 `Retry-After: 1`,与该接口其他未就绪场景的处理姿态一致。

## 为什么需要

Main CI 运行 38267397252(提交 `14cc19b4bdc8`)在 `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` 分片上失败,涉及 `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` 和 `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot`(#13995)。client-MCP 的失败在 CI 之外可以确定性复现:禁用 vitest 重试时 8 次运行 8 次失败,报错 `Unexpected server response: 406`,因为该测试在 daemon 打印 `listening on` 后立即连接 `/acp`。Vitest 的 `retry: 2` 通常掩盖了这个窗口(重试到来时传输层已注册),直到某个高负载的 docker 分片把窗口拉得比重试间隔还长。除测试外,任何在 daemon 启动后立即建立连接的真实客户端 —— 桌面应用、web shell、SDK —— 都会遇到同样的错误 406,而不是正常连接。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` —— 整个 serve 套件通过(501 个测试),包括两个新见证测试:在 deferred 启动窗口期到达的 `/acp` upgrade 会被挂起并以 `101` 完成升级(且该 upgrade 本身会触发 deferred runtime 启动);runtime 启动失败时,被挂起的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503`。
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` —— 禁用重试时,两个此前失败的套件都能通过;修复前,discovery 测试的首次尝试每次都因 `Unexpected server response: 406` 失败。
3. 手工验证窗口行为:`node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t`,然后立即建立到 `/acp` 的 WebSocket —— 连接会在短暂的 runtime 启动后成功,而不是报 406。

### 前后对比证据

N/A(daemon 传输层变更,无 UI)。启动窗口内 `/acp` upgrade 的线上行为:修复前 —— `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`;修复后 —— runtime 注册后 `101 Switching Protocols`,若 runtime 无法启动则可重试的 `503`。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

本地 Linux 容器;E2E 以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 运行(本环境无 Docker,无法在本地复现与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支,该分支仍由 CI 把关)。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:守卫会把早期 upgrade 挂起到 deferred runtime 注册为止,因此在启动窗口内连接的客户端会看到短暂的连接延迟(上限为 runtime 启动超时),而不是立即报错 —— 这与同一窗口期内 REST 请求的既有行为一致。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内:与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支(编写环境无 Docker);channel-workers 测试未在本地复现,但其流程以 REST 为先,且本次修复为所有路径消除了启动窗口期的 WS 失败类别。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。此前在启动窗口内到达的 `/acp` upgrade 会以 406 失败,现在会在 runtime 注册后完成升级(101),或在 runtime 无法启动时收到 `503` + `Retry-After`。

Fixes #13995

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
