## Linked Issues

Closes #13803

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Issue #13803(Managed Agent 提案 #12380 的 H 阶段)交付了 managed workflow child 运行时——H4c 设计明确延后的「Workflow runtime」后续。managed Session 现在可以通过一个镜像 Agent 工具准入的新 Workflow 工具声明来启动 `workflow` child:内联确定性 workflow 源码、有界结构化 args、前台或后台。控制面的 child result relay 发现待处理的 launch 后,在重试下恰好创建一个 child Session,绑定到父 Session 的精确 Workspace,lineage 在同一事务里固化;child 的第一个 Turn 在进程内确定性地执行 workflow(node:vm 沙箱,agent() 分发到进程内 AgentHeadless 子代理,受普通每-run 上限约束——不是嵌套 managed 孙代),其结算结果经 relay、acceptance、consumption 流水线原样回流。关闭父 Session 会通过与 child agent 相同的 funnel 取消其未终态的 workflow children。每个 launch 从 revision 1 起 pin 住定义——脚本字节的 sha256——child 在执行前重验 digest,被篡改的拷贝永远不可能运行。

本切片在 managed 面之外需要一处改动:workflow launch 块是第一个携带分数 `args` 穿越 daemon 的 `sha256(JSON.stringify(prompt))` 准入 digest 的 prompt,而 SDK 的 fastjson2 基底把分数渲染成 Java 科学计数形式、ECMAScript 却用普通记法——任何分数 arg 都会让 child 的第一个 Turn 被确定性地以 `invalid_hosted_prompt` 拒绝。SDK 的 JSON digest 基底现在与 `JSON.stringify` 字节级一致,由 Node 派生的金色向量钉住。

无 Flyway 迁移、无 OpenAPI 或契约变更、无 legacy Workflow 工具行为变化(managed 准入是独立声明,仅内联源码;saved/引用 workflow、脚本级 resume、嵌套 managed 孙代均明确延后)。

## 为什么需要

`managed-child_run` 的 kind 门禁在每一条 revision 提交时生效,所以 issue 的四个出口检查只能一起落地:放宽 relay/cascade 查询(K2)而不放开门禁(K4),会让 relay 的每个动词打在 workflow 行上都得到 409;只放开门禁而不放宽查询,则会让 workflow run 对创建、结算、取消它的整套机制不可见——正是 issue 所禁止的隔离失败。本切片落地后,managed 的 Agent 与 Workflow 工具共享完整的 child Session 流水线,Workflow 工具不再只存在于 managed 运行时之外。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

单元与集成:改动触及的所有套件全绿——core `managed-runtime` 五个改动文件的套件 290/290(全套件除一个 main 上同样失败的既有定时器 flake 外全绿);CLI serve 套件含新增 funnel/见证文件(六个 workflow 相关文件 420/420;`hosted-harness-session` 全量 344 测试绿);`managed-agent-server` surefire 五个触及类的 71 个测试全绿(模块唯一失败是一个 main 上同样失败的、依赖主机环境的 worktree-git 测试);`qwencode` 套件绿,含新增的 digest 金色向量测试。一次按 #13532 形状的物理验收在真实宿主上驱动了打包栈(managed-agent-server + MariaDB + 打包的 daemon):前台 workflow launch 端到端完成且重试下恰好一个 child Session;后台 launch 送达并消费了通知;被篡改 pin 的 Turn 以 `Workflow launch pin does not match its script` 拒绝执行;打包构建放行 workflow 提交而基线构建拒绝同样的提交。关闭父取消 workflow child 记为受阻并注明原因(本 macOS 宿主不具备 workspace close 能力——能力拒绝,已在最终代码树上复验);中断重认领行为部分观测,边界发现已立为 issue #13838。带命令与输出的完整行为表见后续评论。

按项目惯例的变异纪律:每个新增守卫都单独禁用并确认其具名见证变红(digest 编码器、kind 门禁、路由门禁、wake 与 close-drain 谓词、批量排除、键派生)。

### 前后证据

N/A(无用户可见界面;managed workflow 工具只在私有 Hosted profile 上声明——生产启用是独立门禁的后续)

### 测试平台

macOS ✅(Windows 与 Linux 本机未执行;按 #13532 为 H3 记录的惯例,Linux 重跑归入生产启用切片)

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:managed Workflow 工具 v1 只准入内联脚本源码——saved workflow、`scriptPath`、`resumeFromRunId`、`sourceRef` 以指名后续范围的拒绝而不执行,保证 launch pin 的诚实(digest 绑定实际运行的字节)。脚本的 `agent()` 调用在 workflow child 内部进程内运行,受普通上限约束,不构成 managed 孙代 Session。
- 未验证/范围外:关闭父取消 workflow child 受本 macOS 宿主能力拒绝所阻(已如实记录受阻原因,Linux 重跑归入生产启用切片);relay 的中断重认领路径会正确结算 run 一次,但重启 connector 的 load 重绑在非 durable 宿主 profile 下回 409(已立为 issue #13838);Windows 未执行。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:无——无 schema 迁移、无公开契约变更;生产 AgentBundle 启用不属本切片。

设计文档(英文与中文,完整同步):[2026-10-10-managed-workflow-child-runtime.md](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-workflow-child-runtime.md) · [2026-10-10-managed-workflow-child-runtime.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-workflow-child-runtime.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13803

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): recover reused runner checkouts and Java lock waits
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Make ordinary Linux CI, SDK Java, Autofix, and Triage start their self-hosted checkouts with fresh runner-local Git metadata. The cleanup runs immediately before checkout, removes only the workspace's `.git` entry, and keeps existing ownership/config sanitation and checkout refs. Hosted runners skip it. The protected Triage workflow reads main, so its current checkout failure can only receive this change after merge.

Give the SDK Java matrix the same 40-minute host-lock wait as the MariaDB lane and a 60-minute job ceiling, leaving time for setup and Maven after contention. The lock path and serialization remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Main [SDK Java run 38324495714](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38324495714) failed at checkout in three jobs with unresolved pack deltas. [Autofix run 38330224160](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38330224160/job/115080267078) hit the same failure on all three fetch attempts, before its trusted tooling could be staged. Starting with fresh metadata removes inherited shallow boundaries and object state from those fetches; the exact source of the runner's damaged/inconsistent state has not been established.

Separately, [run 38276278195](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38276278195/job/114902415218) exhausted the matrix's 20-minute lock wait. The preceding repair raised only the MariaDB lane's budget. This closes the missed matrix path. PR #14012 handles the publication-test failure from the latest SDK Java run. The first checks on #14012 reproduced the same checkout failure in ordinary CI lint and integration jobs. PR #13961 proposes a narrower stale-shallow reset for one integration lane; this PR recreates the repository metadata across the affected ordinary Linux CI, SDK Java, Autofix, and Triage entry points.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a reused self-hosted runner, confirm checkout initializes fresh Git metadata and still checks out the intended head/merge/trusted-base ref. Confirm hosted jobs skip cleanup, and contended Java matrix work can wait 40 minutes without the 30-minute job ceiling cutting it off.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: repeated `unresolved deltas` / `invalid index-pack output` during checkout, plus a matrix lock timeout exactly 1,200 seconds after acquisition began. After: 45 existing SDK Java workflow tests, 39 platform-lane tests, 18 Hosted process CI tests, fourteen executable checkout-recovery cases, and five selected Autofix checkout/config guards passed (121 distinct tests). The recovery cases exercise a broken shallow boundary, fresh Git initialization, `.git` symlink handling, retained dependency cache, and repeated cleanup. They are controlled local evidence, not reproduction of the original ECS pack error.

Changed workflow shell blocks passed `bash -n`; YAML parsing, targeted ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` passed. The local workflow-size script could not run because it requires Bash 4 and this host has Bash 3.2. A light local correctness/security review found no remaining issue.

UI verification: N/A; only CI checkout preparation and timing budgets change. Production CLI/TUI/Web UI behavior is unchanged.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

macOS ARM64, Node.js/Vitest, Git, Bash; existing dependency tools were copied into the isolated worktree without sharing workspace-package links.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: self-hosted jobs refetch Git objects, adding network work; a stuck Java matrix job can now run for up to 60 minutes.
- Not validated / out of scope: real ECS pack recovery, live lock contention, and the local Bash-4 workflow-size check. GitHub CI remains the real-runner check. Other workflows and the separate publication fixture repair are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Cleanup is anchored to the job-owned workspace entry and does not follow a `.git` symlink to an external repository.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14007. Related: #14010 and #13951. The publication test portion of #14010 is addressed by #14012.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让普通 Linux CI、SDK Java、Autofix 和 Triage 的自托管 checkout 使用新的 runner 本地 Git 元数据。清理步骤紧邻 checkout 之前，只删除 workspace 内的 `.git` 入口，保留已有的权限恢复、配置清理和 checkout ref。托管 runner 跳过该步骤。受保护的 Triage workflow 使用 main，因此当前的 checkout 失败需要在合入后才会使用本次修复。

把 SDK Java 矩阵的主机锁等待提高到与 MariaDB lane 相同的 40 分钟，总超时提高到 60 分钟，为争用后的初始化和 Maven 留出时间。锁路径和串行规则保持不变。

## 为什么需要

main 的 [SDK Java run 38324495714](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38324495714) 有三个 job 在 checkout 时出现 unresolved pack delta。[Autofix run 38330224160](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38330224160/job/115080267078) 的三次 fetch 尝试也全部失败，可信工具尚未完成准备。重新创建元数据可排除 fetch 继承的 shallow 边界和对象状态；runner 状态损坏或不一致的准确来源尚未确定。

另一个 [run 38276278195](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38276278195/job/114902415218) 耗尽了矩阵的 20 分钟锁等待。此前的修复只提高了 MariaDB lane 的预算，本次补齐遗漏的矩阵路径。PR #14012 处理最新 SDK Java 运行中的 publication 测试失败。#14012 的首轮检查在普通 CI 的 lint 和 integration job 中再次出现相同 checkout 失败。PR #13961 提议只为一个 integration lane 重置 stale-shallow 状态；本次在相关普通 Linux CI、SDK Java、Autofix 和 Triage 入口重新创建仓库元数据。

## 评审者验证方案

### 如何验证

在复用的自托管 runner 上，确认 checkout 重新初始化 Git 元数据，仍检出预期的 head、merge 或 trusted-base ref。确认托管 job 跳过清理，争用中的 Java 矩阵可以等待 40 分钟，且不会被原来的 30 分钟总超时提前终止。

### 改动前后证据

改动前：checkout 反复出现 `unresolved deltas` 和 `invalid index-pack output`，矩阵获取锁恰好等待 1,200 秒后超时。改动后：45 个现有 SDK Java workflow 测试、39 个平台 lane 测试、18 个 Hosted process CI 测试、14 个可执行 checkout 恢复用例、五个选定的 Autofix checkout/config 守卫测试全部通过，共 121 个不同用例。恢复用例验证损坏的 shallow 边界、重新初始化 Git、`.git` 符号链接处理、保留依赖缓存及重复清理。这是本地受控证据，不是原始 ECS pack 故障的复现。

变更的 workflow shell 块通过 `bash -n`；YAML 解析、定向 ESLint、Prettier 和 `git diff --check` 通过。本地 workflow-size 脚本要求 Bash 4，而主机只有 Bash 3.2，未能运行。一次本地轻量正确性和安全审查没有发现剩余问题。

UI 验证不适用：只改变 CI checkout 准备和时间预算，不改变生产 CLI、TUI 或 Web UI 行为。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### 环境

macOS ARM64、Node.js/Vitest、Git、Bash；现有依赖工具复制到了隔离 worktree，没有共享指向其他 checkout 的 workspace-package 链接。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：自托管 job 重新获取 Git 对象，增加网络开销；卡住的 Java 矩阵 job 现在最多可运行 60 分钟。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实 ECS pack 恢复、实际锁争用，以及要求 Bash 4 的本地 workflow-size 检查。真实 runner 结果依赖 GitHub CI。其他 workflow 和独立的 publication fixture 修复不在本 PR 范围内。
- 破坏性变化或迁移：无。清理只针对 job 自有 workspace 入口，不沿 `.git` 符号链接删除外部仓库。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #14007。关联 #14010 和 #13951；#14010 中的 publication 测试问题由 #14012 处理。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sessions): explain messaging suppression across guidance surfaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Aligns cross-session messaging guidance with the existing `--bare` and `--safe-mode` suppression rules. Both recipient-error paths identify the active mode, with safe mode taking precedence when both flags are set. Updates controller guidance, setting help, its generated editor schema and session documentation.

## Why it's needed

The current setting-only guidance can suggest a remedy that cannot restore messaging in a suppressed session. It also confuses being listed with being messageable: interactive Ink sessions can remain listed without a peer address, while suppressed hosted ACP sessions do not register. This addresses all five remaining surfaces identified in #12866.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Exercise an unknown recipient with disabled peer transport, both without a team and after a team reports the recipient missing. `--safe-mode` and `--bare` must produce the corresponding explanation; enabling both must explain safe mode. Ordinary setting/inbox suppression keeps its previous guidance. The eight regression cases cover these combinations; controller tests also require the flag guidance. The newly built CLI was additionally exercised with isolated controller add/list/remove operations: each exited 0, the emitted guidance included both flags, and the temporary grants were removed. Regenerate the settings schema and confirm it matches the committed artifact.

- On the latest source baseline: eight isolated diagnostic regression cases passed, with mocked peer transport. The earlier built CLI also completed isolated controller add/list/remove operations with the expected flag guidance; no real peer socket or message was used.
- On the combined verification checkout at `23add5e`, frozen dependency installation, formatting, lint, build and typecheck completed successfully. These were not three independent full-preflight runs.
- **Full preflight did not pass on Windows.** The ACP suite reported 2,624 passed, 14 failed and eight skipped; its 14 failures occurred creating symlink fixtures (`EPERM`). CLI tests also reported failures, including relaunch expectations and file-lock cleanup; the recorded workspace run did not finish all suites. Separate script tests reported 1,805 passed, 26 failed and 202 skipped, including symlink restrictions, missing Git metadata/skill assets in the temporary validation copy, and shell fixture failures. Not all failures have been reproduced on clean upstream or classified; no all-tests-pass claim is made.
- The publication base is `e17ad4c`. Its three intervening commits do not overlap any files in these PRs. Candidate file contents were checked against the verification copy, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent source review found no remaining issue after corrections. The Qwen-specific CLI `/review` orchestration was not run.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, the safe-mode and bare-mode reproduction cases failed because the actual returned explanation was `agents.crossSessionMessaging is off, or its inbox did not start`. After, both returned explanations name the suppressing flag. This is a diagnostic-text and documentation change; N/A for a graphical demo. Unit reproduction uses mocked peer transport, not a real socket or hosted session.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Tested: Node 22.23.2 |
| Linux | Not tested |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: inaccurate guidance; tested both error branches and mode precedence against the existing suppression policy.
- Not validated: real CLI/IPC/hosted reachability. The global `qwen` command is unavailable locally. Child environment inheritance is outside this issue's wording sweep.
- Breaking changes: none; no registration, routing or admission policy changes.
- AI disclosure: Codex assisted with analysis, implementation, tests, review and this description. No personal human code-review confirmation is asserted.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12866

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

使跨会话消息说明与已有 `--bare`、`--safe-mode` 抑制规则一致。两个收件人错误路径均说明当前模式，两个旗标同时启用时优先说明安全模式。同时更新 controller 指引、设置帮助、生成的编辑器 schema 和会话文档。

## 修改原因

目前只提设置开关的指引可能建议无法恢复受抑制会话消息功能的操作，也混淆了列出会话与可发送消息：交互式 Ink 会话可能仍列出却没有 peer 地址，而受抑制的托管 ACP 会话不注册。本修改覆盖 #12866 列出的五处剩余说明。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

在 peer transport 禁用时尝试未知收件人，分别验证无团队与团队报告找不到收件人的情况。`--safe-mode`、`--bare` 必须返回相应解释；同时启用时应解释安全模式。普通设置关闭或 inbox 未启动时保持原指引。八个回归案例覆盖这些组合；controller 测试也要求包含旗标说明。此外，在隔离设置目录实际执行了新构建 CLI 的 controller add/list/remove：均退出 0，输出包含两个旗标指引，临时授权已删除。重新生成设置 schema 并确认与提交产物一致。

- 最新源代码基线上的八个隔离诊断回归案例通过，使用模拟 peer transport。此前构建的 CLI 在隔离目录中完成 controller 添加/列出/移除，输出包含两种禁用模式；未使用真实 peer socket 或发送消息。
- 在 `23add5e` 的合并验证副本中，冻结依赖安装、格式、lint、构建和类型检查已完成并通过；并非三个独立分支各跑了一次完整 preflight。
- **全量 preflight 未通过。** Windows 的 ACP 测试为 2,624 通过、14 失败、8 跳过；这 14 项均在创建符号链接夹具时遇到 `EPERM`。CLI 测试也报告了重启预期和文件锁清理等失败，记录的工作区测试未完成全部套件。独立脚本测试为 1,805 通过、26 失败、202 跳过，包含符号链接权限、临时验证副本缺少 Git 元数据/skill 文件及 shell 夹具失败。尚未在干净上游复现并归类全部失败，不声称所有测试通过。
- 发布基线为 `e17ad4c`；中间新增的三次提交没有修改本轮 PR 涉及的文件。候选文件内容与验证副本一致，`git diff --check` 通过。
- 修正发现的问题后，独立源代码审阅未发现剩余问题；未执行 Qwen 专用 CLI 的 `/review` 编排。

### 修复前后证据

修复前，安全模式和 bare 模式复现案例因实际返回说明为 `agents.crossSessionMessaging is off, or its inbox did not start` 而失败。修复后均说明具体抑制旗标。本修改涉及诊断文字与文档，图形演示不适用。单元复现模拟 peer transport，并非真实 socket 或托管会话。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 未测试 |
| Windows | 已测试：Node 22.23.2 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：说明不准确；已按现有抑制规则测试两个错误分支及模式优先级。
- 未验证：真实 CLI、IPC 和托管会话可达性。本地没有全局 `qwen` 命令。子进程环境继承不属于此问题的文案范围。
- 破坏性变更：无；不修改注册、路由或消息准入策略。
- AI 使用披露：Codex 协助分析、实现、测试、审阅及撰写说明。不声称本人已完成人工代码审阅。

## 关联问题

修复 #12866。

</details>



## Follow-up verification — 2026-10-13

Addressed R1-1 through R1-8: safe-mode guidance names its environment variable and the setting that may also be off; the unreachable bare-mode tool branch and artificial cases were removed; unknown no-inbox states are described without inventing a disabled setting or a startup failure. The empty agent roster also explains suppressed peer visibility. Controller guidance checks the presence of ipcPath and names OpenTUI. The settings documentation and hosted-session paragraph now match actual registry and child-environment behavior.

Related core tests passed (85), including message routing and agent listing. Changed-file ESLint, Prettier and diff whitespace checks passed. Core TypeScript compilation completed, but the full build did not pass: Browser Use runtime/copy verification resolves playwright-core 1.58.2 instead of the required 1.62.1 in this local dependency setup. Full preflight, release-bundle, real socket and real model checks were not rerun. The previous triage run failed because the model API connection timed out (ETIMEDOUT/ENETUNREACH), rather than because an application test failed; this follow-up does not claim that infrastructure failure is fixed. An independent local source review found no additional finding. Codex assisted with the follow-up; no personal human-read certification is asserted.

### 中文：本轮修订

落实 8 条审阅建议，统一 safe-mode 环境变量、设置可能仍关闭及 inbox 缺失的说明；去掉不可达的 bare 工具分支，补齐 agent 列表、controller 和文档。core 相关测试 85 项通过，修改文件 lint、格式和空白检查通过。完整构建仍受本地 Browser Use 的 playwright-core 版本冲突阻塞；未重跑全套 preflight 或真实服务。此前 triage 是模型 API 网络连接失败，不能称为代码测试失败。

Controller follow-up validation: 21 tests passed using a temporary adapter retaining the official CLI setup and aliases while omitting only the unavailable workspace-dist guard. Five load-time mutations (environment-variable name, possible-setting hedge, ipcPath, list_agents suppression, unknown-inbox fallback) each caused the corresponding new assertion to fail. This adapter is not included in the PR and is not a full CLI preflight run.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): delete attachments from an empty composer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows Backspace and Delete to remove the final file attachment or pasted image when the desktop Web Shell composer has an empty text body and no removable context tag. Existing context-tag order, caret and selection guards are retained. Includes regression coverage and documents the keyboard behavior.

## Why it's needed

An image-only draft currently ignores both keys, forcing the user to click its remove button. This implements the attachment fallback described in the maintainer's root-cause comment on #10794.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Paste an image into an empty desktop Web Shell composer, focus the editor and press Backspace or Delete. Before the fix the image remains; after the fix it is removed. With multiple attachments, each keypress removes only the last file, then images once files are exhausted. With body text, file/image attachments remain. The eight new DOM cases exercise both keys, sequential deletion, body text and mixed file/image attachments.

- On the latest source baseline: 108 DOM tests passed across the new attachment suite and existing composer suite. Actual Edge before/after scenarios also passed for both keys against the mocked daemon (four cases), not a real provider.
- On the combined verification checkout at `23add5e`, frozen dependency installation, formatting, lint, build and typecheck completed successfully. These were not three independent full-preflight runs.
- **Full preflight did not pass on Windows.** The ACP suite reported 2,624 passed, 14 failed and eight skipped; its 14 failures occurred creating symlink fixtures (`EPERM`). prs.title: fix(cli): load TOML custom commands saved with a UTF-8 BOM
prs.body:
## What this PR does

TOML custom commands saved with a UTF-8 BOM now load. The BOM is stripped before the TOML file is parsed, the same way Markdown command files already handle it.

## Why it's needed

Some editors, such as Notepad on Windows, save UTF-8 with a BOM. The TOML parser rejects it, so the command file was skipped with only a debug log and the slash command never appeared. The same command saved as Markdown loaded fine, because the Markdown parser already strips the BOM.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the file command loader tests. The new test saves `bom.toml` with a leading BOM and checks that the `/bom` command is loaded.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the fix, the new test fails because the command is skipped:

```
× FileCommandLoader > loads a TOML command saved with a UTF-8 BOM
```

After the fix, all 42 file command loader tests pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests, lint and typecheck on Linux. The full CLI test suite also passes, apart from a few existing tests that fail on a clean `main` in my container, mostly because it runs as root, where file permission and signal checks don't apply.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: very low. Only a leading BOM is removed before parsing; files without one parse exactly as before. Line endings are left untouched, so multi-line prompts are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: other config readers that may have the same gap are left for separate fixes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13944

prs.title: fix(core): strip a leading BOM before converting a TOML command
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A TOML command file saved with a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark now converts to Markdown instead of being dropped.

## Why it's needed

The TOML parser used for command files rejects U+FEFF outright, so a file that a Windows editor wrote with a byte-order mark fails to parse with `Unknown character "65279" at row 1, col 2`. Both places that convert a TOML command into a Markdown one read the text straight off disk and hand it over unchanged, so the parse failure turns into a silently skipped command: the file is valid on disk, the same content without the mark works, and nothing tells the user why the command disappeared. A byte-order mark is the default output of Notepad and of several editor encoding settings, which is what makes this reachable on a normal machine rather than only by hand.

This fixes the conversion path that both of those callers share. Only one leading character is stripped, so a U+FEFF that legitimately appears later in the file is preserved, and line endings are untouched. The custom-command loader reads its TOML through a different file and is being fixed separately, so this deliberately does not close the issue it belongs to.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Take any working `.toml` command file — `prompt = "hi"` is enough — and save a copy with a UTF-8 byte-order mark as its first bytes. Converting that copy should produce the same Markdown as the copy without the mark. Before this change the conversion throws a parse error naming character 65279; after it, the prompt and description both survive into the generated Markdown.

Then confirm the fix is not a blanket strip: a file whose prompt string contains U+FEFF in the middle must still contain it after conversion, and a file that is genuinely invalid TOML must still be rejected with the same parse error as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No screenshot applies; the evidence is the test output and the exception text.

Two regression tests were added to the existing suite. Run against the unmodified converter, the first one fails with the exact user-visible error and the second passes (it pins that the strip is anchored); with the change, both pass:

```console
$ npx vitest run src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 × convertTomlToMarkdown > should convert TOML saved with a UTF-8 BOM
   → Failed to parse TOML: Unknown character "65279" at row 1, col 2, pos 1:
 Tests  1 failed | 12 passed (13)

$ npx vitest run src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  13 passed (13)
```

Both callers keep their own suites green, which is the sibling-surface check for this helper:

```console
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/extension/gemini-converter.test.ts src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)   Tests  24 passed (24)

$ cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/services/command-migration-tool.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  14 passed (14)
```

`prettier --check` and `eslint` were clean on both changed files, and `tsc --noEmit` passed for the package.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Only Windows was exercised, which is where byte-order marks come from in practice. The change itself is a string operation with no platform-specific behaviour, but the other two platforms were not run.

### Environment (optional)

Focused vitest runs inside `packages/core` and `packages/cli`, on Windows with Node.js v24.12.0. No network, daemon or credentials were involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fix strips one character that the parser would otherwise reject, so the only behaviour it can change is for input that previously threw. It deliberately does not reuse the CLI package's BOM helper, because importing across package boundaries is not allowed here, and it does not reuse the core helper that normalises content because that one also rewrites CRLF line endings — an unrelated change for a parser that does not need it. A shared pure strip helper would be the tidier end state, but it would touch the other BOM-aware readers and is out of scope for this bug.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run of the migration command or the extension loader against a real BOM-prefixed file; verification is at the converter boundary plus both callers' existing suites. UTF-16 byte-order marks are not covered — the readers decode to a string before this point and it is the UTF-8 mark that reaches here as U+FEFF.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Files that parsed before parse identically, and no public signature, type or payload changes.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13944 — the same class of bug, on the conversion path rather than the loader path. The loader path is covered by the open PR for that issue, so this does not use a closing keyword.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

带前导 UTF-8 字节序标记（BOM）的 TOML 命令文件，现在能正常转换为 Markdown，而不再被丢弃。

## 为什么需要

命令文件所用的 TOML 解析器会直接拒绝 U+FEFF，因此由 Windows 编辑器写入字节序标记的文件解析失败，报出 `Unknown character "65279" at row 1, col 2`。两个把 TOML 命令转换为 Markdown 的调用点都是从磁盘读出文本后原样传入，于是解析失败最终表现为命令被静默跳过：文件在磁盘上是合法的，同样内容去掉标记就能用，而且没有任何提示告诉用户命令为什么消失了。字节序标记是记事本以及若干编辑器编码设置的默认产物，这让该问题在普通机器上就会遇到，而不只是手工构造。

本改动修复的是这两个调用点共用的转换路径。只剥离最前面的一个字符，因此文件后面合法出现的 U+FEFF 会被保留，行尾也不会被改动。自定义命令加载器通过另一个文件读取 TOML，正在单独修复，因此本 PR 有意不关闭它所属的 issue。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

任取一个可用的 `.toml` 命令文件——`prompt = "hi"` 就够——另存一份，并把 UTF-8 字节序标记作为其最开始的三字节。该副本的转换结果应与不带标记的副本完全一致。修改前转换会抛出名中含 65279 的解析错误；修改后 prompt 与 description 都会完整保留到生成的 Markdown 中。

接着确认本修复不是「一刀切」地剥离：prompt 字符串中间包含 U+FEFF 的文件，转换后仍应保留该字符；而真正非法的 TOML 仍应以与之前相同的解析错误被拒绝。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

不涉及截图；证据是测试输出与异常文本。

在既有套件中新增两个回归测试。在未修改的转换器上运行时，第一个以用户实际看到的错误失败，第二个通过（它钉住剥离是锚定在开头的）；加上改动后两者都通过：

```console
$ npx vitest run src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 × convertTomlToMarkdown > should convert TOML saved with a UTF-8 BOM
   → Failed to parse TOML: Unknown character "65279" at row 1, col 2, pos 1:
 Tests  1 failed | 12 passed (13)

$ npx vitest run src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  13 passed (13)
```

两个调用点各自的套件保持通过，这是针对该 helper 的同级验证：

```console
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/extension/gemini-converter.test.ts src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)   Tests  24 passed (24)

$ cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/services/command-migration-tool.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  14 passed (14)
```

两个改动文件上 `prettier --check` 与 `eslint` 均无问题，包级 `tsc --noEmit` 通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

只在 Windows 上运行过，而字节序标记在实践中正来自这里。改动本身是与平台无关的字符串操作，但另外两个平台未运行。

### 环境（可选）

在 `packages/core` 与 `packages/cli` 内运行定向 vitest，平台 Windows，Node.js v24.12.0。未涉及网络、守护进程或凭据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本修复只剥掉解析器本会拒绝的那一个字符，因此唯一可能改变行为的输入是原先会抛错的输入。它有意不复用 CLI 包中的 BOM helper，因为此处不允许跨包导入；也不复用 core 中那个规范化内容的 helper，因为后者还会重写 CRLF 行尾——对一个并不需要这样做的解析器而言属于无关改动。抽出一个纯粹的剥离 helper 是更整洁的终态，但那会牵动其他感知 BOM 的读取点，超出本 bug 的范围。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有对迁移命令或扩展加载器跑过端到端的真实 BOM 文件；验证停留在转换器边界加上两个调用点各自的既有套件。未覆盖 UTF-16 字节序标记——读取端在到达此处之前就已解码为字符串，进入这里的是以 U+FEFF 形式出现的 UTF-8 标记。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。此前能解析的文件解析结果完全相同，公共签名、类型与负载结构均未变化。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #13944 —— 同一类 bug，位于转换路径而非加载器路径。加载器路径由该 issue 下已开启的 PR 覆盖，因此这里不使用关闭关键字。

prs.title: fix(core): fill empty signature on unsigned thinking blocks for strict Anthropic-compatible proxies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When history contains assistant `thinking` blocks that carry no signature — which happens with cross-provider history, where the upstream generator set `thought: true` without a `thoughtSignature` — and that history is replayed against a non-native Anthropic-compatible proxy, the request now sends those blocks with an empty `signature` key (`signature: ''`) instead of shipping the block with no `signature` key at all. The thinking text itself is preserved. The fill is scoped to non-4.6 (or unparseable) model ids and does not depend on the outgoing request's `thinking` configuration within that scope: the blocks being repaired come from history, and the affected consumers fork with thinking disabled (see below). The 4.6+ adaptive-model quadrant is owned by the existing drop pass and is byte-identical to main in both directions — with thinking on it drops the unsigned blocks as before, and with thinking off nothing runs, so the block ships exactly as `main` did — which keeps fill and drop disjoint by construction. The other quadrants are unchanged: DeepSeek requests still go through normalization, and history replayed against the native Anthropic API is left untouched.

## Why it's needed

I run Qwen Code against a strict Anthropic-compatible backend (verified against SGLang v0.5.19; llama.cpp- and vLLM-backed proxies are expected to behave the same, not independently verified). Those backends require the `signature` key to be present on every assistant `thinking` block: a block without the key is rejected with HTTP 400 (e.g. SGLang's `thinking.signature` error), while the same block is accepted once `"signature": ""` is added. The key goes missing whenever cross-provider history contains thinking that an upstream generator produced without a signature — for example an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, which has no signature concept. The failing requests are the forked consumers (managed auto-memory extraction, prompt suggestions, skill review): they replay the main history with `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }`, so the outgoing request carries no `thinking` parameter at all while still shipping the unsigned history blocks — a deterministic 400 per turn before this PR, silent on their best-effort paths, easy to miss.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Focused unit tests for the changed directory: `npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core -- src/core/anthropicContentGenerator` — 3 files / 327 tests, all pass, including the five new cases: with the fill option on, a `thought` part without a signature replays as `signature: ''`, and with it off the block stays unsigned (converter); a pre-4.6 model through a non-native proxy sends the block with `signature: ''` — filled, not dropped as on 4.6+ and not left unsigned as against the native API — while the native-API case stays unchanged (generator); the #11772 repro shape — the same proxy with `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }` (no `thinking` parameter on the wire) — still gets the history block filled, proving the fill is independent of the outgoing thinking config (generator); a 4.6 model through the same proxy with thinking off ships the block byte-identical to `main` — the fill is out of scope for 4.6+ and the drop does not run without the outgoing `thinking` (generator). The other three quadrants (DeepSeek normalize, 4.6+ proxy drop, native untouched) are covered by the pre-existing tests in the same files.
- Full workspace suite: `npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` (35,693 tests) — the Anthropic converter/generator suites pass; the only failures are pre-existing environment-sensitive flakes (git index-lock and timing-budget tests in unrelated files) that reproduce identically on a pristine `main` baseline under the same load.
- Typecheck and lint: `npm run typecheck -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` and `npm run lint -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` — expected: `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a non-user-visible core change (request-shape fix in the Anthropic history converter, no UI); see How to verify for the focused unit tests and expected outcomes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested (UTM Win11 ARM VM) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (Docker, node:22-bookworm) |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests, `tsc --noEmit`, and `eslint` only; no live backend involved (the new tests are unit-level; the wire-level 400/200 repro from #11772 was done separately against a self-hosted SGLang).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fill reuses the exact pass the DeepSeek normalization already uses (`fillMissingThinkingSignatures`), whose semantics — add `signature: ''` only when the key is missing, preserve the thinking text — are already validated on that path; the new gate is non-DeepSeek + non-native base URL, deliberately independent of the outgoing `thinking` config (the repaired blocks come from history). The only behavior change is on the non-4.6 (or unparseable) model quadrant: requests through such proxies now ship the history blocks with `signature: ''` instead of with no key, in both thinking-on and thinking-off requests — strictly the shape the strict backends already require (verified 200 in #11772). The 4.6+ quadrant is byte-identical to `main` in both directions: with thinking on the drop pass deletes the blocks as before, and with thinking off nothing runs at all.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live wire replay in this PR (the 400 → 200 repro against SGLang v0.5.19 from #11772 remains the wire-level evidence; llama.cpp and vLLM not independently verified); unsigned thinking on tool-use turns still fails closed before sending — pre-existing behavior, unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — strictly additive (a new optional converter option, default off, plus the generator gate); no config or API surface changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11772.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): list and open standalone sessions in the Session Overview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Session Overview page now lists no-workspace (standalone) sessions alongside the workspace ones: when the daemon advertises the `standalone_sessions_v1` capability, the Overview fetches the standalone session list from the same paginated REST surface the sidebar already uses, merges the rows into the existing table with identity-based de-duplication, and refreshes on a short poll so newly created conversations appear without a reload. Clicking a standalone row opens it through the standalone session route instead of as a workspace session of the current workspace, because the row now carries its session context with it (previously the open callback derived the context from the workspace only, so an injected standalone row ended in "session not found"). Rename, export, archive, and delete on a standalone row are routed to the same standalone client routes the sidebar uses (a standalone row's `workspaceCwd` is the daemon's internal Conversations root, so a workspace-qualified call would skip the standalone lifecycle — working directory, deletion journal, live-runtime guard), and the Current badge plus the open-cleared-session handling now recognize the open standalone session. The open-in-split / open-in-tab buttons stay disabled for standalone rows: split/tab pane descriptors carry a workspace context and remain workspace-only.

## Why it's needed

Standalone conversations — the ones the sidebar groups under "No-workspace sessions" — were absent from the Overview page, and the Overview's row-click path could not open them even if they were injected: the page built its row list only from the workspace catalogs, and the open-session callback never produced the standalone context (source-level analysis with minified anchors in #11878). Users running a mix of workspace and standalone sessions had two disconnected views of "all my sessions".

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Full web-shell suite on Node v22.23.3 in Docker (node:22-bookworm): 415 files / 10,999 tests, all pass — including 15 standalone-related tests (9 from the original merge/open-context work, 6 added in this review round: host-locked shell hides the catalog, rename/export/archive/delete routing to the standalone client routes, and the open-standalone current-session match); `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier clean.
- Live check: the same merge/poll logic has run as a local installer patch on my Desktop for a week with a real daemon (data point in #11878) — standalone conversations appear in the Overview and open through the standalone route.
- The Evidence below is rendered with the repo's own web-shell visuals harness (Playwright against the mock daemon, one identical session fixture on both arms): the BEFORE arm is `main`, the AFTER arm is this PR's head, so the only difference between the two columns is this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Same fixture on both arms: three workspace sessions plus two standalone sessions ("Draft the release notes", "Explore the API options"), `standalone_sessions_v1` capability advertised, light theme.

| Before: `main` — standalone sessions only in the sidebar, absent from the Overview | After: this PR — the same rows appear in the Overview and open through the standalone route |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: sidebar standalone section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/8f1c654bca0119a7def92d7fb746538659daa0b3/assets/web-shell-overview-standalone-20261008/before-01-sidebar-standalone-section.png) | ![After: Overview with standalone rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/8f1c654bca0119a7def92d7fb746538659daa0b3/assets/web-shell-overview-standalone-20261008/after-01-overview-with-standalone.png) |
| ![Before: Overview without standalone rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/8f1c654bca0119a7def92d7fb746538659daa0b3/assets/web-shell-overview-standalone-20261008/before-02-overview-without-standalone.png) | ![After: standalone row clicked, session opened](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/8f1c654bca0119a7def92d7fb746538659daa0b3/assets/web-shell-overview-standalone-20261008/after-02-standalone-opened.png) |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested (UTM Win11 ARM VM) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (Docker, node:22-bookworm) |

### Environment (optional)

web-shell dev server plus the repo's visuals harness (mock daemon, no live backend); the live-daemon check above ran on macOS. The branch advanced past the 10-09 platform matrix (head 504a563b: standalone Overview actions now route to the standalone routes), so the full web-shell suite plus typecheck was re-run on all three platforms against 504a563b: macOS (host, node 22.23.1, darwin-arm64) 415/415 files, 10 999/10 999 tests; Linux (Docker, node:22-bookworm, aarch64) full 10 975/10 999 (the 24 build-artifact failures are the dist-not-built-without-prepare class; 24/24 green in isolation with dist built) with tsc and eslint at 0; Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22.23.3) full 10 997/10 999 (the 2 failures are 5s vite-startup timeouts under WinOnArm emulation, reproduced in isolation: build-artifact 23/24, vite-config 20/21 — the documented platform-timing class) with tsc at 0.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: if the daemon's standalone list carries no live flags, a merged row's running/attention status can read as idle until the next session event — a cosmetic staleness window, the same one the sidebar's section already has.
- Not validated / out of scope: the open-in-split / open-in-tab buttons stay disabled for standalone rows (split descriptors carry a workspace context); a daemon that advertises the capability but fails the list endpoint falls back to workspace-only rows (console.warn, the rest of the Overview keeps working) — covered for the list endpoint by the *warns and keeps the overview when the standalone list fails* test, mutation-endpoint failures are not covered by a dedicated test.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the merge is additive and capability-gated; without `standalone_sessions_v1` the Overview behaves exactly as today.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11878.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): count running background agents in the status-bar task pill
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Shows a running count of background subagents in the Web Shell / Qwen Code Desktop status-bar task pill while any of them are active (for example `1 shell, 2 local agents`). The count reuses the existing `tasks.pill.agent` / `tasks.pill.agents` i18n strings, is derived from the `getTasks()` snapshot the footer already polls, and drops out of the pill entirely once every agent reaches a terminal state — no new "done" residue, no per-agent elapsed timer, no new polling, no new surface. Foreground agent calls are not counted.

## Why it's needed

Since #7561, background Agent cards intentionally show a static "background task" label and are excluded from the composer footer, so the window gives no progress signal at all while background agents are working (see #13898). A compact running count in the footer is the minimal acceptable version of the requested live status: it separates "keep waiting" from "something is stuck" without polling or per-card timers.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open a Web Shell / Qwen Code Desktop session and launch three background subagents in one turn (Agent tool with `run_in_background: true`). While all three run, the composer footer pill shows `3 local agents`; with a background shell command running alongside it shows `1 shell, 3 local agents`. As each agent finishes the count decreases, and when the last one reaches a terminal state the agent part clears (the pill shows the usual done count for remaining composer tasks, or disappears). Launching foreground agents does not change the count. The pill still opens the Tasks panel on click. The label logic is also covered by the new unit tests in `packages/web-shell/client/components/StatusBar.test.tsx` (9 cases, including regressions for the pre-existing shell/done labels): `cd packages/web-shell && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts components/StatusBar.test.tsx` — 9/9 pass on node 26 / macOS.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: agent tasks are filtered out of the pill by `isComposerTask`, so a turn with three running background agents shows no agent count in the footer at all (the static "background task" card rows are the only signal). After: the same turn shows `3 local agents` in the footer pill, joined with the existing running counts (`1 shell, 3 local agents`) and cleared when the agents finish. The label-logic unit run is below; the full web-shell suite was additionally run on all three platforms against head 6c42de1 (numbers and failure classification in Environment). A live Desktop screenshot is still pending.

```
 RUN  v3.2.7 …/packages/web-shell/client

 ✓ utils/composerTasks.test.ts (2 tests) 1ms
 ✓ components/StatusBar.test.tsx (9 tests) 2ms

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests, `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, and ESLint/Prettier ran locally with pnpm 11 / node 26 on macOS. The full web-shell suite plus typecheck ran on head 6c42de1 on Linux (Docker, node:22-bookworm, aarch64) and Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22.23.3): Linux 11 487/11 518, Windows 11 513/11 518 — every failure is in a file this PR does not touch and passes when that file is run in isolation (build-artifact I/O; main-boot, BranchPickerPopover, ContextUsageMessage, SkillsManagerPage — full-suite load/timing artifacts; vite-config — 5s timeout flake). Typecheck and lint are clean on both platforms.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the status-bar `tasks` prop now receives the unfiltered `sessionTasks` snapshot instead of the pre-filtered composer list; `getTaskPillLabel` already applies the same `isComposerTask` filter internally, so shell/monitor/workflow behavior is unchanged (covered by the regression cases in the new test file), and the only new input is the agent count.
- Not validated / out of scope: per-agent live state and elapsed time on the cards (the design-reversal half of #13898), the grouping behavior of parallel background launches, and visual e2e / a live Desktop screenshot of the footer pill (the label logic is unit-tested; the full suite ran on all three platforms).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Design doc (both versions): [English](https://github.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/blob/feat/footer-agent-counter-13898/docs/design/background-agent-status-and-details.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/blob/feat/footer-agent-counter-13898/docs/design/background-agent-status-and-details.zh-CN.md) (the missing `.zh-CN.md` pair for this doc is added in this change, as required by `docs/design/README.md`).

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Russian (`ru`) locale to the web shell: a partial catalog covering the Goal card and Goals dialog strings (`goal.*` / `goals.*` keys), with the per-key English fallback the translator already provides, so everything outside the catalog renders in English until the catalog grows. The language normalizers match the `ru` prefix (any case, any region: `ru-RU`, `ru-UA`, `ru-KZ`, …), the `ru_ru` underscore form, and `russian` / `русский`, so region-qualified Russian speakers do not fall through to English; the daemon language setting maps the same forms, and the language picker lists «Русский [ru]». Russian pluralisation follows the full Russian rules including the 11–14-per-decade exception (ход/хода/ходов, токен/токена/токенов, активная цель/активные цели/активных целей). Surfaces with their own language-keyed copy tables (standalone auth, root error fallback, conversation search, desktop relay) reuse the English copy for `ru` — the same partial-catalog policy.

## Why it's needed

On a Russian-locale machine the web shell only shipped `en` and `zh-CN`, and the normalizer collapsed every other browser locale (e.g. `ru-RU`) to `en` — so a Russian user got a Russian goal objective surrounded by "Goal blocked · 3 turns" and English turn/token counters (item 1 of #13391).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `i18n.test.ts`: +9 tests — ru spelling normalization (prefix match: `ru`, region forms `ru-RU`/`ru-UA`/`ru-KZ`/`ru-BY`/`ru-MD`, the `ru_ru` underscore form, `russian`/`русский`; en/zh regressions and unrelated locales such as `fr-FR`/`ja-JP` still collapse to `en`), daemon-settings mapping (including `ru_ru` and region forms), picker list + «Русский [ru]» label, Russian pluralisation at 1/2/5/11/21 (the budget side pluralises on the budget), `goals.dropped` rendered with the session count and the right plural (1/3/5), the Goal card rendered from the ru catalog and distinct from EN, and EN fallback for keys the partial catalog lacks (plain, parameterised, unknown key).
- Full web-shell suite on Node 22.23.1: 415 files / 10,994 tests pass; `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier clean.
- Size budget: the catalog grows the transcript entry from 1,320,366 to 1,325,015 UTF-16 code units; the ceiling was re-measured and raised from 1,323,000 to 1,328,000 with the measurement kept in the test comment (the test's own convention).

Same fixture on both arms under a `ru-RU` browser locale: a blocked goal ("Wait for deployment approval" / "User authority is required"), light theme.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested (UTM Win11 ARM VM) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (Docker, node:22-bookworm) |

### Environment (optional)

web-shell dev server plus the repo's visuals harness (mock daemon, no live backend); the live check ran on macOS with a Russian-locale Desktop, where the Goal card and Goals dialog render in Russian.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the catalog is partial by design — keys it does not cover (e.g. `approval.goal.*`) fall back to English, so a Russian session stays mixed-language until the catalog grows; that is the same policy the per-key EN fallback was built for.
- Not validated / out of scope: item 2 of #13391 (Goal verifier verdict inheriting the session output language, a core change) is a separate follow-up; Windows/Linux locale rendering not checked locally. (The `/language ui ru` command works as-is: it resolves through `SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES`, which already includes `ru`.)
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — `ru` is an additive locale; `en`/`zh` normalization and rendering are regression-tested and unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13391.

This PR covers item 1 of #13391 — the web-shell `ru` locale for the Goal card and Goals dialog. Item 2 — the Goal verifier verdict inheriting the session output language (packages/core) — is a separate follow-up, so the issue stays open.

prs.title: fix(acp): preserve cancellation intent across session recovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserve explicit user cancellation across live and restored sessions while keeping infrastructure interruptions recoverable. A uniquely owned user cancellation cannot be continued. Timestamped cancellation of unknown intent requires confirmation of its current daemon identity, including ambiguous ownership of a user marker. Completed local commands retain that resolved identity; later model input, attempts or terminal outcomes supersede the unknown-intent boundary.

## Why it is needed

A cancelled tool turn can resemble a crash after restore. Older builds also stamped timestamps for deadline, connection-close and supersession aborts. Treating every timestamp as human intent suppresses valid recovery; silently resuming uncertain cancellation can repeat work the user stopped. The recovery flow preserves that uncertainty and asks before continuing.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Explicitly Cancel or Close active work, then restart and Continue. It should refuse without another model request, even with a confirmation identity.
- Interrupt through connection close, a deadline or runtime disposal. Recovery should remain available.
- Restore a timestamp-only cancellation or one with ambiguous ownership. Continue without an identity or with an outdated identity should start no model request; confirming the current identity should resume once.
- Use the public SDK in stream-json mode with the supplied confirmation identity. The emitted control frame should contain that identity; the existing no-option frame should remain unchanged.
- Complete a local command after a legacy cancelled turn and restore. The local command should stay out of model history while the original cancellation still requires its current identity.
- Remove pending work before dispatch, or after an interruption cancellation was already sent. The child should receive user intent; the next FIFO prompt should wait for outstanding cancellation acknowledgements.
- Exercise Bridge Retry after a turn error. Cancelled-turn attempt testing uses direct ACP Session retry; resubmission through the bridge after a cancelled completion is a new prompt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The pinned `88ba18c5` source probes reproduced all four reported omissions. Consolidated review and a faithful dispatched source witness identified the additional removal upgrade gap. The current repair preserves user provenance through both dispatch windows and retains the later-terminal supersession control. [Current local report and retained actual tmux evidence](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13436#issuecomment-6081778123). Historical browser acceptance remains tied to its original commit and unchanged UI.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, candidate `22ab1b6039c8973d5ebc05194f6ae56333319ad4`. 244 focused tests passed, with fresh full build and affected Core/bridge/SDK typechecks. The final bridge-only repair was rebuilt and verified separately without repeating unaffected suites. Actual compiled daemon/ACP in tmux passed one cold legacy+/docs-fixture recovery profile: missing/stale identities sent no continuation request; the matching identity sent one and completed. Current runtime log excerpts are in the report; pane captures are empty because stdout was redirected. Earlier harness failures are retained; ambiguous-explicit ownership has focused-test evidence only. Current-head necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

- Unknown or ambiguous ownership requires confirmation without certifying user intent. Invalid settlement payloads do not create provenance; a newer model input invalidates the previous recovery boundary.
- The change does not resolve unmarked cron/steering ownership or durable Close after an already idle interruption; those remain in #13502. It does not settle the entirety of #6710.
- Controlled local evidence does not establish real-model behavior, other platforms, a fresh browser run or release delivery. No whole-repository typecheck or full unit-suite pass is claimed.
- English and Chinese designs remain synchronized. No transcript migration or release is included.

## Linked Issues

Related to #6710; remaining policy decisions in #13502 and existing follow-ups in #13478.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

保留已验证的主动取消来源，基础设施中断仍可恢复；旧取消或归属歧义按未知意图要求确认当前 daemon 身份，本地命令不抹掉该边界，后续新轮次仍使其失效。SDK 支持回传确认 ID；删除输入在派发前后都保留用户取消意图，双握手完成前不推进 FIFO。244 项定向测试、完整构建及受影响包类型/静态检查通过；最后仅重建并验证新增修改的 bridge。真实编译 daemon/ACP 在 tmux 中通过一次旧取消+/docs 夹具的冷恢复路径：缺失/过期身份不发恢复请求，当前身份只恢复一次并正常完成。stdout 重定向到日志，原 pane capture 为空；报告提供实际日志摘录且不冒充 pane 内容。归属歧义仅有定向测试证据。 保留初始脚本失败、历史 UI 身份及未验收范围，不冒称真实模型、多平台、main 或发布版本已解决。尚未合并/发布，必要 CI 和人工批准独立跟踪；#13502 的产品裁决不因本轮修复而关闭。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(core): centralize model stream attempt state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR introduces one shared per-attempt state model for streamed model responses and routes every raw model-stream consumer through it. Text, thoughts, tool calls, usage, response identifiers, finish reasons, and truncation state now follow the same retry, continuation, fallback, and compression semantics across the main turn, subagents, forked queries, speculative execution, and ACP-driven flows.

Fresh retries and model fallbacks discard the failed attempt. Continuation retries preserve accumulated text and thoughts while clearing tool calls and attempt-scoped metadata. Message-display hooks and loop detection now follow the same reset decision.

## Why it's needed

Stream consumers previously maintained independent copies of attempt state. Those implementations had drifted: subagents dropped the first half of continuation retries, fallback output could be appended to stale text, ACP background responses retained failed-attempt usage, and stale tool calls or response identifiers could survive a reset. Centralizing the lifecycle removes those inconsistencies and gives future protocol-boundary work one place to preserve retry semantics.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Stream partial text, usage, and a tool call, then emit a fresh retry or model fallback followed by a successful response. Confirm only the successful attempt contributes final text, usage, tool execution, response identifiers, finish reason, and truncation state.
2. Stream partial text and thoughts, then emit a continuation retry. Confirm the text and thoughts continue without duplication while pre-retry tool calls and metadata are discarded.
3. Exercise the main turn, subagent, forked-query, speculative, foreground ACP, daemon-continuation, cron, and background-notification paths. Confirm they produce the same final-attempt state and never execute stale tool preparations.
4. Enable the MessageDisplay hook and force a fresh retry. Confirm the final hook payload contains only the successful attempt; force a continuation retry and confirm both text segments remain.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a non-UI stream-lifecycle refactor. Deterministic regression fixtures reproduce the stale-state behavior before the change and pass after the shared attempt state is applied.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS workspace with Node.js v24.18.0. Verified with 238 focused core tests, two client integration tests, all 669 ACP Session tests, targeted ACP reset tests, the full repository build, and workspace type checking. Targeted lint for every changed source and test file passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Incorrectly classifying a retry as fresh versus continuation could drop or duplicate text; dedicated state and consumer-level regression tests cover both branches.
- Not validated / out of scope: This does not replace the current Google-shaped request/response boundary with Pi or another provider-neutral protocol. Already-delivered streaming chunks are not retroactively retracted; final and captured attempt state is corrected.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. The existing stream event contract is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为模型流式响应引入了一套共享的单次尝试状态模型，并让所有直接消费原始模型流的路径统一经过该模型。主会话、子 Agent、分叉查询、推测执行和 ACP 流程现在对文本、思考、工具调用、用量、响应标识、结束原因和截断状态采用一致的重试、续写、回退和压缩语义。

全新重试和模型回退会丢弃失败尝试；续写重试会保留已经累积的文本和思考，同时清除工具调用与本次尝试相关的元数据。MessageDisplay hook 和循环检测也遵循同一个重置判断。

## 为什么需要它

此前各个流消费者分别维护自己的尝试状态，具体实现已经发生偏移：子 Agent 会丢失续写重试的前半段，模型回退输出可能拼接到旧文本后面，ACP 后台响应会保留失败尝试的用量，重置后还可能残留旧工具调用或响应标识。集中管理生命周期可以消除这些不一致，并为未来调整协议边界提供一个统一保留重试语义的位置。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 先流式返回部分文本、用量和一个工具调用，再触发全新重试或模型回退，随后返回成功响应。确认最终文本、用量、工具执行、响应标识、结束原因和截断状态只来自成功尝试。
2. 先流式返回部分文本和思考，再触发续写重试。确认文本和思考能够无重复地继续，同时重试前的工具调用和元数据已被丢弃。
3. 覆盖主会话、子 Agent、分叉查询、推测执行、前台 ACP、daemon continuation、cron 和后台通知路径。确认它们得到一致的最终尝试状态，并且不会执行过期的工具准备。
4. 启用 MessageDisplay hook 并触发全新重试。确认最终 hook 载荷只包含成功尝试；再触发续写重试，确认两段文本都会保留。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

prs.title: feat(web-shell): Add workspace file browser and previews
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Files action to the Web Shell right panel. Initially it shows a full-width workspace tree; selecting a file opens content on the left and keeps the tree on the right. Users can render Markdown, HTML, images and `.xlsx` workbooks, inspect read-only source, resize or hide the tree, and retain selection, expansion, filtering and scroll positions across panel tabs.

The file menu copies relative or absolute paths, downloads a file, opens a separate preview, or inserts the same reference tag as the composer’s `@` picker. Reference closes a floating drawer to expose the composer; the desktop dock stays open and exits fullscreen. The standalone page enables Files; embedded hosts opt in through the existing right-panel item configuration. Excel Preview uses the shared read-only spreadsheet UI in a separate workspace file tab; repeated opens reuse that tab. Other Excel formats remain download-only.

Keyboard navigation includes shadow-root file rows while respecting portalled dialogs. File loading and renderer failures stay local. Failed imports offer page reload only in the standalone shell when credentials survive it or no token is needed; embedded hosts and memory-only credentials get Close Files. Internal renderer failures propagate to local retry after cleanup. Source previews above 4 MiB are rejected before content reads, with download still available. Bundled dependency licenses and NOTICE credits ship in the npm package and extension attribution, and missing bundled seeds fail generation without overwriting existing attribution.

## Why it's needed

The right panel can show file changes but cannot browse the workspace alongside the conversation. This adds that workflow without launching a separate editor. Reads retain workspace ownership and trust checks, including rejection of stale results and unavailable owners.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Files: only the tree appears initially. Expand directories, then select a file to reveal content with more initial space beside the tree.
2. Open Markdown, HTML, an image and source. Right-click an `.xlsx` workbook and select Preview: its spreadsheet opens in a separate tab; repeat the action and confirm only one workbook tab exists. Return to Files and check its selection and expanded tree remain. Switch panel tabs and return: selection, source mode, expansion, filter and scroll positions remain. Reload restores the workspace’s Files tab and root listing; selected content is not persisted across reload.
3. Filter loaded paths with mixed case and spaces. Input remains unchanged, unmatched queries show no matches, and filtering issues no directory reads. Escape clears a nonempty filter before dismissing fullscreen or the drawer, except during IME composition.
4. Resize the divider with pointer or keyboard, hide and restore the tree, and horizontally scroll deep paths. Check relative/absolute path copying, download, separate preview, and Reference without sending a prompt.
5. Switch workspaces and revoke an owner. Unavailable, untrusted or replaced owners cannot continue reading; a stale tab does not block reopening Files for the current valid owner. Secondary-workspace content reads stay workspace-qualified.
6. In ordinary/fullscreen narrow drawers, Tab reaches file rows and Shift+Tab returns. Open a dialog: its controls retain normal forward/reverse navigation.
7. Inject an import failure. In embedded or memory-token mode, Close Files preserves the host page, credentials and composer. Safe standalone mode can reload. Inject an internal renderer error: Try again recovers locally after the fault is removed, retaining the tree.
8. Select a source file above 4 MiB: a size notice appears without content reads; use Download to obtain it. Smaller large files remain virtualized with bounded highlighting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no workspace browser was available; earlier review revisions also allowed dialog Tab interception, unsafe import-failure reload and swallowed renderer errors. After: workspace browsing remains local to the panel and these failure/focus paths recover without losing the host state.

The following fresh Chromium screenshots use a **simulated daemon** and actual Vite UI. They were visually inspected; the labeled renderer failure injects a fault into the real library. The error detail is development-only. These images do not verify Git backend or real filesystem operations. Assets live on the fork’s independent branch at a fixed commit, outside the implementation branch.

Excel Preview opens a separate workbook tab beside Files in a secondary workspace. / 次工作区的 Excel「预览」在 Files 旁打开独立工作簿页签。

![Excel Preview opens a separate workbook tab beside Files in a secondary workspace. / 次工作区的 Excel「预览」在 Files 旁打开独立工作簿页签。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/7ef93fe3283a362962134533c773272fcbb4d4a2/web-shell-files/excel-merge-after-secondary-new-tab.png)

Injected real Pierre render failure stays in the content column; tree and composer remain. / 注入 Pierre 内部渲染错误，仅内容列显示局部重试，目录树与输入框保留。

![Injected real Pierre render failure stays in the content column; tree and composer remain. / 注入 Pierre 内部渲染错误，仅内容列显示局部重试，目录树与输入框保留。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/56e6d69e676390e8ccccdba25fab9e12e0c36005/web-shell-files/oct13-fixed-pierre-local-error.png)

After local retry, source renders again in the shell theme. / 局部重试后，源码按 Web Shell 主题恢复显示。

![After local retry, source renders again in the shell theme. / 局部重试后，源码按 Web Shell 主题恢复显示。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/56e6d69e676390e8ccccdba25fab9e12e0c36005/web-shell-files/oct13-fixed-pierre-recovered.png)

Embedded import failure offers Close Files without reloading the host; the synthetic unsaved host input remains. / 嵌入宿主的导入失败提供「关闭文件」，保留模拟的未保存宿主输入。

![Embedded import failure offers Close Files without reloading the host; the synthetic unsaved host input remains. / 嵌入宿主的导入失败提供「关闭文件」，保留模拟的未保存宿主输入。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/56e6d69e676390e8ccccdba25fab9e12e0c36005/web-shell-files/oct13-fixed-import-embedded.png)

Latest integration validation (46c746a27e, merging main ef38ad7753): all three text conflicts are resolved, preserving spreadsheet lazy loading, both transcript message stubs and the ExcelJS/Pierre attribution paths. Full root build/typecheck, a final Web Shell rebuild/bundle, frozen-lockfile install, lint/formatting and publish verification passed. **1,937 focused unit/script tests** passed (1,151 App, 201 artifact/spreadsheet/parser utilities, 500 SDK, 32 notice generator, 53 build-artifact/Vite config), plus **19 Files Chromium cases and the existing Excel smoke case**. The Excel case was rerun after its selector was adjusted to avoid Tailwind treating a test locator as a style candidate. Two final resolution-patch audits were clean. GitHub confirms this head has no text conflicts; CI is still in progress, and Java 11/21 currently failed during Checkout with unresolved Git pack deltas before compilation/tests.

Independent actual-UI verification covers primary and secondary workspace workbook tabs, same-file deduplication, return to Files with selection/expansion preserved, and `.xls` exclusion. Secondary reads remain fully workspace-qualified; primary content uses its existing guarded route. A separate fresh temporary Vite cache verified one document request throughout first open and tab switching after Excel worker dependencies were explicitly preoptimized. [Cold-cache primary screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/7ef93fe3283a362962134533c773272fcbb4d4a2/web-shell-files/excel-merge-cold-primary-new-tab.png). The Excel image above is captured at 46c746a27e; the three retained error-recovery screenshots below it are from the preceding 3fc059f12a review revision. All use a simulated daemon, were visually inspected, and make no Git-backend claims.

Previous review validation (3fc059f12a): root build, bundle and sequential typecheck; ESLint, formatting, notice regeneration and actual publish-artifact verification passed. **1,922 relevant unit/script tests passed** (1,311 Web Shell App/component, 498 SDK, 28 notice generator, 58 CI/publish-verifier and 27 build-artifact), plus **18 Files Chromium E2E cases** and a final directory-retry rerun. Smoke coverage now includes secondary-workspace content routing, fresh directory retry and chunked large-file reads, alongside import recovery, filtering and drawer focus. Two final full-patch self-audit passes were clean.

Independent browser checks reproduced the prior failures and verified dialog focus at 430px/1680px, safe close with memory-only credentials and embedded host state, real Pierre internal failure/cleanup/local recovery, named tree/menu, and Windows-formatted tooltip paths. The dialog check mounted the actual dialog primitive as a surrogate; it did not exercise ScheduledTask CRUD. Size-boundary checks used mocked stat metadata, including 4 MiB + 1 rejection and inclusive 4 MiB acceptance with small content; they do not constitute a real 90 MiB freeze/OOM stress test. These checks sent no model requests.

Earlier verification included a real-daemon run of all four Reference layouts with visible typing/chip clicks and zero model requests. The full 11,168-test Web Shell suite ran on the preceding CI-fix revision; this revision reran the focused suites above. Frozen-lockfile, React 18.2 consumer and cold production lazy-loading checks were performed on earlier revisions, not rerun for this dependency-unchanged follow-up. A packaged VSIX was not separately installed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, focused tests and Chromium verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ No native Windows run; Windows path formatting checked in Chromium |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22+, pnpm workspace, local Vite UI and simulated daemon for this follow-up. Earlier real-daemon checks used the built CLI against a real workspace without model requests.

## Risk & Scope

- Pierre Trees is beta and pinned. Filtering covers loaded paths only. Tree/source implementations load on demand; compatible Shiki is bundled separately from the existing host highlighter. React 18/19 support remains unchanged.
- Two review items remain open: sanitizing Pierre’s own virtualized row-label text through a supported integration, and trimming the second highlighter’s grammar/theme payload. Toolbar/menu/notices/reference-chip sanitation and transcript message isolation are fixed here; #13935 records the precise remaining work.
- Git state, editing, filesystem mutations, live watching and migration of the existing file-changes renderer remain outside scope. Pierre can later render diffs, but grouping, recorded snapshots/partial edits, downloads and ownership semantics must be retained; this PR records that assessment only.
- No public API removal. Files is optional for embedded consumers and enabled on the standalone page. Workspace-qualified SDK directory reads use REST even when the general transport is ACP. Full repository tests and other browser/OS combinations were not run locally.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/46c746a27ea76d363d80338711db9fff831b368f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/46c746a27ea76d363d80338711db9fff831b368f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.zh-CN.md), synchronized.

## Linked Issues

#13935 is now a narrowed follow-up ledger. At the author’s request, reasonable small Suggestions were implemented in this branch: 23 previously deferred open items and all 24 new review threads were addressed, including duplicate reports. Two original threads remain open with concrete limitations; the optional return-to-tree-only enhancement remains unimplemented.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 右侧拓展区新增「文件」。初始仅有占满宽度的工作区目录树；选择文件后左侧显示内容、右侧保留树。支持 Markdown、HTML、图片、`.xlsx` 表格、只读源码、拖动列宽、隐藏目录树，以及跨页签保留选中、展开、筛选和滚动状态。

右键菜单支持复制相对／绝对路径、下载、独立预览，以及与输入框 `@` 一致的引用标签。引用后浮动抽屉关闭并露出输入框；桌面停靠区保持展开并退出全屏。独立页面默认开启，嵌入宿主显式配置启用。Excel 右键「预览」复用共享只读表格，在独立工作区文件页签打开；重复预览复用同一页签。其他 Excel 格式仍仅支持下载。

本轮进一步修复对话框焦点拦截、不安全重载、Pierre 吞掉内部渲染错误，并落实合理的小建议。模块导入失败仅在凭据可恢复或无需 token 的独立页面允许重载；嵌入宿主／仅内存凭据提供「关闭文件」。渲染错误释放资源后局部重试。源码超过 4 MiB 时在读取前提示，仍可下载。许可证生成缺少打包种子时失败并保留原声明；两种发布声明均保留依赖及 NOTICE 署名。

## 审查者测试计划

1. 初始仅有树；选择文件后出现内容列。检查预览、源码、横向滚动、列宽、隐藏／恢复树及右键操作。右键 `.xlsx` 选择「预览」应打开独立表格页签；重复不新增同名页签，切回 Files 保留目录和选中。
2. 切换页签应保留选中、源码模式、展开、筛选及滚动。页面重载恢复 Files 页签和根目录；不跨重载保留所选内容。
3. 大小写与空格筛选保留输入；零匹配明确显示；不额外读取目录。非 IME 状态下 Escape 先清筛选。
4. 检查不同工作区读请求归属，以及不可用／不可信／替换 owner 后拒绝读取。失效页签不阻止重新打开有效工作区。
5. 窄屏普通／全屏抽屉支持文件行正反向 Tab；对话框内部导航不被截获。引用插入标签但不发送模型请求。
6. 模块失败时嵌入宿主／内存凭据只关闭 Files，保留宿主、凭据与输入框；安全独立页面可重载。内部渲染错误清除故障后局部重试恢复。
7. 超过 4 MiB 的源码在内容读取前拒绝并提示下载；较小的大文件保持虚拟化与高亮上限。

### 验证与截图

上方截图均为**模拟 daemon** 下的实际 Chromium UI，已目视检查。第一张为最新 46c746a27e 的次工作区 Excel 独立预览页签；其余三张保留自 3fc059f12a，分别展示真实 Pierre 内部故障的局部重试、重试后的源码恢复，以及嵌入导入失败保留未保存宿主输入。它们不作为 Git 后端或真实文件系统操作证据，开发模式错误详情不会出现在生产库。图片位于 fork 独立素材分支的固定 commit，实现分支不含图片。

最新合并提交 46c746a27e 接入 main ef38ad7753 并解决三处文本冲突，同时保留 Excel 延迟预览、Files／语音文案隔离以及两套依赖声明。完整 build／typecheck、最终 Web Shell 重建／bundle、冻结锁文件安装、lint／格式和发布校验通过。**1,937 项相关单元／脚本测试通过**（App 1,151、文件／表格／解析工具 201、SDK 500、声明生成 32、构建／Vite 配置 53）；**19 项 Files Chromium 加现有 Excel smoke 通过**。调整测试选择器避免 Tailwind 误识别样式候选后，Excel 用例补跑通过。最终两轮冲突处理补丁自查干净。 GitHub 确认无文本冲突；CI 仍在运行，Java 11／21 当前在 Checkout 拉取 git pack 时失败，尚未编译／测试。

独立验证覆盖主／次工作区 Excel 新页签、重复打开去重、返回 Files 保留选中／展开及 `.xls` 排除。次工作区内容读取全部带工作区限定，主工作区保留既有受保护路由。单独全新临时 Vite 缓存验证首次打开到页签切换全过程只有一次文档请求，不再由依赖优化触发整页刷新。[冷缓存主工作区截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/7ef93fe3283a362962134533c773272fcbb4d4a2/web-shell-files/excel-merge-cold-primary-new-tab.png)。上述浏览器检查均为模拟 daemon，未发送模型请求，不代表真实 Git 后端验证。

此前 review 提交 3fc059f12a：完整 build、bundle、顺序 typecheck、ESLint、格式、声明生成与实际发布产物检查通过；**1,922 项相关单元／脚本测试通过**（Web Shell 1,311、SDK 498、声明生成 28、CI／打包验证 58、构建产物 27）；**18 项 Files Chromium E2E 全部通过**，目录重试调整后另补跑一次通过。新增 smoke 覆盖次工作区内容路由、真实新请求重试及大文件分块。最终两轮完整补丁自查干净。

独立浏览器验证先复现旧问题，再检查 430px／1680px 对话框焦点、内存凭据／嵌入宿主安全关闭、真实 Pierre 内部错误与清理／重试、树／菜单名称和 Windows 路径格式。对话框使用实际基础组件的替代场景，不宣称覆盖 ScheduledTask CRUD。4 MiB 边界采用模拟 stat 元数据（边界允许用小内容），不是实际 90 MiB 冻结／OOM 压测。未发送模型请求。

此前已验证真实 daemon 下四种引用布局和零模型请求；全量 11,168 项 Web Shell 测试在前一版 CI 修复提交运行，本轮复跑上述针对性测试。冻结锁文件、React 18.2 使用方及生产冷启动按需加载属于此前验证，本轮依赖未变且未复跑这些夹具；未单独安装 VSIX。当前本地平台为 macOS／Chromium，未运行原生 Windows 或 Linux。

## 风险与范围

Pierre Trees 为固定 beta 版本，筛选仅针对已加载路径；树与源码按需加载，兼容高亮器与宿主高亮器分别打包，保持 React 18/19 支持。仍开放的两项是 Pierre 自有虚拟行标签字符清理、第二套高亮器语言／主题包裁剪；标题／菜单／提示／引用标签清理及 transcript 文案隔离已完成。

不接入 Git、编辑、文件修改、实时监听或迁移现有「文件更改」渲染器。后续 Pierre 可承载 diff，但须保留分组、历史快照／局部片段、下载与归属语义。本轮未跑全仓及其他浏览器／操作系统组合。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/46c746a27ea76d363d80338711db9fff831b368f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/46c746a27ea76d363d80338711db9fff831b368f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.zh-CN.md)，同步完整。

## 关联 Issue

按作者本次要求，合理且改动不大的建议在本分支解决，不再按非阻塞统一暂缓。#13935 中 23 项之前开放的建议及本轮 24 个新增线程（包含重复报告）已处理；两项保留开放并明确剩余范围。可选「关闭内容回到仅目录树」增强仍未实现。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): clean up recovery fixtures after probe failures
prs.body:
This branch includes the CI runner recovery from #14017 (merge commit, no rebase). That dependency addresses the repeated checkout `unresolved deltas` failures; it should land first. Relative to #14017, this PR still contains only the four recovery-test/documentation files described below.

## What this PR does

Recovery acceptance now cleans up already tracked and registered worker processes even when an escaped PID fails its working-directory ownership check. The unverified PID remains untouched. The scenario timeout also leaves room for the driver's own timeout diagnostics, and the acceptance report distinguishes Hosted MySQL CI coverage from the recorded local MariaDB run.

## Why it's needed

An ownership assertion could previously abort teardown before known workers were collected or stopped, leaving test processes alive after a failed run. This follows up the three suggestions in [the #13759 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13759#issuecomment-6080254276).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Exercise teardown with a tracked process, a registered worker, and an escaped PID whose working directory does not match the session. The original ownership assertion should still fail, both owned processes should stop, and the unverified process should remain alive. The Linux regression uses real child processes and cleans up all fixtures afterward.

Confirm that the outer scenario timeout exceeds the 270-second driver wait and that the acceptance report does not imply Hosted MariaDB CI coverage.

### Evidence (Before & After)

UI: N/A; only test fixtures and acceptance documentation change.

The same Linux regression failed against the original helper because the tracked process remained alive, then passed against this change (1 passed, 0 skipped). A separate real-process probe also confirmed that the registered worker stops while the unverified PID remains alive. Repository build, typecheck and documentation formatting checks passed. Java 21 compiled all server production and test sources successfully. Independent local review found no blockers. Qwen CLI 0.25.1 also returned a text review with no blockers, but its structured-report wrapper exited 1 because no composed artifact was generated; this is not recorded as a passing machine gate, and its local model differs from CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Repository build, typecheck and formatting |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A; regression requires Linux `/proc` |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Real-process reproduction and JUnit regression, Java 21 |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: teardown must stop owned processes without weakening PID ownership validation; the regression checks both sides.
- Not validated / out of scope: this follow-up does not repeat the full MySQL/MariaDB recovery matrix or certify H3 publication. Historical acceptance results retain their original baseline.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; production code is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12904. Follow-up to #13759.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本分支通过 merge 引入 #14017 的 CI runner 恢复修复，未 rebase，用于处理反复出现的 checkout `unresolved deltas` 故障。应先合入 #14017；相对该依赖，本 PR 仍只有下述四个恢复测试与文档文件。

## 本次改动

恢复验收在脱离进程的 PID 未通过工作目录归属校验时，仍会清理此前跟踪的进程和已注册 worker，归属未确认的 PID 保持存活。同时延长场景外层超时，让 driver 自身的超时诊断有机会输出，并在验收报告中区分 Hosted MySQL CI 覆盖与历史本地 MariaDB 验收结果。

## 修改原因

原先归属断言失败会提前退出清理流程，导致已知 worker 尚未收集或停止，测试失败后仍留下进程。本 PR 处理 [#13759 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13759#issuecomment-6080254276) 的三条建议。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

使用一个已跟踪进程、一个已注册 worker，以及一个工作目录与 Session 不符的脱离进程 PID 触发清理。原归属断言应继续失败，两个已归属进程应停止，归属未确认的进程应保持存活。Linux 回归测试使用真实子进程，结束时清理全部测试进程。

确认场景外层超时大于 driver 的 270 秒等待，并确认验收报告没有将本地 MariaDB 验收表述为 Hosted MariaDB CI 覆盖。

### 前后对照证据

UI：不适用；仅修改测试夹具与验收文档。

同一个 Linux 回归用例在原 helper 上因已跟踪进程仍存活而失败，在本次修改上通过（1 个通过、0 个跳过）。独立真实进程探测也确认已注册 worker 被停止，归属未确认的 PID 保持存活。仓库构建、类型检查和文档格式检查通过。Java 21 已成功编译 server 全部生产与测试源码。独立本地 review 未发现阻塞问题。Qwen CLI 0.25.1 也输出了无阻塞问题的文字结论，但因未生成 composed artifact，结构化报告包装器退出码为 1；不将其记录为机器门禁通过，且本地模型与 CI 不同。

### 验证环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 仓库构建、类型检查和格式检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | 不适用；回归用例依赖 Linux `/proc` |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 真实进程复现及 JUnit 回归，Java 21 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：清理已归属进程的同时不能放宽 PID 归属校验；回归用例同时检查这两个约束。
- 未验证及范围之外：本次未重跑完整 MySQL/MariaDB 恢复矩阵，也不代表 H3 publication 验收通过。历史验收结果保留原有基线。
- 破坏性变更及迁移说明：无；生产代码未修改。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #12904，后续处理 #13759 的 review 建议。

</details>
