prs.title: fix(managed-agent): tenant-wide InnoDB locks must not wedge unrelated Sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Workstream A2 of #13800 asked for two things: isolate the mechanism by which a `recovery_blocked` Session wedges later foreground turns of *other* Sessions on the same hosted-harness daemon, and bound the blast radius so a fresh Session's turn either completes or fails with a named, model-visible reason.

**Mechanism (W1).** The wedge is a cross-Session InnoDB record-lock convoy on two per-tenant guard rows: `qwen_tool_publication_tenant` and `qwen_runtime_placement_guard`. Before this change, every hot-path admission and write route acquired both rows unconditionally — including per-turn traffic that has nothing to do with tenant-wide lifecycle. Any transaction that holds these rows for long enough (the `recovery_blocked` flow does) blocks every Session of the tenant behind InnoDB's 50 s `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`, which outlasts the client's 30 s request timeout. The client gives up first; the turn freezes after `hostedModelAttempt` commits, the model is never HTTP-called, and the journal stops with no terminal event. A full reproduction pack (V1–V5 variants of an external-lock experiment against the real store) is in the design doc below.

**Fix (W2), in three moves:**

1. **Ordinary traffic no longer queues on tenant-wide guard rows.** Per-turn admission and read-modify-write paths now fence per Session only (drain row + head row `FOR UPDATE`), which were already the sufficient per-session fences. The flipped contract test asserts that a same-tenant neighbor and a different-tenant neighbor both authorize promptly while a session holds its own fences.
2. **Tenant-wide acquisitions that are still required are bounded.** Lifecycle admission paths that genuinely serialize across the tenant (writer acquisition, lifecycle authorization, publication writes) take the guard rows with a 5 s per-statement query timeout (`setQueryTimeout`), in the codebase-wide placement-before-publication lock order. Contention now degrades to a named, retryable 503 `tenant_guard_contended` instead of a silent 30 s freeze, and failed acquisitions no longer leave a half-inserted head row producing a `managed_session_writer_conflict` burst. The hosted harness reclassifies transport and 5xx store failures as `managed_session_store_unavailable` in the settled turn result, so the model-visible outcome names the real cause; per-Session refusals keep their own names.
3. **`requireIdleJournal` fails closed on snapshot staleness.** With the journal-wide `FOR UPDATE` removed, a REPEATABLE READ snapshot pinned before the head-row current read can miss a concurrent commit. The lifecycle idle scan now compares the maximum scanned revision against the head revision read under the held head lock and refuses with `workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified` when the snapshot cannot see the latest revision — a witness test drives exactly that interleaving.

The blocked Session itself reports its own `recovery_blocked` state accurately throughout; the witness IT asserts this with the guard rows held.

Design doc (both languages, synchronized): [docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/fix/13800-tenant-guard-decouple/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md) · [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/fix/13800-tenant-guard-decouple/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

A single wedged lifecycle transaction took down every Session of its tenant: turns froze mid-flight with no error, no terminal event, and no model call, and the 30 s client timeout died before InnoDB's 50 s lock wait could even name the contention. Decoupling per-turn traffic from the tenant guard rows removes the convoy vector; bounding the remaining cross-tenant acquisitions converts the residual contention window into a fast, named failure that clients retry as `uncertain`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

All witnesses run against a real MariaDB/MySQL via the `mysql-integration` profile (local MariaDB with a temp datadir works; system props `mysql.url`, `mysql.user`, `mysql.password`):

1. `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` — the W1 witness. Externally holds both tenant guard rows in an uncommitted transaction, then asserts in parallel that `renewWriter`, `authorizeOrdinary`, `commit`, and `blockRecovery` (idempotent replay) of other Sessions complete promptly; that a fresh-thread `acquireWriter` fails in well under the old freeze window with 503 `tenant_guard_contended`; that `authorizeLifecycle` fails the same way; that a late `acquireWriter` succeeds after rollback; and that the blocked neighbor's `recovery_status` is unchanged. This test fails if the unconditional guard acquisition is restored. Run: `mvn -Pmysql-integration test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dit.test=ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT -Dmysql.url=... `.
2. `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT#idleJournalCheckReVerifiesARevisionItsSnapshotCannotSee` — pins a REPEATABLE READ snapshot, commits a revision from another thread, and asserts the idle check throws `workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified` instead of passing on a stale snapshot.
3. `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT#ordinaryAuthorizationFencesOnlyWithinOneSession` — the flipped per-tenant contract: same-tenant and different-tenant neighbors complete ordinary authorization while a session holds its own fences.
4. `packages/cli` hosted-harness test "names a Session store transport failure in the settled turn result" — a `ManagedSessionStoreTransportError` on the mid-turn publish surfaces as `managed_session_store_unavailable` in `/transcript` and in `turn.settled`, with the model never called. Run: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`.
5. Regression sweep: the acquisition-retirement serialization contract tests (`SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest`, `ToolPublicationRetentionStoreTest`) still pass, proving bounded guard acquisition in `acquireWriter` keeps retire-vs-acquire serialization.

Observed locally: `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` green at ~33 s; hosted-harness suite 366/366; affected Java suites `BUILD SUCCESS` (132 tests across the store modules); typecheck, eslint, prettier, checkstyle green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — server-side store semantics, no UI surface. Before/after contention behavior is captured by the external-lock experiment variants in the design doc: V1/V2a/V2b (control placements) do not reproduce; V4 (hold guards across Session create) and V5 (hold across a mid-turn publish) reproduce the freeze, with `sys.innodb_lock_waits` showing 29 waits queued on the tenant row, `managed_session_open_failed` on Session create, and `hosted_execution_authorization_unavailable` at the 30 s client deadline. After this change, the same held-guard setup is what `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` drives — and everything except the genuinely tenant-wide admissions completes immediately.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

`npm run dev` for the CLI suites; Maven with `JAVA_HOME` pointing at JDK 21 for the Java modules; local MariaDB with a temp datadir (no Docker) for `mysql-integration` failsafe witnesses.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the lifecycle fat-transaction window still exists — a slow lifecycle transaction can still hold the guard rows, but contention now fails fast with a named 503 bounded at 5 s per statement instead of freezing turns. Bound chosen to sit well under the 30 s client request timeout and the 50 s MySQL default lock wait, so the store raises the conflict before either side dies silently. Lock order is placement-before-publication everywhere; an inversion introduces an InnoDB 1213 deadlock pair whose `DeadlockLoserDataAccessException` bypasses the bounded wrapper — `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` exercises the ordering under real contention.
- Not validated / out of scope: two A2 candidate families were falsified or left open during triage — materializer gap-poison (H3) is not supported as the sole factor in either arm, and renewal-scheduler starvation (H2) is unresolved and tracked as a follow-up in #13800. Rig re-acceptance per the issue's exit criteria remains a separate step.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Store-level error codes added (`tenant_guard_contended`, `workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified`, `managed_session_store_unavailable`); the per-turn admission contract changes intentionally (no tenant-wide queueing) and is covered by the rewritten contract test.

## Linked Issues

References #13800 (workstream A2; rig re-acceptance and the H2 follow-up remain open there, so no closing keyword).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**本 PR 做什么**

#13800 的 A2 工作流要求两件事：定位 `recovery_blocked` 的 Session 卡死同一 hosted-harness daemon 上其他 Session 前台 turn 的机制；并把爆炸半径收敛为「新 Session 的普通 turn 要么完成、要么带一个具名的、模型可见的原因失败」。

**机制（W1）。** 楔死来自两张按租户单的 InnoDB 守卫行上的跨 Session 记录锁车队：`qwen_tool_publication_tenant` 与 `qwen_runtime_placement_guard`。改动之前，每条热路径准入与写入路由都无条件获取这两行——包括与租户级生命周期无关的每个 turn 的流量。任何长时间持有这两行的事务（`recovery_blocked` 流程正是如此）会把该租户所有 Session 堵在 InnoDB 默认 50 秒的 `innodb_lock_wait_timeout` 之后，超过客户端 30 秒请求超时。客户端先放弃；turn 在 `hostedModelAttempt` 提交之后冻结，模型从未被 HTTP 调用，journal 无任何终态事件即停止。完整复现包（针对真实 store 的外部持锁实验 V1–V5 变体）见下方设计文档。

**修复（W2），三步：**

1. **普通流量不再排队到租户级守卫行上。** 每个 turn 的准入与读改写路径只按 Session 设栅（drain 行 + head 行 `FOR UPDATE`），这两者本来就是充分的单会话级栅栏。翻转后的契约测试断言：当一个会话持有自己的栅栏时，同租户邻居与异租户邻居都能即时完成普通准入。
2. **仍然必需的租户级获取改为有界。** 真正需要跨租户串行化的生命周期准入路径（writer 获取、生命周期授权、发布写入）以每语句 5 秒查询超时（`setQueryTimeout`）获取守卫行，并保持全库统一的 placement 先于 publication 锁序。争用现在降级为具名的、可重试的 503 `tenant_guard_contended`，而不是静默的 30 秒冻结；获取失败也不再留下半插入的 head 行引发 `managed_session_writer_conflict` 爆发。hosted harness 把传输层与 5xx 存储故障在落地 turn 结果中重分类为 `managed_session_store_unavailable`，使模型可见的结果指出真实原因；单会话级拒绝保留各自的名字。
3. **`requireIdleJournal` 在快照过期时失败关闭。** 移除全 journal 的 `FOR UPDATE` 后，先于 head 行当前读钉住的 REPEATABLE READ 快照可能错过并发提交。生命周期空闲扫描现在把扫到的最大 revision 与持有的 head 锁下读到的 head revision 对比，快照看不到最新 revision 时以 `workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified` 拒绝——见证测试精确驱动该交错。

被阻塞的 Session 自身始终准确报告自己的 `recovery_blocked` 状态；见证 IT 在守卫行被持续持有时对此断言。

设计文档（双语同步）：[docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/fix/13800-tenant-guard-decouple/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md) · [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/fix/13800-tenant-guard-decouple/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md)

**为什么需要**

一个卡住的生命周期事务会拖垮其租户的全部 Session：turn 在半途中冻结，无错误、无终态事件、模型从未被调用，而 30 秒客户端超时在 InnoDB 50 秒锁等待报出争用之前就已死掉。把每个 turn 的流量与租户守卫行解耦消除了车队向量；对剩余跨租户获取设置上界，把残余争用窗口变成快速、具名的失败，客户端按 `uncertain` 重试。

**评审者测试计划 / 如何验证**

全部见证在 `mysql-integration` profile 下对真实 MariaDB/MySQL 运行（临时 datadir 的本地 MariaDB 即可；系统属性 `mysql.url`、`mysql.user`、`mysql.password`）：

1. `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT`——W1 见证。在未提交事务中从外部持有两行租户守卫，随后并行断言其他 Session 的 `renewWriter`、`authorizeOrdinary`、`commit`、`blockRecovery`（幂等重放）即时完成；新线程上的 `acquireWriter` 在远小于旧冻结窗口的时间内以 503 `tenant_guard_contended` 失败；`authorizeLifecycle` 同样失败；回滚后迟来的 `acquireWriter` 成功；被阻塞邻居的 `recovery_status` 不变。若恢复无条件守卫获取，本测试会变红。运行：`mvn -Pmysql-integration test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dit.test=ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT -Dmysql.url=...`。
2. `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT#idleJournalCheckReVerifiesARevisionItsSnapshotCannotSee`——钉住 REPEATABLE READ 快照，从另一线程提交一个 revision，断言空闲检查抛出 `workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified` 而不是在过期快照上通过。
3. `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT#ordinaryAuthorizationFencesOnlyWithinOneSession`——翻转后的按租户契约：同租户与异租户邻居在一个会话持有自身栅栏时完成普通准入。
4. `packages/cli` hosted-harness 测试「names a Session store transport failure in the settled turn result」——中途发布的 `ManagedSessionStoreTransportError` 在 `/transcript` 与 `turn.settled` 中呈现为 `managed_session_store_unavailable`，模型从未被调用。运行：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`。
5. 回归扫描：获取-退役串行化契约测试（`SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest`、`ToolPublicationRetentionStoreTest`）仍然通过，证明 `acquireWriter` 中的有界守卫获取保持了退役-获取串行化。

本机实测：`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` 约 33 秒绿；hosted-harness 套件 366/366；store 相关 Java 套件 `BUILD SUCCESS`（132 个测试）；typecheck、eslint、prettier、checkstyle 全绿。

**证据（前/后）**

N/A——服务端存储语义，无 UI。前后争用行为由设计文档中的外部持锁实验变体记录：V1/V2a/V2b（对照位置）不复现；V4（跨 Session 创建持锁）与 V5（跨中途发布持锁）复现冻结，`sys.innodb_lock_waits` 显示 29 个等待排队在租户行上，Session 创建报 `managed_session_open_failed`，客户端 30 秒截止报 `hosted_execution_authorization_unavailable`。改动后，同样的持锁布置正是 `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` 驱动的场景——除真正租户级的准入外一切立即完成。

**测试平台**：仅 macOS ✅；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ⚠️ 未测（CI 覆盖三平台）。

**环境**：CLI 套件用 `npm run dev`；Java 模块用 `JAVA_HOME` 指向 JDK 21 的 Maven；`mysql-integration` failsafe 见证用临时 datadir 的本地 MariaDB（无 Docker）。

**风险与范围**

- 主要风险/取舍：生命周期大事务窗口仍然存在——慢生命周期事务仍可持有守卫行，但争用现在以每语句 5 秒上界快速失败并给出具名 503，而不是冻结 turn。该上界远低于 30 秒客户端请求超时与 MySQL 默认 50 秒锁等待，因此存储层会先于任何一方静默死亡前报出冲突。锁序全库统一为 placement 先于 publication；反转会引入 InnoDB 1213 死锁对，其 `DeadlockLoserDataAccessException` 绕过有界包装——`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` 在真实争用下演练该顺序。
- 未验证/范围外：A2 的两个候选族在分诊中被证伪或留空——materializer gap-poison（H3）在两个分支上都不被支持为唯一因素，续约调度器饥饿（H2）未解决，作为 #13800 的后续项跟踪。按 issue 的出口标准，rig 复验仍是独立步骤。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。存储层新增错误码（`tenant_guard_contended`、`workspace_lifecycle_journal_unverified`、`managed_session_store_unavailable`）；每个 turn 的准入契约有意变更（不再跨租户排队），由重写后的契约测试覆盖。

**关联 Issue**：引用 #13800（A2 工作流；rig 复验与 H2 后续项在该 issue 中保持开放，故不使用关闭关键词）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12538。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): land the deferred findings from the definition-execution review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lands the seven review Suggestions deferred from #13530 by its 1500-line size fuse, now verifiable on a box with a JDK 21 + Maven toolchain and the CLI test suite.

Two of the seven are design-document accuracy repairs, four are test-witness gaps the review thread enumerated, and one is a one-literal test-strength fix. No production code changes: the shipped behavior was already correct in every case; what was missing was either the doc saying what the code does, or a test that can see a regression.

**§5.3 Shell approval rule (item 1).** The design doc said Shell profiles "must pair with the `default` approval mode" while the shipped compiler refuses only `yolo` — with a three-value vocabulary the two statements genuinely diverge on `auto-edit`. The doc's own combination rule and decision 5 already said "not `yolo`"; §5.3 was the outlier, in both the EN and zh-CN twins. Both bullets now state the rule the code implements.

**§8 concurrent-read claim (item 2).** The verification section lists "no partially updated read under a concurrent update", but the `FOR UPDATE` read implementing it had zero test references and is signature-identical to the non-locking read, so substituting one for the other kept the suite green. A new two-thread H2 test holds the row lock through a transaction while a contender's locking read waits; red on both mutation arms (holder without `FOR UPDATE`, contender without `FOR UPDATE`).

**instructionsRef guard legs (item 3).** The parse-time guard is the only `kind` check on the path that decodes referenced bytes into the system prompt, but only the `byteLength` leg was exercised. Wrong-`kind` and wrong-`schemaVersion` negative cases now sit next to the over-cap one.

**Lone top-level test (item 4).** The stored-definitions test was the file's only column-0 `it()`, so no `describe`-scoped `beforeEach` ran for it and an isolated `-t 'pins stored definitions'` run resolved 16 journal/resource paths against the vitest CWD. It now has its own describe with temp-root setup, mock resets and teardown; the isolated run passes with a clean working tree.

**model_unavailable credential half (item 5).** Design §5.6 promises a pinned model with an unauthenticated route fails the Turn before inference; coverage showed the `switchModel` catch branch at zero. A new case matches one model, makes the switch reject, and asserts `model_unavailable` with zero inference requests.

**W1 recovery guards (item 6).** The recovery branch's 64 KiB cap and `{fatal: true}` UTF-8 decode were unpinned — the only negative case was same-length all-zeros valid UTF-8 that trips the generic digest check. Over-cap and invalid-UTF-8 rows with self-consistent digests now pin both; each goes red when its guard is removed.

**metadata literal (item 7).** `metadataNeverAffectsExecution` planted a metadata mode identical to both the deployment mode and the expected result, so reading metadata could not fail the assertion. The planted literal now differs from both.

## Why it's needed

The size fuse deferred these to keep #13530 reviewable, and the toolchain gap deferred them again after that. With the toolchain in place every item is now mechanically verifiable, and each red/green check was run before landing: reverting the blankness-style predicate, the FOR UPDATE clauses, the recovery guards, or the metadata literal each turns its new witness red.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read §5.3 in both design doc languages and confirm it matches the compiler's `yolo`-only refusal; run the definition concurrency test and confirm the contender's blocked time is asserted; run the four CLI suites listed below.

What was run locally on this branch:

- `packages/cli`: `hosted-agent-definition.test.ts` 2/2, `hosted-harness-model.test.ts` 45/45, `workspace-recovery-session.test.ts` 72/72, and `hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t 'pins stored definitions'` isolated run — all green, working tree clean after the isolated run.
- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server` (JDK 21, H2): `ManagedAgentDefinitionTest` 9/9 including the new concurrency case, `AgentDefinitionCompilerTest` 27/27.
- Mutation checks: FOR UPDATE -> plain read (both arms) red; 64 KiB cap removed red; fatal decode removed red.
- `npm run typecheck` green; ESLint clean on all changed files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change: this PR touches only test files plus two design-document accuracy corrections, so there is no CLI/TUI surface and nothing user-visible to capture. The equivalent evidence for a test-only change is the red/green mutation check recorded under `## Why it's needed` and in the mutation-checks bullet above.

### Tested on

|     OS     |     Status      |
| :--------: | :-------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

Every run listed under `### How to verify` was executed on a Linux dev box: the `packages/cli` vitest suites, and the two `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server` JUnit suites on a JDK 21 + Maven toolchain against in-memory H2. macOS and Windows were not run locally — the Java lane needs that JDK 21 + Maven toolchain, which is exactly the gap that deferred these items twice before; CI covers the remaining platforms.

### Environment (optional)

Plain local checkout, no Docker/Podman sandbox and no seatbelt: vitest on the four `packages/cli` suites, Maven on JDK 21 with in-memory H2 for the `packages/sdk-java` suites, plus `npm run typecheck`. No deployed managed-agent server was involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-witness and design-doc accuracy only — no production code changes, so no runtime behavior changes. The residual risk is a new witness being weaker than it looks; each new assertion was checked by removing the guard it pins and confirming the test goes red.
- Not validated / out of scope: not run locally on macOS or Windows; the shipped behavior these tests witness was already correct and is not re-verified end-to-end here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents updated by this PR, EN and zh-CN kept in sync (only the two §5.3 bullets changed in each): [`docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ca18e8fd6867d235d69d31f618befa580a92fab1/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.md) · [`docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.zh-CN.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ca18e8fd6867d235d69d31f618befa580a92fab1/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

- Fixes #13840 — that issue tracks exactly these seven deferred findings, and this PR lands all seven.
- Source PR: #13530 — plain reference only, no auto-close keyword on purpose: it is a pull request, and merging this PR must not close it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 #13530 因为其 1500 行体量熔断而推迟的七条 review Suggestion 落地。此前它们无法验证，现在这台机器上已经有了 JDK 21 + Maven 工具链和 CLI 测试套件。

七条里有两条是设计文档准确性修复，四条是 review 线程逐条列出的测试见证（witness）缺口，还有一条是一个字面量级别的测试强度修复。没有任何生产代码改动：每一种情况下已上线的行为本来就是对的，缺的要么是"文档没有写出代码实际做的事"，要么是"没有一个能看见回归的测试"。

**§5.3 Shell 审批模式规则（第 1 条）。** 设计文档原先写 Shell profile "必须搭配 `default` 审批模式"，而已上线的编译器只拒绝 `yolo`——在三个取值的词表下，这两句话在 `auto-edit` 上是真实分歧的。文档自己的组合规则和 decision 5 早就写的是"不是 `yolo`"，§5.3 是唯一的例外，而且英文和 zh-CN 两个孪生版本都错。现在两条 bullet 都改成了代码实际实现的规则。

**§8 并发读断言（第 2 条）。** 验收章节列了"并发更新下不会读到部分更新的内容"，但实现它的 `FOR UPDATE` 读在测试里零引用，而且和不加锁的读签名完全相同，所以把两者互换测试套件照样全绿。新增了一个双线程 H2 测试：一个线程在事务里持有行锁，另一个竞争者的加锁读被阻塞；两条变异臂都变红（持有者去掉 `FOR UPDATE`、竞争者去掉 `FOR UPDATE`）。

**instructionsRef 守卫的各条分支（第 3 条）。** 解析期守卫是"把被引用字节解码进 system prompt"这条路径上唯一的 `kind` 检查，但此前只有 `byteLength` 那条分支被覆盖到。现在 `kind` 错误和 `schemaVersion` 错误的负向用例就放在超上限那条用例旁边。

**唯一的顶层测试（第 4 条）。** stored-definitions 那个测试是该文件里唯一一个写在第 0 列的 `it()`，因此没有任何 `describe` 作用域的 `beforeEach` 会为它执行，单独跑 `-t 'pins stored definitions'` 时会把 16 个 journal/resource 路径解析到 vitest 的 CWD 上。现在它有了自己的 describe，带临时根目录 setup、mock 重置和 teardown；单独跑通过，且工作树干净。

**model_unavailable 的凭据那一半（第 5 条）。** 设计 §5.6 承诺：路由未鉴权时，钉住的模型应当在推理之前就让这个 Turn 失败；而覆盖率显示 `switchModel` 的 catch 分支为零。新增用例只匹配一个模型、让 switch 拒绝，并断言返回 `model_unavailable` 且推理请求数为零。

**W1 恢复守卫（第 6 条）。** 恢复分支的 64 KiB 上限和 `{fatal: true}` 的 UTF-8 解码此前都没有被钉住——唯一的负向用例是同长度全零的合法 UTF-8，它只会撞上通用的 digest 校验。现在新增了超上限行和 digest 自洽的非法 UTF-8 行，把两条守卫都钉住；各自去掉对应守卫时都会变红。

**metadata 字面量（第 7 条）。** `metadataNeverAffectsExecution` 原先植入的 metadata 模式与 deployment 模式、与期望结果三者完全相同，所以"读了 metadata"这件事根本不可能让断言失败。现在植入的字面量与两者都不同。

## 为什么需要

体量熔断为了保住 #13530 的可评审性把这些推迟了，之后工具链缺口又把它们推迟了第二次。工具链就位后，每一条现在都能机械验证，并且落地前都跑过红/绿检查：把 blankness 风格的谓词、`FOR UPDATE` 子句、恢复守卫或 metadata 字面量任一改回去，对应的新见证都会变红。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

对照两种语言的设计文档读 §5.3，确认它与编译器"只拒绝 `yolo`"的行为一致；跑 definition 并发测试，确认竞争者被阻塞的时间被断言到；跑下面列出的四个 CLI 套件。

本分支上本地实际跑过的内容：

- `packages/cli`：`hosted-agent-definition.test.ts` 2/2、`hosted-harness-model.test.ts` 45/45、`workspace-recovery-session.test.ts` 72/72，以及 `hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t 'pins stored definitions'` 的单独运行——全部通过，单独运行后工作树干净。
- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`（JDK 21，H2）：`ManagedAgentDefinitionTest` 9/9（含新增并发用例）、`AgentDefinitionCompilerTest` 27/27。
- 变异检查：`FOR UPDATE` 改成普通读（两条臂）变红；去掉 64 KiB 上限变红；去掉 fatal 解码变红。
- `npm run typecheck` 通过；所有改动文件 ESLint 干净。

### 前后对比证据

N/A——非 UI 改动：本 PR 只碰测试文件和两处设计文档准确性修正，没有 CLI/TUI 界面，也没有任何用户可见的变化可供截图。对纯测试改动而言，等价的证据就是上面记录的变异红/绿检查（见 `## 为什么需要` 与变异检查那条 bullet）。

### 在哪些平台测过

|     OS     |     状态      |
| :--------: | :-----------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ 已测试   |

`### 如何验证` 下列出的每一次运行都是在 Linux 开发机上执行的：`packages/cli` 的 vitest 套件，以及 `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server` 的两个 JUnit 套件（JDK 21 + Maven 工具链，内存 H2）。macOS 和 Windows 没有在本地跑过——Java 这条 lane 需要那套 JDK 21 + Maven 工具链，而这正是此前把这些条目推迟了两次的缺口；其余平台由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

普通本地 checkout，没有 Docker/Podman 沙箱，也没有 seatbelt：四个 `packages/cli` 套件用 vitest，`packages/sdk-java` 套件用 JDK 21 上的 Maven 配内存 H2，另外跑了 `npm run typecheck`。整个过程没有涉及已部署的 managed-agent 服务。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：只涉及测试见证与设计文档准确性——没有生产代码改动，因此没有运行时行为变化。残留风险是某个新见证比看上去更弱；每条新断言都通过"去掉它要钉住的守卫、确认测试变红"验证过。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有在 macOS 或 Windows 上本地运行；这些测试所见证的已上线行为本来就是正确的，此处不做端到端复验。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

本 PR 更新的设计文档，英文与 zh-CN 保持同步（两边各自只改了 §5.3 的两条 bullet）：[`docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ca18e8fd6867d235d69d31f618befa580a92fab1/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.md) · [`docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.zh-CN.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ca18e8fd6867d235d69d31f618befa580a92fab1/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

- Fixes #13840——那个 issue 追踪的正是这七条被推迟的发现，本 PR 把七条全部落地。
- 来源 PR：#13530——刻意只做普通引用，不带自动关闭关键字：它是一个 pull request，合并本 PR 不应该把它关掉。

prs.title: fix(serve): stop renewing settled Hosted Shell grants
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops renewing a Hosted Shell publication once the original execution has authoritatively settled, while retaining its binding until receipt acceptance so failure cleanup still works. Each renewal pass attempts all live bindings before reporting failures with their publication IDs. A renewal already in flight when settlement is observed can finish without producing a misleading warning; genuine renewal failures still block dispatch.

## Why it's needed

A slow Session receipt leaves the settled execution in the batch's bookkeeping. The publication service correctly rejects renewal of settled executions, but the client previously kept renewing them and logged a misleading warning. The first rejection also prevented queued publications later in the same pass from being renewed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the first Shell execution open in a two-call batch and advance the renewal timer. Both its running publication and the queued second publication should renew.
2. Settle the first execution, hold its receipt commit across two timer ticks, and check that only the queued publication renews. Release the receipt: both calls should complete, ownership should release normally, and no publication-renewal warning should appear. Repeat for original-finished-publication recovery and a proven not-started execution.
3. Let an already-running renewal reject after settlement is observed. It should not warn or prevent renewal of the queued publication.
4. Reject an unsettled timer renewal with HTTP 503. The same tick should still renew the queued publication and log exactly one warning naming the failed publication. The next successful tick should retry both live publications. HTTP 400 or 503 during pre-dispatch renewal must still block dispatch after attempting all bindings.
5. Return cancelled-before-dispatch with no capture, then reject the finished-publication lookup. Recovery must cancel the original execution and send close_not_started with the original publication ID and token, without releasing uncertain ownership.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for visual evidence: internal Hosted lifecycle behavior, no TUI layout change. With the original eight regression tests on unchanged base 8eaaa1355cafbd0ae2716331b0eca57dec54b2e6, seven cases fail and the cleanup-preservation case passes. Settled publications are renewed, delayed receipts produce spurious warnings and skip queued grants, and genuine per-binding errors stop the renewal pass. The exact same eight cases all pass with the fix. After the fix, all 581 Hosted CLI tests (15 files) and 1,927 managed-runtime core tests (34 files) pass, 2,508 in total. Full build, full typecheck (4 GiB Node heap), bundle, repository-wide lint:ci, changed-file Prettier, diff whitespace checks, and the serve-fast-path bundle closure check also pass.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 222 scoped Hosted-turn tests on current head (2026-10-13) |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ deterministic component tests |

### Environment (optional)

Debian 13, Node.js 24.19.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Usage statistics and OTel are disabled with QWEN_USAGE_STATISTICS_ENABLED=false and QWEN_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false. The component tests exercise the actual Hosted turn coordinator and local Session/harness persistence with controlled Broker and publication-service fixtures. Only interval timers are advanced. The global qwen CLI is unavailable in this environment.

Latest upstream-merge validation (2026-10-07, head b6ee9a1ac6a8): 210 Hosted-turn tests, changed-file Prettier/ESLint, CLI typecheck, and full build/bundle passed on Windows. The wider Linux counts above describe the original fix validation, not a new full-suite run on this head.

Review follow-up (2026-10-11, head 91b3bf80a): collected renewal failures retain their binding reference and are filtered again against current settlement state when the pass finishes. The new regression rejects the first renewal before client settlement, then holds the second renewal until the first receipt and ACK complete. With catch-time-only filtering it rejects the turn with HostedToolRecoveryRequiredError; with the correction both calls and ACKs complete with zero cancellation and no renewal warning. Independent verification: 217/217 Hosted-turn tests and 9/9 renewal cases, including HTTP 400/503 pre-dispatch fail-closed and cleanup. Changed-file formatting/lint, full workspace+integration typecheck, CLI rebuild, bundle, and compiled CLI version smoke check pass. A fresh frozen-lockfile installation did not complete because registry requests/foreign-platform cache metadata were unavailable; these checks use the existing locked-version dependency cache. No real remote-service E2E or full-repository unit-suite pass is claimed. Retry-policy changes and store/client settlement-lag confirmation remain non-blocking follow-ups; this correction does not infer settlement from HTTP 400 or message text.

Maintenance follow-up (2026-10-13, head 0aa39cf07): merged main ef38ad775 normally, including upstream #13844's Git fanout-fixture correction. Production renewal behavior is unchanged by this round. Added mixed stale/live and multiple-live-failure coverage for R2-3/R2-4: only the stale error is discarded, the queued live failure still blocks dispatch, and both live publication IDs are retained in the aggregate and its single warning. Independent mutation checks turn red when the entire pass is swallowed or the aggregate message is truncated to the first error; after restoration, 222/222 Hosted-turn tests and 11/11 renewal cases pass. Frozen-lockfile installation and its 2,075 supply-chain checks, full workspace prepare/build/bundle, CLI typecheck, changed-file formatting/lint, pre-commit hooks and compiled CLI version smoke (0.25.1) pass. - Main risk or tradeoff: renewal eligibility must not erase the original binding needed by failure cleanup; the regression suite pins both paths. Review remains important for this Hosted lifecycle code.

Its default 2 GiB integration-typecheck heap exhausted memory; a separate full typecheck passes with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096. prs.title: fix(cli): close post-merge takeover findings from the #13083 review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the three Critical findings from the [post-merge review on #13083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826) (Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover), each pinned by a unit witness, plus the findings filed by several follow-up /review rounds (R1–R5) on this PR itself. All three gaps sit on the managed-agent takeover path:

1. **A takeover load left the Session indistinguishable from an idle one.** The load answered 200 and registered the Session while its recovered Turn was still unsettled, yet nothing on the Session marked that Turn as in flight and owned by the client. `/status` reported the exact pair the SDK's settlement check reads as a terminal Turn, a fresh `/prompt` was admitted over the checkpoint the load had just advertised, and a user cancel was a silent no-op while a Runtime Session was held. The Session now records the recovered-but-undriven Turn: `/status` reports it in flight, `/prompt` refuses a fresh Turn over it (logged for oncall), and the continue/cancel routes clear the marker when they drive the Turn to its terminal record — a retryable cancel failure keeps the marker so the coordinator's retry re-drives the same Turn. The marker is deliberately not aliased to the existing active/blocked state, since both refuse the coordinator's own continue/cancel.
2. **A failed continuation reconciliation used to settle the Turn terminally.** The inlined recovered-continuation called the committed-results resume with no error mapping; the follow-up review then established that blocked-for-recovery is worse here: the comment's promised re-drive does not exist (the Session stays registered, and the connector drops its recovery tracking on the 200 admission), and an already-registered Session can never be re-loaded. The shipped shape is therefore the honest terminal one again: a raw escape from the resume — a transient warmup failure or a retryable re-acquire refusal, which the tool turn rethrows as-is — settles the Turn as a terminal error, while only an already-wrapped recovery error still lands in the recovery-blocked handler, exactly like the sibling driver classifies them after admission. A pre-wrapped error is rethrown unwrapped so the block log names the real cause, and a Turn settling without completing drops its pending file-history marker with it — a failing retirement stays owed and is retried by the next settled prompt or by close, so one transient failure can neither brick a Session's file history nor record a completed Turn as an error. Separately, a cancel replay certified while the stop still ran is now recorded on the admission, so a later failure stops waiting for a retry that cannot arrive; a fallible step after the durable checkpoint moved (the marker retirement or the terminal record write) admits loudly — best-effort terminal, recovery-blocked, marker cleared — instead of a permanent identity-mismatch; a refused lease release owes the lease for the next terminal route on the correct runtime-session id, and a Runtime Session the Broker already forgot is treated as handed back so the obligation retires instead of retrying forever. Finally, a refused load-resume now logs its reconciliation root cause before answering a bare 503.
3. **An unknown execution read had no truthful representation.** The recovery-report status read mapped every `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` to "definitively unknown" (#13083 review R2-3). The H2 hooks rewrite on main (#13129) already replaced that fold with a first-class wire state whose only terminal consumer fails closed; this PR owns the terminal arm the Broker marks with `details.terminal` (an ABANDONED record, fenced on loss evidence alone). Such a record now reaches callers as the distinct `abandoned` state — never folded into the not-found sentinel — and the cancellation's stop step accepts it as cancellation-complete without a cancel or a poll that could never observe anything more, while a still-reconcilable unknown keeps failing closed (one shared predicate keeps the pre-cancel skip and the post-cancel poll in lockstep). The passive report keeps its fence too: a fenced record now arrives as known + `{ state: 'abandoned' }` instead of folding into the same unknown the coordinator cannot drive, since only a federated cancellation can retire it. The takeover arms its undriven marker only through the producer's own drivability call (`every outcome known`, and drive restricted to `results_ready`). The user-facing cancel route also refuses a user cancel in the undriven-takeover window with a scoped 409 instead of confirming a cancellation that never happened.

The review history is recorded honestly: R2-3's observed transient-unknown failure was already closed on main by #13129, so this PR's delta on that axis is the terminal arm plus its stop-step handling.

## Why it's needed

Each finding either wedges a shared resource or makes the durable journal lie: a second Turn over the advertised checkpoint pins the recovered Runtime lease on a dead owner; a terminally settled continuation can never be driven again and keeps the checkpoint's receipts unconsumed; a skipped cancel lets a possibly running execution outlive the Turn the journal claims was cancelled; a folded terminal record certifies a stop nobody observed while the Workspace lease is handed away; a certified-then-failed cancel leaves the Session claiming an in-flight Turn that will never settle; and a 204 user cancel claims a stoppage that never occurred. Every fixed branch goes red when its production hunk is reverted (mutation evidence below).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the three touched suites from `packages/cli`:

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts
```

What to confirm, one behavior per finding:

- After a takeover load and before any continue/cancel, `GET /session/:id/status` reports the Session in flight and `POST /session/:id/prompt` with a fresh prompt is refused with `409 hosted_turn_active`; the user cancel answers a scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required` in that window (and keeps 204 when idle or driving); after the continuation settles, a fresh prompt is admitted again. (Witness: *reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*.)
- When the continuation's reconciliation escapes `resumeCommittedResults()` raw, the route still answers 200 but the Turn settles as a terminal `turn_error` instead of blocking forever, and the Session reads idle and unblocked afterwards. (Witness: *settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*.)
- A pre-wrapped recovery error reaching the continuation keeps its cause visible in the block log: the logged line contains `Original file history snapshots changed.` rather than the wrapper boilerplate. (Witness: *logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*.)
- A cancel replay that was certified 200 while the stop still ran stops waiting for a retry after failure: `/status` reports `recoveryBlocked: true` with `hasActivePrompt: false`, a user cancel is refused `hosted_turn_recovery_required`, and a fresh prompt gets the truthful code too. (Witness: *reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*.) A failure after the durable checkpoint moved is admitted the same way — loudly, not armed-and-idle. (Witness: *admits the post-settle failure loudly once the checkpoint has moved*.)
- A completion-failing file-history retirement owes the marker and retires it through close: the cold load after detach stays 200; a completed continuation never pays that fallible round trip. (Witnesses: *retires the pending marker through close when the retirement write fails once*, *skips the file-history retirement read on a completed continuation*.)
- A lease release refused after a confirmed stop settles the Turn and owes the lease: the cancel answers 200 with the cancelled terminal record, and the replay's terminal route retries the release instead of the coordinator drowning in 503s and identity mismatches. (Witness: *settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*.)
- A 409 carrying `details.terminal` reads as `{ state: 'abandoned' }`, a marker-less 409 as `{ state: 'unknown' }`, a 404 as undefined; through the stop step, abandoned is accepted with no cancel issued while unknown still throws, and an execution fenced abandoned mid-poll still ends the stop. The passive report advertises `unknown` for both kinds. (Witnesses: *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records* at the wire; *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*, *breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*, and the extended *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown* at the recovery layer.)
- A cancel whose stop confirmation fails still answers 503, keeps the owned Turn refused, and the coordinator's retry drives the same cancellation to settlement. (Witness: *refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*.)

Mutation evidence recorded during development, all producing red: reinstating the blanket wrap makes the terminal-settle witness time out with no terminal event; removing the replay-certified failure branch leaves the Session armed and the fresh prompt answered `hosted_turn_active`; rethrowing the refused release turns the owed-lease witness into a 503; removing the terminal discriminator at the broker fails with `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`; removing the abandoned arm from the stop-step pre-check calls `cancel` once where zero is required; removing it from the poll spins past the test timeout instead of breaking; removing it from the passive fold reports `known` for an abandoned record.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; behavior is exercised by the unit witnesses above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux Test lane green on the PR head commit; Windows covered by the same suite family. Local run: 256/256 across the three touched suites.

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest run`; full `npm run build` and package typecheck green. The previously intermittent `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` was deflaked in this PR (synchronization on the stop step's first status read instead of polling `/status`, whose semantics the takeover change itself alters); 3/3 consecutive full-file runs green locally and green on CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new `/prompt` refusal, `/status` reporting, and scoped user-cancel refusal apply only in the window between a takeover load and its continue/cancel; the Java coordinator does not poll `/status` in that window (it drives continue directly after load, and its HarnessCoordinator retry scheduler re-drives retryable failures including the 503 the daemon answers for an unconfirmed stop), and every changed branch is pinned by a unit witness.
- The accepted-abandoned cancellation asserts no observed stop; the journal's own wording for that turn is "cancelled with its owner", and the stop-step contract comment now records that the abandoned stop is accepted unproven because the Broker fenced the record permanently on loss evidence. A Session that goes recovery-blocked through the pre-wrapped class still has no re-drive, as at base — closing that gap needs the coordinator protocol to grow one, which is deliberately not this PR.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 36 Suggestions from the #13083 post-merge review, tracked in #13187.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the wire contract adds one refusal the takeover design already implied, `/status` becomes truthful where it previously read as terminal, and the user cancel stops promising a stoppage it did not perform in one bounded window.

## Linked Issues

Post-merge review on #13083: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826
Deferred Suggestions: #13187

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地 [#13083 合后 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826)（Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover）的三条 Critical 与本 PR 多轮 /review 的后续发现，每条都有单元见证。三个缺口都在托管代理 takeover 路径上：

1. **takeover load 之后的 Session 与空闲会话无法区分。** 恢复出的轮次尚未结算时，load 就已回答 200 并注册 Session，但 Session 上没有任何状态表明该轮次在途且归属于客户端：`/status` 报告的键值对恰好被 SDK 的结算检查读作"轮次已终态"；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 会在刚通告的 checkpoint 之上被准入；用户取消在 Runtime Session 仍被持有时静默落空。现在 Session 会记录"已恢复但未驱动"的轮次：`/status` 报告其在途，`/prompt` 拒绝在其上开启新轮次（并落日志给 oncall），continue/cancel 路由把轮次驱动至终态记录时清除标记——可重试的取消失败会保留标记，让协调器的重试重新驱动同一轮次。该标记刻意不复用现有的 active/blocked 状态，因为这两者会拒绝协调器自己的 continue/cancel。
2. **续跑调和失败曾经把轮次结算为终态。** 内联的恢复续跑最初调用已提交结果续跑时没有任何错误映射；后续 review 进一步确认"为恢复而阻塞"在此处更糟：注释所承诺的重驱并不存在（Session 保持注册，协调器在 200 准入时就移除了恢复跟踪），而已注册的 Session 永远无法重新 load。因此交付的形态回归诚实的终态语义：从续跑中原始逃逸的失败——瞬态 warmup 失败或可重试的 re-acquire 拒绝（工具轮次原样重抛）——把轮次结算为终态 error，而只有已预包装的恢复错误仍进入恢复阻塞处理器，与兄弟驱动在准入后的分类完全一致。预包装错误原样重抛，使阻塞日志能看到真实原因。另外：仍在运行就被认证通过的 cancel replay 现在会记录在 admission 上，之后失败时不再等待永远不会来的重试，而是把 Session 如实报告为恢复阻塞而非"武装且空闲"；已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为欠账交下一终态路由重试，不再让 503 压在已结算的轮次上（此前会让协调器陷入身份不匹配死循环）。
3. **对 unknown 执行读取缺少如实的表达。** 恢复报告的 status 读取曾把所有 `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` 映射为"确定性未知"（#13083 review R2-3）。main 上的 H2 hooks 重写（#13129）已把这种折叠替换成一等公民的线上状态，其终态消费者 fail closed；本 PR 拥有的是 Broker 用 `details.terminal` 标记的终态分支（ABANDONED 记录，仅凭丢失证据封闭）。这类记录现在以独立的 `abandoned` 态到达调用方——不再折叠进 not-found 哨兵——取消路径的停止步骤在不发出取消或轮询（两者本就无法再观测到任何东西）的前提下接受它为"取消完成"，仍可调和的 unknown 继续 fail closed；一条共享谓词保证取消前跳过与取消后轮询两臂一致，被动报告仍对两者通告 `unknown`。用户侧取消路由在未驱动 takeover 窗口内对 user cancel 回答 scoped 409，不再确认一次从未发生的取消。

review 历史被如实记录：R2-3 观测到的瞬态 unknown 失败已由 main 上的 #13129 关闭，本 PR 在该轴的贡献是终态分支及其停止步骤处理。

## 为什么需要

每条发现要么钉死共享资源，要么让持久化日志说谎：在已通告的 checkpoint 上再开第二个轮次，会把恢复出的 Runtime 租约钉在已死的属主上；被结算为终态的续跑再也无法驱动，checkpoint 的回执永远无人消费；被跳过的取消会让一个可能仍在运行的执行，比日志声称已取消的轮次活得更久；被折叠的终态记录会把无人观测的停止说成事实，同时把 Workspace 租约递交给下一个获取者；先认证后失败的取消会让 Session 声称有一个永不结算的在途轮次；204 的用户取消会声称一次从未发生的停止。每个修复分支在生产代码被还原时都有见证变红（下文变异证据）。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/cli` 下运行三个受影响的套件：

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts
```

每条 finding 对应一个待确认行为：

- takeover load 之后、任何 continue/cancel 之前，`GET /session/:id/status` 报告会话在途；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 拒绝为 `409 hosted_turn_active`；该窗口内用户取消回答 scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`（空闲或驱动中仍为 204）；续跑结算后新 prompt 再次被准入。（见证：*reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*。）
- 续跑调和以原始形态逃逸出 `resumeCommittedResults()` 时，路由仍回答 200，但轮次结算为终态 `turn_error` 而非永久阻塞，且 Session 事后读作空闲且未阻塞。（见证：*settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*。）
- 预包装的恢复错误到达续跑路由时，其底层原因仍可在阻塞日志中看到：日志行包含 `Original file history snapshots changed.`，而不是包装器套话。（见证：*logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*。）
- 仍在运行就被认证 200 的 cancel replay，在失败后不再等待重试：`/status` 报告 `recoveryBlocked: true` 与 `hasActivePrompt: false`，新 prompt 被如实地拒绝为 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`。（见证：*reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*。）
- 已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为结算轮次并欠账：取消回答 200 并落已取消终态记录，replay 的终态路由重试该释放，而不是让协调器淹没在 503 与身份不匹配里。（见证：*settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*。）
- 带 `details.terminal` 的 409 读作 `{ state: 'abandoned' }`，无标记的 409 读作 `{ state: 'unknown' }`，404 仍为 undefined；经停止步骤，abandoned 被接受且不发出取消，unknown 仍然抛错，取消后被废弃的执行也会让轮询准时结束。被动报告对两类都通告 `unknown`。（见证：wire 层 *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records*；恢复层 *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*、*breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*，以及扩参后的 *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown*。）
- 停止确认失败的取消仍回答 503，持有的轮次继续保持拒绝，协调器的重试会把同一次取消驱动到结算。（见证：*refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*。）

开发过程记录的变异证据（均产生变红）：恢复全量包装让终态结算见证超时且无终态事件；删除 replay 认证后的失败分支会让 Session 处于武装态并把新 prompt 答为 `hosted_turn_active`；还原拒绝释放的重抛会把欠租用例变回 503；去掉 broker 的 terminal 判别得到 `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`；去掉停止前检查的 abandoned 臂会在要求零次时调用一次 `cancel`；去掉轮询臂会在应结束时自旋至测试超时；去掉被动报告折叠臂会把废弃记录报告为 `known`。

### 前后对照证据

N/A——非 UI 变更，行为由上述单元见证覆盖。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux Test lane 在 PR head 上已通过；Windows 由同族套件覆盖。本地：三个受影响套件 256/256。

### 环境（可选）

本地 `vitest run`；`npm run build` 与包级 typecheck 全绿。此前间歇失败的 `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` 已在 PR 内 deflake（改用停止步骤首次 status 读取做同步，替代语义被 takeover 改动本身改变的 `/status` 轮询）；本地连续 3 轮全文件通过，CI 亦通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：新增的 `/prompt` 拒绝、`/status` 报告与 scoped 用户取消拒绝，只作用于 takeover load 与其 continue/cancel 之间的窗口；Java 协调器在该窗口内不轮询 `/status`（load 后直接驱动 continue，且其 HarnessCoordinator 重试调度器会重驱包括 daemon 为未确认停止所答 503 在内的可重试失败），且每条改动分支都有单元见证钉住。
- 被接受的 abandoned 取消并未断言观测到停止；该轮次落在日志里的措辞是"cancelled with its owner"，停止步骤的契约注释也已写明：该停止未经证明而被接受，因为 Broker 仅凭丢失证据就把该记录永久封闭了。经由预包装类别进入恢复阻塞的 Session 仍无重驱（与基线一致）——关闭这个缺口需要协调器协议新增一条通道，刻意不在本 PR 内做。
- 未验证/范围外：#13083 合后 review 的 36 条 Suggestions，已在 #13187 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；线上契约只增加了 takeover 设计本就隐含的一个拒绝，`/status` 从"读作终态"变得如实，用户取消在一个有边界的窗口内不再承诺它未执行的停止。

## 关联 Issue

#13083 合后 review：https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826
暂缓的 Suggestions：#13187

</details>

prs.title: docs: record local tool visibility comparison and verification steps
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Records the existing local tool-visibility comparison and a short procedure for checking normal CLI conversations with existing logging. The final diff contains only English and Chinese verification notes.

## Why it's needed

The real-model comparison measured lower token totals, but also observed two answer-format failures and one rejected call that recovered. Keeping these results and their limits is useful; maintaining a separate evaluation framework is unnecessary for this local verification task.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Check that both language versions preserve the same configuration, totals, failures and accounting limits. Follow the documented existing CLI capture options for a small matched comparison. Missing request usage must remain incomplete evidence, and correct task output must be checked separately from token cost.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. The PR now contains two documentation files only: the custom runner, its 800-line test suite, npm entry and design proposal have been removed. Formatting, relative links, stale-reference checks and package restoration against the base passed. Two bounded source-CLI sessions subsequently exercised the deferred bridge: Agent returned the exact requested format, while Goal reproduced a call before schema review, then recovered and completed after the correct refusal. The captured prompt already instructs schema review first. Four preliminary isolated-global sessions used 0.24.0 and did not reach the bridge; they are excluded from that conclusion. No production code was changed and no new A/B cost comparison was made.

Historical results: input + output 998,874 → 698,947 (−30.03%), task results A 18/18 versus B 16/18, plus one recovered invalid-parameter call. Quality acceptance remains FAIL. Cached input was uncontrolled and B had higher uncached input, so this is not evidence of billing savings. See the [original report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13767#issuecomment-6079794031) for both runs, including failures.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Documentation checks passed; historical real-provider results linked above |
| Windows | No runtime change; not rerun |
| Linux | No runtime change; not rerun |

### Environment

Historical experiment: macOS, Node 22, kimi-k3, production source 4360b003a087. The follow-up used source c2f5ce45b156 and existing CLI/logging; the tracked change remains documentation only.

## Risk & Scope

The manual procedure is not an automated gate and does not by itself recreate the historical nine-task experiment. Original artifacts remain local and the retired implementation remains in Git history. General recall parity and standard-suite acceptance remain open. Product defaults, dependencies and workflows have no net changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12333

## 为什么需要

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): display declared Channel submissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

For Channel-source sessions, use a nonblank original-text declaration as the display projection when the request has a text block and the turn has no channel-worker classification or worker display projection. Pending text, live user echoes, and durable recording use the original declaration verbatim, while the model still receives the complete prepared prompt.

Missing, invalid, empty, whitespace-only, and media-only submissions retain their content-derived display. An explicit worker projection keeps precedence, including an intentionally empty projection paired with a declaration. Add regression coverage for these boundaries and synchronize the [English design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md) and [Chinese design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

An external Channel gateway can submit model text such as `gateway instructions\nhello` and separately declare the original user text `hello` through the existing non-privileged `qwen.submittedPrompt` contract. The declaration reaches the bridge, but the user echo and transcript display the prepared wrapper. This change displays `hello` consistently without removing the instructions from model input or granting worker authority.

The declaration is a display contract, not authentication or proof of authorship. Native authenticated channel-worker history behavior and Qwen product wording remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a prepared text prompt to a Channel-source session with a nonblank original-text declaration and no worker keys. Pending text and live user echo should match the raw declaration, including surrounding whitespace. The complete prepared prompt should still reach the model.
2. Complete the turn, stop the daemon, start a new process with the same isolated runtime, and load the session. Both load replay and transcript paging should show the declaration; persisted model content should retain the prepared text.
3. Omit the declaration or supply an invalid type, empty string, or whitespace-only string. Display should retain the prepared text. For an image-only request with a nonblank declaration, pending text should stay `[image]`, the echo should contain only the image, and private display metadata should be absent. Ordinary-source sessions should keep their original display.
4. Confirm caller-supplied private display metadata cannot select this fallback and worker-classified turns cannot acquire a declaration-based projection. An explicit worker projection should win over a declaration; an empty worker projection must still hide every text block and forward `''`.
5. Set a one-tool-call cap and use a controlled model to request another tool call from an ordinary declared Channel turn. Expect `turn_error` with `LOOP_DETECTED`, `errorKind: loop_detected`, and `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The review baseline reproduced three display regressions: an empty declaration erased the live echo and durable user display while the turn-result record retained the wrapper; whitespace-only declarations replaced the display with blank space; a media-only declaration changed pending/child display metadata without adding a live text echo.

After the correction, all ten bridge cases pass. Six real daemon text cases pass live pending/echo, durable user/turn-result recording, and cold-process load plus transcript replay: 18 assertions. A separate real loop-cap assertion also passes, for 19 daemon assertions total. Every complete prepared text was observed in the mock model request and persisted intact. The worker-empty-projection control passes normally and fails an actually executed isolated `??` to `||` mutation.

Local quality checks passed: all 2,639 ACP Bridge package tests, repository typecheck, changed-file lint and Prettier checks, build, and bundle. Independent read-only review found no actionable issue. Test reports and artifact fingerprints are retained locally under `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` and `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`; these ignored artifacts are not included in the PR. This is protocol/recording evidence, not a browser screenshot or deployed gateway acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local quality checks and real daemon with a mock model |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, and the rebuilt `node dist/cli.js`. The runtime test used synthetic prompts, isolated workspace/home/runtime directories, port-0 listeners, and a local mock OpenAI endpoint. The global `qwen` command was unavailable, so verification used the local bundle. Both daemon processes and the mock endpoint were stopped. CI for the newly pushed source revision must complete separately; earlier revisions do not validate this update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an eligible Channel caller can choose the declared display text; that text does not authenticate the caller or prove human authorship. The model still sees the full prepared prompt.
- Not validated / out of scope: external gateway integration, real provider behavior, browser rendering, historical record rewriting, and deployment. Preexisting submission-provenance forwarding remains unchanged; Session already omits blank provenance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new API or privileged flag. Gateway producers must explicitly declare nonblank original text beside a text-bearing prompt and omit worker classification, authorization, and private display keys to use the existing non-privileged route.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13747.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

对于 Channel 来源会话，当请求包含文本块、当前回合没有 channel-worker 分类或 worker 显示投影时，将非空白原文声明用于显示投影。排队文本、实时用户回显和持久录制完整保留该声明，模型仍收到完整准备后的 prompt。

缺失、非法、空串、纯空白声明及纯附件提交继续从内容取得显示文本。显式 worker 投影保持优先，包括刻意为空的投影与声明同时存在的情况。补充这些边界的回归覆盖，并同步[英文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md)和[中文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

外部 Channel 网关可提交 `gateway instructions\nhello` 这样的模型文本，并通过既有非特权 `qwen.submittedPrompt` 契约单独声明用户原文 `hello`。声明已经到达 bridge，但用户回显和记录仍显示准备后的包装文本。本改动将展示统一为 `hello`，同时保留交给模型的指令，也不授予 worker 权限。

声明属于展示契约，不是认证，也不证明作者身份。原生授权 channel-worker 的历史展示行为和 Qwen 产品文案保持不变。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Channel 来源会话提交准备后的文本 prompt 与非空白原文声明，省略所有 worker 键。排队文本和实时用户回显应完整保留声明及其空白，模型仍应收到完整准备后的 prompt。
2. 完成回合后退出 daemon，以相同隔离 runtime 启动新进程并加载会话。load 重放与 transcript 分页都应显示声明，持久模型内容仍应保留准备后的文本。
3. 省略声明，或提供非法类型、空串、纯空白字符串，显示应保留准备后的文本。纯图片请求即使带有非空白声明，排队文本仍应为 `[image]`，回显只包含图片，且不附加私有显示元数据。普通来源会话保留原有展示。
4. 确认调用方自报的私有显示字段不能选择此回退，已分类的 worker 回合也不能取得声明投影。显式 worker 投影应优先于声明；空 worker 投影仍须隐藏所有文本块，并转发 `''`。
5. 设置单回合工具调用上限为一次，让受控模型在普通声明 Channel 回合继续请求工具调用。预期收到 `turn_error`，包含 `LOOP_DETECTED`、`errorKind: loop_detected` 和 `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`。

### 证据（修改前后）

评审基线复现了三项展示回归：空声明隐藏实时回显和持久用户展示，但回合结果记录仍保留包装文本；纯空白声明将展示替换为空白；纯附件声明改变排队项和子进程显示元数据，却没有增加实时文本回显。

修正后，十项 bridge 场景全部通过。六项真实 daemon 文本场景通过实时排队与回显、持久用户与回合结果录制、冷进程 load 与 transcript 重放，共十八项断言；独立执行的真实工具调用上限断言也通过，daemon 共十九项断言。模拟模型实际请求和持久记录都完整保留了准备后的文本。空 worker 投影控制用例正常通过，实际执行隔离的 `??` 改为 `||` 变异后则失败。

本地质量检查通过：ACP Bridge 包全部 2,639 项测试、仓库类型检查、改动文件 lint 与 Prettier 检查、构建及打包。独立只读评审未发现可行动问题。测试报告及制品指纹保留在本地 `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` 和 `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`，这些被忽略的制品不包含在 PR 中。上述属于协议与录制证据，不代表浏览器截图或已部署网关验收。

### 已验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地质量检查与使用模拟模型的真实 daemon 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 22.23.1、固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0，以及重新构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。运行时测试使用合成消息、隔离的 workspace/home/runtime 目录、自动分配端口的监听及本地模拟 OpenAI 服务。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，因此使用本地 bundle 验证。两个 daemon 进程和模拟服务均已停止。新推送 source revision 的 CI 须单独完成，旧 revision 的结果不能验证本次更新。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：符合条件的 Channel 调用方可选择声明的显示文本；该文本不认证调用方，也不证明内容由人撰写。模型仍会收到完整准备后的 prompt。
- 未验证或不在范围内：外部网关集成、真实 provider 行为、浏览器渲染、历史记录改写及部署。已有提交来源转发保持不变，Session 已经会省略空白来源。
- 兼容性与迁移：不新增 API 或特权标记。网关生产方须在包含文本的 prompt 之外显式声明非空白原文，并省略 worker 分类、授权和私有显示键，才能使用既有非特权路由。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13747。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): order a sender's commands by commit sequence, and make the member restart IT interrupt a live wait
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR follows up on #13928. It fixes the relay's per-sender command order, removes an unused helper, and rebuilds the member restart IT so that the restart actually interrupts a live command wait.

- **Per-sender command order.** The relay passes one sender's commands strictly in commit order.
  - The guard that enforced this compared command ids. A command id is a digest of the sender, prompt and call, so "older" was a random permutation of commit order.
  - It now compares each outbound's `first_sequence`, the sequence at which that record was first committed in the sender's journal.
  - An older `planned` or `accepting` entry now blocks a younger one even when discovery has not yet opened a ledger row for it. The design says this ("whether or not it has a ledger row yet"); the old `INNER JOIN` skipped such entries.
- **Unused helper removed.** `isUnfinishedCommand` restated the relay's planned/accepting rule but had no production caller, so it could only drift from the relay's SQL. It is removed.
- **The restart IT now interrupts a live wait.**
  - The relay is held from the start, by parking a task on its single-thread scheduler. carol's command therefore cannot move.
  - The kill happens only after the lead's Turn has settled and carol's command is asserted to be `planned`.
  - The relay is released only after a new writer generation holds carol's Session, i.e. after the coordinator's takeover load has fenced the dead generation.
  - The case then asserts that the reply folds into the parked wait (`consumed`) and that the lead accepts carol's result.
  - The class runs with a 15 s writer lease, so the takeover lands well inside the command's 2-minute bound.

## Why it's needed

These are the non-blocking review follow-ups on #13928: [r4253304973](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304973), [r4253304983](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304983) and [r4253304991](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304991), plus F2 of the [real-stack verification](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#issuecomment-6127090927).

- **The ordering guard.** It cannot see two open entries from one sender today, because the member awaits each command call in turn and the Turn lock refuses the rest. So it was a latent bug: it would have bitten the first producer that leaves two entries open.
- **The restart IT.** The old version killed the Harness only after carol had already finished. Its kill condition matched any checkpoint that ever named `await_command`, and it also waited for the lead's Turn to settle. So it passed whether or not a parked command wait could be resumed. That is how #13928's continue-gate bug (every `await_command` continue answered 409) got through CI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- **Ordering.** Run `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`. The new case `ordersCommandsByCommitOrderAndCountsAnEntryWithoutARow` commits `cmd_z_first` before `cmd_a_second`, so the later id sorts first. It then expects the younger command to wait behind the older one, both before and after the older one gets its ledger row, and to stop waiting once the older row is classified. On the old SQL the case fails at its first assertion.
- **Restart IT.** Run `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT` on a disposable MySQL schema, the same way the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane does: `-Phosted-harness-mysql -Dnode.executable=… -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/dist/cli.js -Dmysql.url=… -Dmysql.user=… -Dmysql.password=…`, after `npm run build && npm run bundle`. In each restart run, the Harness log shows carol's writer-conflict loads until the dead lease lapses, then one takeover load and one `POST /session/:id/managed-runtime/continue` answered 200.
- **Mutation control.** Revert #13928's continue-gate fix in `hosted-harness-session.ts` and re-bundle. The restart case then fails: every continue gets 409 `continuation_not_ready` with `phase=await_command`, and the lead never receives carol's result. The old IT passed in that state.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI change. The results below are from local runs on macOS (arm64) with JDK 21, Node 24 and MySQL 8.4.7 native, using a disposable schema.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`, `SessionMessageRelayTest`, `ManagedSessionCommandRecordContractTest` | 61/61. The new ordering case fails on the old SQL. |
| `managed-session-command-record.test.ts` | 68/68 |
| Restart case, final version | 5/5, 53–54 s each. Each run has one takeover `continue` 200, and carol's writer generation advanced. |
| Restart case, continue-gate fix reverted | Fails. `continue` → 409 `continuation_not_ready` (`phase=await_command`). |
| Full class (`membersReadAndWriteTheBoardTheirLeadReads` + restart) | 2/2 in each of 2 runs (97–99 s per class) |
| Checkstyle (`managed-agent-server`) | clean |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested (the MySQL lane runs it in CI) |

### Environment (optional)

`mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify` against a native MySQL 8.4.7 on a free local port, with the bundled `dist/cli.js` from this branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The IT's hold relies on `messageRelayScheduler` having a single thread, which is how it is configured. If its pool ever grows, the hold no longer stops the relay. The case would then fail at its own `planned` precondition rather than pass vacuously.
  - The 15 s writer lease applies to both cases in the class. The lifecycle case does not depend on the lease.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - While developing the IT I hit a load race. When the relay is released right after the restart, the relay's own plain attach of carol's Session can win against the coordinator's takeover load. The takeover then gets 409 `hosted_session_already_attached`, the coordinator treats that as non-transient, and the parked Turn is never continued. In the earlier IT draft, which released the relay right after the restart, the race showed up in 1 of the 3 runs whose logs I captured. The final IT releases the relay only after the takeover, so it does not pin this race. It is a separate product issue (related to #13838 and #13873) and is not fixed here.
  - With the continue-gate fix reverted, one of the mutation runs did not end at the case's `@Timeout`. It held its fork until failsafe's 1200 s fork timeout. I did not trace that hang.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No migration; the relay's query reads the existing `first_sequence` column.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13928.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 是 #13928 的后续：修正 relay 对同一发送方命令的排序，删除一个无用的辅助函数，并重做成员重启 IT，让重启真正打断一个仍在进行的命令等待。

- **同一发送方的命令顺序。** relay 必须严格按提交顺序处理同一发送方的命令。
  - 原来的守卫比较的是命令 id。命令 id 是发送方、prompt、调用三者的摘要，所以按它判断「更早」，等于对提交顺序做了一次随机排列。
  - 现在改为比较每条 outbound 的 `first_sequence`，即该记录在发送方 journal 里首次提交时的序号。
  - 更早的 `planned` 或 `accepting` 条目，即使 discovery 还没为它建 ledger 行，现在也会挡住后来的命令。这是设计文档的要求（「不管有没有 ledger 行」），原来的 `INNER JOIN` 会跳过这类条目。
- **删除无用的辅助函数。** `isUnfinishedCommand` 重复了 relay 的 planned/accepting 规则，但没有任何生产调用方，只会和 relay 的 SQL 渐渐不一致，已删除。
- **重启 IT 现在会打断进行中的等待。**
  - 场景一开始就占住 relay 单线程调度器上的唯一线程，让 relay 停住，carol 的命令因此无法推进。
  - 只在 lead 的 Turn 已结束、且断言 carol 的命令仍为 `planned` 之后才杀进程。
  - 要等新的 writer generation 持有 carol 的 session（即协调器的接管 load 已把死掉的 generation 隔离掉）之后，才放开 relay。
  - 随后断言回复被 fold 进那个停住的等待（`consumed`），并且 lead 收到了 carol 的结果。
  - 这个测试类使用 15 s 的写锁租约，让接管远早于命令的 2 分钟上限完成。

## 为什么需要

这些是 #13928 不阻塞的评审后续：[r4253304973](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304973)、[r4253304983](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304983)、[r4253304991](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#discussion_r4253304991)，以及[真实栈验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13928#issuecomment-6127090927)中的 F2。

- **排序守卫。** 目前同一发送方不会同时有两条未完成的条目：成员逐个等待命令调用，Turn 锁又会拒绝其余调用。所以这是一个潜伏的 bug，第一个让两条条目同时处于未完成状态的生产方就会踩到它。
- **重启 IT。** 旧版要等 carol 已经跑完才杀 Harness：它的 kill 条件会匹配任何曾经写过 `await_command` 的 checkpoint，而且还要等 lead 的 Turn 结束。所以停住的命令等待能不能续跑，它都会通过。#13928 的 continue 闸门 bug（所有 `await_command` 的 continue 都回 409）正是这样通过了 CI。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- **排序。** 跑 `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`。新用例 `ordersCommandsByCommitOrderAndCountsAnEntryWithoutARow` 先提交 `cmd_z_first` 再提交 `cmd_a_second`，所以后提交的 id 反而排在前面。它要求后来的命令一直排在更早那条之后，在更早那条有 ledger 行之前和之后都是如此，直到更早那条的 ledger 行被分类为止。换回旧 SQL，该用例在第一个断言就失败。
- **重启 IT。** 先 `npm run build && npm run bundle`，再用一个一次性 MySQL schema 跑 `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT`，方式与 `hosted-harness-mysql` lane 相同：`-Phosted-harness-mysql -Dnode.executable=… -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/dist/cli.js -Dmysql.url=… -Dmysql.user=… -Dmysql.password=…`。每次重启场景的 Harness 日志都是：carol 的 load 先因写锁冲突被拒，直到死掉的租约到期；然后是一次接管 load，以及一次返回 200 的 `POST /session/:id/managed-runtime/continue`。
- **变异对照。** 把 #13928 在 `hosted-harness-session.ts` 里的 continue 闸门修复改回去并重新打 bundle，重启场景就会失败：每次 continue 都得到 409 `continuation_not_ready`（`phase=await_command`），lead 始终收不到 carol 的结果。旧版 IT 在同样状态下是通过的。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A，没有 UI 改动。以下结果来自本地运行：macOS（arm64）、JDK 21、Node 24、原生 MySQL 8.4.7，使用一次性 schema。

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`、`SessionMessageRelayTest`、`ManagedSessionCommandRecordContractTest` | 61/61。新的排序用例在旧 SQL 下失败。 |
| `managed-session-command-record.test.ts` | 68/68 |
| 重启场景（最终版） | 5/5，每次 53–54 s。每次都有一次接管 `continue` 返回 200，carol 的 writer generation 增加。 |
| 重启场景（还原 continue 闸门修复） | 失败。`continue` → 409 `continuation_not_ready`（`phase=await_command`）。 |
| 整个测试类（`membersReadAndWriteTheBoardTheirLeadReads` + 重启） | 连跑 2 次，每次 2/2（每次 97–99 s） |
| Checkstyle（`managed-agent-server`） | 通过 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试（CI 的 MySQL lane 会跑） |

### 环境（可选）

`mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify`，连接本地空闲端口上的原生 MySQL 8.4.7，使用本分支打出的 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - IT 里的占位依赖 `messageRelayScheduler` 只有一个线程，这是它当前的配置。如果线程池以后变大，占位就停不住 relay。届时用例会在它自己的 `planned` 前置条件处失败，而不会空转通过。
  - 15 s 写锁租约对测试类里的两个用例都生效，生命周期用例不依赖租约时长。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - 写这个 IT 时遇到一个 load 竞态。如果重启后立刻放开 relay，relay 自己对 carol session 的普通 attach 可能抢在协调器的接管 load 之前完成。接管随后得到 409 `hosted_session_already_attached`，协调器把它当作不会自愈的错误，停住的 Turn 就再也不会被 continue。早期版本的 IT 在重启后立即放开 relay，保留了日志的 3 次运行中有 1 次出现了这个竞态。最终版只在接管之后才放开 relay，所以不覆盖这个竞态。它是一个独立的产品问题（与 #13838、#13873 相关），本 PR 不修。
  - 在还原 continue 闸门修复的变异运行中，有一次没有在用例的 `@Timeout` 处结束，而是一直占着 fork，直到 failsafe 的 1200 s fork 超时。这个卡住我没有追查。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有迁移，relay 的查询读的是已有的 `first_sequence` 列。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13928.

</details>
